SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Romania

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Romania. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

About Smartcat

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

You’ll win and grow Smartcat’s largest enterprise relationships, owning a small set of named strategic accounts and new enterprise prospects and running the full sales cycle. Our largest customers often start with Smartcat in a single team, and the opportunity is to change how the whole organization creates and adapts content across marketing, product, and other functions, replacing work it pays agencies, language service providers, and internal teams to do today. You’ll lead a cross-functional account team that includes AI Strategists, who run consulting-style assessments of a customer’s current and future state and develop the recommendations and business case you’ll use to win. As our offering grows, you’ll help shape how Smartcat sells to the enterprise.

MISSION

Win and grow Smartcat’s largest enterprise relationships by turning an initial foothold into a funded, multi-year content transformation across a customer’s functions, business units, and markets, building executive sponsorship from the project team to the C-suite.

OUTCOMES

  • Win new business and expand strategic accounts by running the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through negotiation, signature, and expansion
  • Turn an initial foothold into a broader content transformation across functions, business units, and markets, opening new buying centers before an active project exists
  • Build relationships from project teams to the C-suite, developing several champions and reaching the executive who owns the business outcome and the budget
  • Lead the value conversation yourself, building a quantified business case covering cost, speed, capacity, and quality, and partner with AI Strategists to deepen it through current- and future-state assessments
  • Negotiate customized multi-year agreements through procurement, legal, security, and AI governance reviews, protecting value rather than discounting
  • Lead the account team around one account strategy, including AI Strategists, Solutions Engineers, Technical Account Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Product, and executives, with delivery scope agreed before close
  • Forecast accurately, call risk early, and bring customer insight back to Product to shape our enterprise offering and sales playbook

HOW YOU’LL RAMP

By Day 30:

  • Learn Smartcat’s platform, AI agent capabilities, and enterprise value story, along with how AI Strategists, Solutions Engineers, Technical Account Managers, and Forward Deployed Engineers each contribute to an account
  • Get oriented on your named strategic accounts and target prospects: current footprint, key stakeholders, buying centers, and whitespace
  • Meet your account team partners across AI Strategy, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Product, and leadership

By Day 60:

  • Have an account strategy in place for each named account, with a plan to open new buying centers and build champions across functions
  • Be running outbound and discovery on selected new enterprise prospects
  • Begin building quantified business cases for priority accounts, with AI Strategists where an assessment will strengthen them

By Day 90:

  • Have active, multi-threaded opportunities in your accounts, with relationships reaching executive sponsors who own the business outcome and the budget
  • Present a business case to a customer executive, and be moving at least one opportunity toward a funded multi-year agreement
  • Deliver an accurate forecast, with risk called early

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, including 5+ years owning strategic or named enterprise accounts
  • A track record of personally creating and closing large, multi-year enterprise agreements, ideally eight figures in total contract value, and growing them afterward
  • Experience turning a narrow initial use case into a larger, funded initiative across a customer’s organization
  • Proven ability to sell to C-level executives and navigate complex buying groups across business, technical, finance, procurement, and legal stakeholders
  • Skill in building a quantified business case with customers, and fluency in structured methods such as MEDDPICC
  • Experience leading a virtual team of solution consultants, services, and customer success colleagues across reporting lines while keeping accountability for the deal
  • Comfort creating and closing opportunities with an evolving offering and lean infrastructure
  • Experience selling platform, data, security, or workflow software to large enterprises; experience with content, marketing, or localization technology is a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the judgment to challenge customers and disqualify weak opportunities

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

  • A global, connected team We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
  • Be part of an AI Native OrganizationWe are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
  • Innovating a $100 Billion industrySmartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
  • Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
  • Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High PerformanceAt Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

Proposal Writer & Project Manager – Wealth Solution Ready to turn complex Wealth solutions into winning, client-ready stories? Want end-to-end ownership of high‑impact proposals that directly influence Aon’s growth? Join Aon’s industry‑leading pursuit team as a Proposal Writer & Project Manager and shape compelling, bilingual (EN/FR) proposals and presentations that help us win and retain key clients across Canada! Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As a Proposal Writer & Project Manager – Wealth Solutions, you will manage end to end proposal and presentation projects that support Aon’s growth in Wealth. You’ll collaborate with consultants, practice leaders, sales teams, and designers to translate complex ideas into clear, client focused, and visually engaging content. In this role, you will: Manage the development of proposals and presentations from intake to delivery, often partnering with senior leaders and pursuit managers. Participate in proposal strategy meetings, helping to shape response themes, messages, and differentiators, and ensure that strategy is reflected consistently in the final documents. Work closely with the lead designer to produce visually impactful, brand aligned proposals and presentations. Partner with consultants and subject matter experts to develop tailored, strategic content that clearly addresses client needs and aligns with Aon’s value propositions. Continue to build a strong working knowledge of Aon’s Wealth, Health and Risk offerings to strengthen content quality and consistency. Support the development of oral presentation materials, including slide decks, in partnership with the account team and designer. Engage in brainstorming sessions and content development workshops to refine messages, structure responses, and strengthen client impact. Primarily work independently to plan, organize, and deliver assignments, determining methods and procedures for each project while coordinating input from multiple stakeholders. Help maintain and improve our content library and proposal tools (e.g., templates, standard text, SharePoint/Loopio/Qvidian entries) to increase efficiency and quality across pursuits. How this opportunity is different In this role, you’ll be at the center of how Aon tells its story—turning complex solutions into clear, compelling proposals that directly influence win rates and business growth. You’ll collaborate closely with consultants, practice leaders, sales teams, designers, and pursuit specialists across Canada and beyond, giving you exposure to high‑profile, strategic pursuits. Unlike many writing roles, this position blends strategic thinking, hands‑on content creation, and project management, so you’ll both shape the message and run the process from end to end. You’ll be supported by an experienced pursuit team, proven tools, and a strong content library, while still having the autonomy to own your projects and make a visible impact. Skills and experience that will lead to success Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Communications, Business, Marketing, Finance, or related discipline), or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Professional experience in bid management, proposal writing considered as a strong asset. Working experience as an Executive assistant considered as an asset Demonstrated experience developing custom, strategic content (leveraging key messages / value propositions) and strong editing skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and meet all deadlines. Experience creating oral presentation deliverables, partnering with a designer and account team to build client ready slide decks. Ability to learn quickly, adapt to a growing and evolving group, and work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques to achieve high-quality deliverables and practical solutions. Impeccable communication skills in both written and spoken English and French. Working knowledge of proposal management tools (e.g., SharePoint, Qvidian, Loopio or similar) is strongly preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel. French / English bilingualism preferred due to frequent interactions with clients, colleagues, or partners based in Quebec, other Canadian provinces and/or internationally. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. 2587282

Overview

The Associate Director of Instructional Media and Technology leads strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of EIM’s educational technology ecosystem, ensuring that the tools and digital experiences supporting hybrid and online learning are modern, scalable, and aligned with institutional and programmatic needs. This role oversees an EdTech team and collaborates closely with LDT leadership, Learning Designers, and Academic and University Partner (UP) stakeholders to deliver solutions that enhance curriculum development efficiency and quality, elevate the user experience, and expand EIM’s innovation capacity.

Operating within the LDT division, this role evaluates instructional technologies, guides the development and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions, develops instructional media standards and templates, and ensures educational technology platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality. Through cross-functional leadership, technology stewardship, and continuous improvement, it strengthens EIM’s digital learning infrastructure and advances its mission to deliver high-quality hybrid healthcare education at scale.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead the strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of EIM’s educational technology ecosystem and roadmap, keeping tools modern, scalable, and aligned with institutional and programmatic needs.
  • Based on ongoing analysis of internal LDT needs and the innovation roadmap, set the EdTech vision and establish metrics that evaluate effectiveness and guide investment, development, or deprecation decisions.

Team Leadership

  • Build LDT team capability with respect to instructional media and technology.
  • Develop the EdTech team, fostering an innovative and solutions-oriented culture.
  • Work in a cross-matrixed environment to identify and serve the needs of the Learning Designers, University Partners, and other stakeholders.

Technology Evaluation & Management

  • Partner with Learning Designers and LDT leadership to identify instructional and operational needs and determine technology solutions that enable effective learning experiences and improve curriculum-development quality, efficiency, and scale.
  • Apply product-management principles to the EdTech portfolio, including discovery, prioritization, roadmap development, implementation, adoption, measurement, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement
  • Champion policies (such as AI and accessibility), supporting their translation into the edtech stack and training.
  • Oversee the administration of EdTech systems.

Course Templates, Media & Digital Experience

  • Lead the development and maintenance of master course templates, reusable instructional media, and design objects that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across UP and EIM programs. Balance standardization-for-scale and customize-for-partner dynamics.
  • Establish instructional media and design standards—including video, interactive, and multimedia components—and guide implementation in partnership with the LDT team.
  • Direct the development, adoption, and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions.
  • Ensure platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality, refining them based on analytics and stakeholder feedback.

Innovation & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Expand EIM’s innovation capacity by exploring emerging technologies—including AI and automation—and recommending ROI-driven applications to implement.
  • Partner with EIM Business Enablement to ensure the LDT EdTech ecosystem aligns with enterprise technology architecture.
  • Develop adoption and change strategies for new technologies, tools, standards, and workflows, partnering with LDT leaders and managers to build awareness, capability, utilization, and sustained adoption.
  • Partner with Learning Designers and Academic/UP stakeholders to identify technology needs and systemic issues affecting course development, delivery, and user experience, driving cross-functional resolution and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or related field (or equivalent work experience), with 6–8 years of relevant experience (Associate Director) or 8-12 years (Director)
  • Minimum 5 years experience supporting online courses in an LMS (Canvas, Brightspace, Blackboard, or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of product development lifecycles and solution implementation in educational environments.
  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating technologies against organizational goals.
  • Demonstrated experience in two or more of the following: web development (HTML, CSS/SCSS); EdTech system administration; UI/UX design for educational platforms; multimedia development.
  • Proven strategic thinking with experience in road-mapping and implementation, plus strong project management across competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and applying AI and emerging technologies in educational or content-development environments.
  • Exceptional communication skills including presentation to external partners (e.g., university partners).
  • Familiarity with learning theories, instructional theories, and instructional design best practices.
  • Ability to thrive in a diversified environment with varying levels of ambiguity.

raw.description:
Praktyki w zespole Cen Transferowych, EY Advantage

W zespole Cen Transferowych pogłębisz wiedzę zarówno z zakresu cen transferowych i podatków międzynarodowych, jak i umiejętności z zakresu zarządzania projektami, współpracy z zespołem profesjonalistów oraz budowy relacji z klientami. Zdobędziesz profesjonalne doświadczenie na projektach dla największych korporacji na świecie.

EY Advantage to nowopowstała spółka w grupie EY. Razem tworzymy zespół do zadań specjalnych. Jesteśmy w stanie zaadoptować szeroki wachlarz procesów biznesowych – od obsługi podatkowej międzynarodowego klienta, po przeprowadzenie mediacji frankowych dla lokalnych klientów. Nieustannie poszerzamy naszą ofertę biznesową, szukamy możliwości automatyzacji, a także skupiamy się na usprawnieniach procesów, aby były wydajniejsze i efektywniejsze. Zbuduj swoją przewagę rynkową razem z nami.

EY.AI – na tym stanowisku będziesz pracować z ekosystemem narzędzi, w którym agenci AI są partnerami w codziennej pracy doradczej. Wspólnie analizujecie przepisy, interpretacje i dane, automatyzujecie procesy i tworzycie dokumenty oraz rekomendacje dla klientów. AI jest tu elementem pracy operacyjnej, a nie dodatkiem. 

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • Wsparcie zespołu w projektach z zakresu cen transferowych, w tym w przygotowaniu analiz ekonomicznych, polityk cen transferowych, czy dokumentacji cen transferowych
  • Bieżąca współpraca z doświadczonymi konsultantami
  • Udział w tworzeniu najlepszych rozwiązań dla rozpoznawalnych i interesujących klientów z całej Polski oraz z zagranicy – od ambitnych start-upów aż po globalne organizacje

Nasze wymagania:

  • Status studenta minimum 3 roku studiów licencjackich, lub studiów magisterskich, na kierunku prawniczym, finansowym lub ekonomicznym. Jeśli masz już ukończone studia – także zapraszamy
  • Dostępność minimum 30h tygodniowo
  • Znajomość j. polskiego i j. angielski na poziomie minimum B2
  • Dobra znajomość pakietu MS Office, szczególnie Excel

Mile widziane:

  • Pierwsze doświadczenie w zakresie podatków
  • Aktywność w kołach naukowych lub organizacjach studenckich

To oferujemy:

  • Pracę zdalną z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce

  • Wsparcie merytoryczne i finansowe w zdobyciu uznanych kwalifikacji i certyfikatów

  • EY Badges – globalna certyfikacja Twoich kompetencji i możliwość zdobycia tytułu MBA renomowanej uczelni Hult International School of Business School 

  • Career Counselor - profesjonalny, indywidualny doradca w zakresie budowania i rozwoju kariery 

  • Platforma psychoedukacyjna – pakiet bezpłatnych konsultacji ze specjalistami z szerokiego zakresu zdrowia psychicznego i rozwoju osobistego oraz dostęp do aktywności edukacyjnych  

  • Program benefitów oferujący m.in. prywatną opiekę zdrowotną z dodatkowymi badaniami profilaktycznymi, ubezpieczenie na życie, bilety, sporty zespołowe, karty sportowe i wiele innych (dostępnych online i offline)  

Etapy rekrutacji:

  1. Aplikuj. Jeśli robisz to po raz pierwszy, załóż profil i dodaj CV.
  2. Porozmawiajmy. Czekają eksperci ds. pozyskiwania talentów i osoby z Twojego przyszłego zespołu.

O EY Polska 

Jesteśmy globalną firmą doradczo-technologiczną. 

Robimy różnicę - transformujemy i zmieniamy usługi, produkty, organizacje, a nawet reguły gry. Biznesowo i technologicznie, wykorzystując sztuczną inteligencję i prawdziwe talenty. Pomagamy organizacjom rozwiązywać złożone problemy, podejmować lepsze decyzje i wdrażać zmiany na lepsze.  

Dajemy pewność – danych, opinii, standardów, technologii i bezpieczeństwa.   

Codziennie podejmujemy wyzwania, analizujemy możliwości, promptujemy, badamy, współpracujemy, zadajemy dobre pytania, planujemy, modelujemy, kodujemy, próbujemy nowych rzeczy, wyciągamy wnioski – tworzymy rozwiązania, które są kluczowe dla klientów. 

Tutaj tworzą się przyjaźnie, relacje i wspomnienia na całe życie.  

Tutaj robisz trudne i ważne rzeczy, z wspierającymi i najlepszymi ludźmi.  

Zatrudniamy ponad 400 000 wyjątkowych osób w ponad 150 krajach na świecie. W Polsce jest nas ponad 7000 – pracujemy w Warszawie, Gdańsku, Katowicach, Krakowie, Łodzi, Poznaniu, Szczecinie, Rzeszowie i Wrocławiu oraz w centrum usług Global Delivery Services w Warszawie i Wrocławiu. 

Dbamy o środowisko – nie tylko biznesowe. W ramach realizacji założonego planu zmniejszyliśmy globalną emisję gazów cieplarnianych o 40% w stosunku do roku bazowego 2019. 

EY jest pracodawcą równych szans – doceniamy i promujemy różnorodność wiedzy, doświadczeń i perspektyw naszej społeczności. Tworzymy środowisko oparte na szacunku, otwartości i współpracy, w którym każdy może się rozwijać i mieć realny wpływ. Prowadzimy program „Poziom Wyżej bez Barier”, który wspiera pracowników z niepełnosprawnościami w realizacji ich ambicji i marzeń związanych z rozwojem zawodowym.   

EY zapewnia wszystkim kandydatom jednakowe szanse w procesie rekrutacji, niezależnie od płci, wieku, rasy, wyznania, orientacji seksualnej, pochodzenia, niepełnosprawności lub jakiejkolwiek innej prawnie chronionej podstawy, zgodnie z obowiązującym prawem.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving what and how we sell—bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers distinct opportunities to help customers adopt, use, and expand technology that advances their priorities. This is an opportunity to be part of meaningful change by shaping how we engage, advise, and support customers as their environments become more complex. If you are energized by uncovering new possibilities, building executive alignment, and turning technology investments into measurable outcomes, this role offers the chance to help lead that change.

As an Account Director Senior Large Enterprise Strategis, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the Account Director Senior, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a self-directed strategy for a portfolio of large, important, or global accounts, grounded in each customer’s business model, financial priorities, operating risks, technology estate, market context, and competitive position.
  • Anticipate needs before they become formal requirements; develop points of view and use cases that connect modernization to growth, efficiency, resilience, risk reduction, and innovation.
  • Build qualified pipeline through executive relationships, account intelligence, focused prospecting, partners, marketing, and business development.
  • Prioritize investments and resources based on customer potential, solution fit, buying signals, competitive dynamics, and revenue opportunity.
  • Lead discovery across executive, business, technical, operational, and financial stakeholders to define the problem, value at stake, decision path, and urgency to act.
  • Integrate relevant capabilities across Lumen and its partners into a coherent outcome; direct architects and specialists through clear commercial and customer objectives while they own technical design and validation.
  • Build quantified business cases covering expected value, investment, implementation requirements, risk, and cost of inaction.
  • Develop customers’ and colleagues’ understanding of business, market, and solution tradeoffs; influence executive sponsors, economic buyers, technical decision makers, and internal champions.
  • Own new-logo acquisition and expansion against assigned sales, revenue, and consumption goals.
  • Lead complex, high-value sales cycles through qualification, validation, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal review, and close.
  • Exercise substantial commercial discretion—and, within company governance, full authority to shape and negotiate product, service, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Establish mutual action plans, decision criteria, stakeholder commitments, milestones, and activation dates; surface risks and dependencies early.
  • Plan and manage the account resource model, mobilizing sales, technical, delivery, customer success, channel, and partner teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Retain commercial ownership through implementation and activation; hold downstream partners accountable for customer readiness, delivery commitments, adoption, and value realization.
  • Use consumption data and customer signals to remove adoption barriers, address underutilization, anticipate revenue risk, and identify expansion across workloads, locations, and business units.
  • Convert demonstrated value into modernization, additional use cases, broader executive relationships, recurring revenue, and sustained growth.
  • Serve as a recognized expert across business, financial, market, customer, and portfolio domains; coach peers and contribute account insight that improves sales approaches and solution fit.
  • Activate channel and technology partners through joint targeting, account planning, and selling, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Use AI, agents, and automated workflows to improve research, prioritization, outreach, follow-through, and opportunity management; validate outputs and apply sound judgment.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, stakeholder maps, next steps, forecasts, and CRM records.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience and sustained quota achievement, with evidence of performance at the scope and complexity described above.
  • Success acquiring and expanding large, important, or global enterprise accounts and closing complex deals with multimillion-dollar total contract value.
  • Broad expertise across customer business and financial drivers, enterprise technology markets, complex buying environments, and relevant solutions such as networking, cloud, security, managed services, or enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated authority and judgment in structuring and negotiating complex product, service, pricing, and contract terms with senior customer leaders.
  • Technical fluency to lead credible discovery, recognize solution opportunities, and direct architects and specialists effectively.
  • Experience planning account strategy independently and orchestrating colleagues and partners across the full customer lifecycle without formal authority.
  • Understanding of recurring-revenue and consumption-based models, including how activation, adoption, and usage create customer value and revenue growth.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation to improve sales execution, with disciplined validation of outputs.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and an ownership mindset; you make decisions, surface risk early, give direct feedback, and take responsibility for outcomes.

raw.description:
Captive Client Leader | Aon Captive & Insurance Management (ACIM) Are you a client leader who turns strong relationships into long‑term strategic value? Do you thrive in complex client environments where success depends on judgment, influence, and cross‑functional collaboration? Join us to help clients make better captive and risk financing decisions! This is a virtual role with the flexibility to work virtually across the U.S. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like This role exists to strengthen client outcomes through consultative captive leadership. As a Captive Client Services Director, you will act as the principal interface between captive clients and Aon, ensuring clients receive high‑quality service, strategic insight, and access to the right expertise across the business. You will help clients make better decisions about captive performance, risk financing strategy, and long‑term value creation. Typical activities include: Leading strategic client engagement for a portfolio of captive clients, acting as the primary relationship lead for senior executives Running annual account planning discussions aligned to client priorities, service requirements, and commercial objectives Coordinating strategy check‑ins with subject matter experts to provide external perspectives, market insight, and forward‑looking recommendations Reviewing stewardship reports, performance data, and service metrics to find opportunities for improvement and additional value creation Orchestrating internal teams across domiciles, Global Capability Centres, and wider Aon businesses to deliver integrated client outcomes Finding opportunities to strengthen client relationships, improve account profitability, and expand relevant Aon services Translating technical, financial, and performance information into clear client narratives and actionable recommendations Coaching and supporting more junior colleagues to strengthen client leadership capability and consistency of service delivery Maintaining delivery discipline across service schedules, governance commitments, and regulatory requirements How this opportunity is different This role is differentiated by the level of client influence, strategic ownership, and cross‑functional coordination involved. You will operate as the central connector between captive clients and Aon, bringing together expertise from across the organization to support better client decisions and stronger long‑term partnerships. The role is shifting from transactional service delivery toward consultative client leadership. Success depends on your ability to deeply understand client priorities, proactively find opportunities, and build value through strategic conversations, insight‑led communication, and effective orchestration of Aon capabilities. You will help shape the future‑state client leadership model within ACIM, supporting a more proactive, data-driven, and commercially focused approach to client engagement. Skills and experience that will lead to success Demonstrated advisory client engagement, building deep understanding of client priorities, challenges, and risk financing objectives and operating as a trusted advisor Strong strategic and commercial thinking, connecting client strategies, commercial opportunities, and Aon capabilities to create measurable value and support profitable growth Confirmed ability to orchestrate expertise across a matrixed organization, influencing without formal authority and aligning teams around shared client objectives Track record of owning client service delivery, managing service schedules and stewardship activity, and maintaining high standards of execution and governance Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn technical information, market insight, and performance data into compelling narratives for senior collaborators Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving situations, with sound judgment, learning agility, and the ability to draw on specialist expertise when needed Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring colleagues to build capability and consistent client leadership standards across teams Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, risk management, or a related field. How we support our colleagues In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share, and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. You can request accommodations by emailing us at or your recruiter. We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. The University of Saint Mary is conveniently located a short 30 minutes’ drive from Parkville, Shawnee, Basehor and Kansas City, Kansas. USM offer all full-time employees Medical, Dental, Vision, University Paid Basic Life & AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability along with a generous Tuition Remission for the employee, spouse and dependents under the age of 24 years old.

THE HISTORY OF THE UNIVERSITY OF SAINT MARY:

The University of Saint Mary is a Roman Catholic, liberal arts university located in Leavenworth, Kansas, just 25 minutes away from Kansas City. For over 100 years, the University of Saint Mary has helped students find their way to meaningful lives and careers through an education that blends the liberal arts and a focus on critical thinking with the development of key professional skills. USM serves about 1,400 students at its main campus in Leavenworth, its satellite location in Overland Park, as well as online.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The University of Saint Mary is seeking an adjunct faculty member in social work. This position is a pool position meaning that openings may or may not be currently available. Your application for this position will be kept current for a period of two years.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Teach classes as assigned from the regular social work program curriculum.
  • Prepare syllabi and deliver curriculum appropriate for the course assigned.
  • Appropriately respond to student needs and feedback.
  • Assess the course learning outcomes.
  • Foster an inclusive educational environment to serve all learners.
  • Maintain student attendance records in accordance with university policy.
  • Submit mid-term and final grades on time.
  • Advise and/or mentor students through electronic communications and other appropriate methods.
  • Complete all required training, including training on Engage LMS.
  • Perform other duties as required.

REQUIREMENTS:

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving how we sell by bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers multiple distinct opportunities to help shape this journey while building your own expertise as a technology-focused seller. This is an opportunity to be part of meaningful change - help define how we engage, advise, and support customers as their technology needs become more complex. If you are energized by building trusted relationships, shaping a more consultative customer experience, and making a visible impact as our sales approach evolves, this role offers the chance to help lead that change.

Asn an Account Director Senior - Large Enterprise Majors, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the senior commercial lead, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a self-directed strategy for a portfolio of large, important, or global accounts, grounded in each customer’s business model, financial priorities, operating risks, technology estate, market context, and competitive position.
  • Anticipate needs before they become formal requirements; develop points of view and use cases that connect modernization to growth, efficiency, resilience, risk reduction, and innovation.
  • Build qualified pipeline through executive relationships, account intelligence, focused prospecting, partners, marketing, and business development.
  • Prioritize investments and resources based on customer potential, solution fit, buying signals, competitive dynamics, and revenue opportunity.
  • Lead discovery across executive, business, technical, operational, and financial stakeholders to define the problem, value at stake, decision path, and urgency to act.
  • Integrate relevant capabilities across Lumen and its partners into a coherent outcome; direct architects and specialists through clear commercial and customer objectives while they own technical design and validation.
  • Build quantified business cases covering expected value, investment, implementation requirements, risk, and cost of inaction.
  • Develop customers’ and colleagues’ understanding of business, market, and solution tradeoffs; influence executive sponsors, economic buyers, technical decision makers, and internal champions.
  • Own new-logo acquisition and expansion against assigned sales, revenue, and consumption goals.
  • Lead complex, high-value sales cycles through qualification, validation, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal review, and close.
  • Exercise substantial commercial discretion—and, within company governance, full authority to shape and negotiate product, service, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Establish mutual action plans, decision criteria, stakeholder commitments, milestones, and activation dates; surface risks and dependencies early.
  • Plan and manage the account resource model, mobilizing sales, technical, delivery, customer success, channel, and partner teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Retain commercial ownership through implementation and activation; hold downstream partners accountable for customer readiness, delivery commitments, adoption, and value realization.
  • Use consumption data and customer signals to remove adoption barriers, address underutilization, anticipate revenue risk, and identify expansion across workloads, locations, and business units.
  • Convert demonstrated value into modernization, additional use cases, broader executive relationships, recurring revenue, and sustained growth.
  • Serve as a recognized expert across business, financial, market, customer, and portfolio domains; coach peers and contribute account insight that improves sales approaches and solution fit.
  • Activate channel and technology partners through joint targeting, account planning, and selling, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Use AI, agents, and automated workflows to improve research, prioritization, outreach, follow-through, and opportunity management; validate outputs and apply sound judgment.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, stakeholder maps, next steps, forecasts, and CRM records.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience and sustained quota achievement, with evidence of performance at the scope and complexity described above.
  • Success acquiring and expanding large, important, or global enterprise accounts and closing complex deals with multimillion-dollar total contract value.
  • Broad expertise across customer business and financial drivers, enterprise technology markets, complex buying environments, and relevant solutions such as networking, cloud, security, managed services, or enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated authority and judgment in structuring and negotiating complex product, service, pricing, and contract terms with senior customer leaders.
  • Technical fluency to lead credible discovery, recognize solution opportunities, and direct architects and specialists effectively.
  • Experience planning account strategy independently and orchestrating colleagues and partners across the full customer lifecycle without formal authority.
  • Understanding of recurring-revenue and consumption-based models, including how activation, adoption, and usage create customer value and revenue growth.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation to improve sales execution, with disciplined validation of outputs.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and an ownership mindset; you make decisions, surface risk early, give direct feedback, and take responsibility for outcomes.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

$126,518 - $168,683 in these states: AR IA KS MO WI OH TN IN KY

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

raw.excerpt: Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів.
raw.description:
Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів. За понад 13 років роботи ми виросли з локального стартапу до потужного міжнародного хабу. Сьогодні Agentify — це сотні однодумців, які працюють як у наших сучасних технологічних офісах, так і в зручному віддаленому форматі (Remote) з будь-якої точки світу. Ми обслуговуємо провідні світові бренди, спілкуємося 5 мовами та щодня допомагаємо тисячам людей. Ми працюємо на перетині технологій та комунікацій, а кожен наш співробітник стає мультифункціональним експертом, опановуючи ключові напрямки сучасного бізнесу.

Наші Core-ніші та експертиза:

  • E-commerce & Retail — повний супровід клієнтів інтернет-магазинів: від оформлення замовлень до координації міжнародної логістики та повернень.

  • Активні продажі — робота з теплими лідами, телемаркетинг, cross-sell/up-sell та повернення клієнтів до покинутих кошиків.

  • Омніканальний Customer Care — клієнтська та технічна підтримка користувачів у режимі 24/7/365.

  • Цифрові чати — спілкування з клієнтами без голосу через Live-чати на сайтах, Email та популярні месенджери (Viber, Telegram, WhatsApp).

  • Інтелектуальна телефонія — робота з сучасним програмним забезпеченням, професійними CRM-системами та AI-інструментами автоматизації.

В свою команду зараз ми шукаємоМенеджера з продажу зі знанням німецької мови!

🌟Чому кандидати обирають Agentify?

  • Стабільність з 2013 року —прозорі виплати та впевненістьу завтрашньому дні.

  • Власна Академія —безкоштовне навчання з нуля(ділова комунікація, техніки продажів, робота з програмами та сервісами). Ми інвестуємо в розвиток співробітників і підтримуємо їх на всіх етапах адаптації.

  • Дохід без обмежень —погодинна ставка + відсоток від викупу. У продажах твій заробіток залежить насамперед від твоїх результатів.

  • Реальний кар'єрний ліфт — більшість наших Team Lead, Supervisor та QA-менеджерів виросли всередині компанії.

  • Абсолютна інклюзивність— ми вільні від стереотипів. Для нас важливі лише твої навички, енергія та бажання розвиватися.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Своєчасна оплата праці,що складається зфіксованої ставки 6,4 Євро/год + % від викупу товарів.Очікуваний місячний дохід для ТОП-спеціаліста: ~2000 євро!

  • Повністю віддалена робота.

  • Зручний позмінний графік :9.00−18.00 та з 13.00−22.00 (в кожній зміні година обіду).

  • Бонус за успішне проходження навчання

  • Дружній колектив і наставники, які завжди допоможуть.

  • Подарунки на річницю роботи та дітям співробітників на свята.

  • Спеціальні бонуси для менеджерів з найвищими показниками: індивідуальний графік, оплата спортивних абонементів або оплата курсів з іноземної мови, оплата розваг та інші привілеї.

  • Акція «Бонус за новачка» (ти отримуєш приємний бонус за кожного працівника, що прийшов по твоїй рекомендації)

Наші бізнес-цінності:

  • Відкритість—ми цінуємо вміння говорити прямо, чути інших і шукати нові підходи.

  • Надійність— для нас важливо, щоб на кожного члена команди можна було покластися, і ми створюємо умови для відповідальної роботи.

  • Безперервний розвиток—ми не чекаємо досконалості, але очікуємо бажання вчитися та вдосконалюватися.

  • Націленість на результат— ми працюємо, щоб досягати реальних результатів, а не для виконання формальних планів.

  • Клієнтоорієнтованість— ми ставимо потреби клієнтів у центр уваги та працюємо над тим, щоб забезпечувати якісний сервіс та пропонувати рішення, які створюють реальну цінність

Твої майбутні обов’язки:

  • Здійснювати дзвінки по теплій базі на нативному ринку Польщі.

  • Виявляти потреби клієнтів, презентувати товари та працювати з запереченнями.

  • Продавати продукцію компанії за скриптами.

  • Фіксувати замовлення в CRM-системі.

Що потрібно, щоб до нас приєднатись:

  • Знання німецької мови: від рівня В2+і вище (важливо розмовний рівень)

  • ПК/ноутбук, дротова гарнітура та стабільний інтернет.

  • Вільне володіння ПК і офісними програмами.

  • Уміння продавати або бажання навчитися це робити.

  • Бажано володіння техніками продажу та роботою з запереченнями.

Що для нас важливо?

Щоб ви бачили сенс у тому, що робите, були чесними з собою та колегами й не боялися вийти за межі звичного, коли це потрібно.

Якщо ви шукаєте місце, де ваші дії справді впливають на результат, ми будемо раді познайомитися.

Надсилаючи свою заявку, ви даєте згоду на обробку ваших персональних даних компанією Agentify Ltd. з метою рекрутингу відповідно до GDPR. Ви можете відкликати свою згоду або запросити видалення ваших даних у будь-який час.

At WelbeHealth, we serve our communities’ most vulnerable seniors through shared intention, pioneering spirit, and the courage to love. These core values and our participant-focus lead the way no matter what.

The Operations Support & Strategy Manager is accountable for delivering measurable results in enterprise operational initiatives, specifically to the role assignment they support. The Operations Support & Strategy Manager is an individual contributor who plays a hands-on role in identifying and implementing process improvement strategies to ensure our teams are prepared to perform their role duties efficiently and effectively. This role works to identify gaps where additional clarity and improvement in enterprise operations processes are required, and works closely with impacted teams to achieve reliable, hard-wired processes that facilitate operational excellence.

This role is different because the Operations Support & Strategy Manager at WelbeHealth:

  • Leads highly ambiguous, complex operational challenges, bringing structure and clarity to undefined problems that directly impact care delivery

  • 401K savings + match
  • Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus

  • Independently manage end-to-end enterprise operations improvement initiatives that yield simplified, repeatable, and scalable processes to improve care quality and drive team engagement

  • Develop training, job aids, SOP's, workflows, and other support materials related to operations improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to the development of operations playbooks, role specific handbooks, role specific checklists, and departmental guides

raw.title: Content Operations Specialist
raw.excerpt: Location: Fully Remote, UK Contract Type: Full-time, 6-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension, 40 hours per week Mon-Fri, 8.
raw.description:
Location: Fully Remote, UK
Contract Type: Full-time, 6-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension, 40 hours per week Mon-Fri, 8.30am - 5.30pm, UK time.
Interviews: 2 stages, plus a short meeting with our Head of Product at final stage
Salary: £30,000 per annum
Reports to: Product Manager for Core Content

About Vable

Vable builds content intelligence software used by international law firms, consultancies and government teams. We help organisations turn information overload into competitive advantage.

Our clients rely on Vable to monitor thousands of trusted sources: the news sites, publisher feeds and email newsletters through which we track content for them daily. That only works if those sources are accurate, healthy and set up properly. Keeping them that way takes careful, hands-on work, and we need someone to help us do it well.

The Role

We are hiring a Content Operations Specialist to keep our source library accurate and reliable for clients. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension.

You will work alongside our Data Specialist, setting up new sources and keeping existing ones working. Much of the job is hands-on: checking web pages and emails, working out why a source has stopped collecting content, and fixing it using our existing processes.

This is a small team of two, so your work makes a visible difference every day. The tasks are detailed, and much of it is about responding quickly to issues as they come up. No two days are quite the same: one day you might work through dozens of source checks, the next you might help deliver a large project for a client. This won't be a client-facing role, but client requests will come to you through our Customer Success team. If you love a system that runs like clockwork, and get a buzz from tracking down a problem and putting it right before anyone else notices, read on.

What You'll Do

  • Set up new sources for clients
  • Investigate and fix broken sources with the help of our internal tools, for example by reading a page's HTML, checking HTTP errors, or using XPath to extract relevant information
  • Carry out daily source maintenance, keeping error levels within our quality targets and fixing issues before clients notice them
  • Maintain publisher records, including name updates
  • Escalate wider issues to the Product Manager
  • Support client requests, from quick checks to migrations and bulk source projects
  • Take part in the maintenance projects we run at set points in the year to find hidden problems across our content
  • Share feedback on which parts of our tools and processes are slow or awkward, so we can improve them
  • Your work should show up in source health, fewer client-reported issues and faster turnaround on client requests.

Is This You?

Accuracy matters to you, whether at work or in your studies. You get real satisfaction from a system that runs smoothly, and when something looks slightly off, you want to know why and fix it.

You do your best work when you can settle in and focus. You like working at pace, moving from one problem to the next, and you enjoy the rhythm of fixing things in quick succession.

You might come from operations, data quality, research, library or information services, or a support role where you got deep into the data. You might also be a recent graduate. You don't need to be highly technical already: we will teach you how to read a page's HTML and use XPath to fix sources. What matters is that you are curious about how things work and pick up new tools quickly.

Essential Criteria

  • 2+ years in a detail-focused role, such as data quality, operations, research or support
  • Excellent attention to detail, and the patience to do a high volume of similar checks to a consistently high standard
  • The ability to learn quickly, and curiosity about how websites and tools work
  • Ownership of your work: you see tasks through, prioritise without close direction and flag problems early
  • Clear written communication, especially when explaining an issue to colleagues
  • Familiarity with HTML or XPath is a plus
  • The right to live and work in the UK

Desirable Criteria

  • Comfortable working closely with Customer Success and Product teams
  • Experience in a fully remote technical environment

Why Join?

This is a role for problem solvers who like to see results. When you fix a source, content starts flowing to clients again straight away. You will have real responsibility from your first weeks and learn quickly alongside a small team that knows the work inside out. By the end of your contract, you'll be able to cover the content function on your own.

We are investing in better tools and processes for this work, and your day-to-day feedback will help decide what we improve first.

You're Probably Not the Right Fit If:

  • You find detailed, repetitive checking draining rather than satisfying
  • You would rather wait to be told what to fix than go looking for problems, or you tend to push on alone rather than speak up when you're stuck
  • You are looking for a role focused on strategy rather than hands-on delivery
  • You like the social aspect of corridor chats and time talking face to face. We have plenty of social interaction, but it is remote.

What Success Looks Like:

🟢 First 30 Days: Confident with our sources, publishers and tools, handling day-to-day maintenance and requests with support

🟢 First 90 Days: Setting up and fixing sources independently, with proactive source-health checks back on a regular rhythm

🟢 By 6 Months: Taking on migrations and bulk projects without disruption, and able to cover the content function on your own

What We Offer:

Remote-first flexibility, WFH and learning budgets. More than that, a supportive team.

We're a team that takes ownership, stays curious, succeeds as a team and treats each other well with kindness and empathy. That's not a values statement, it's just how we work 💚

Submit your CV, cover letter and answers to the application questions. This role drives customer understanding and adoption of new solutions by coordinating testing, documenting business processes, developing training materials, and leading knowledge transfer throughout the project lifecycle. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and collaborates effectively with project managers, developers, configuration and quality assurance teams, and customer stakeholders.

Performance Objectives

Project preparation

Build and configuration

System and end-to-end testing

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Experience: 2+ years of full-time, professional work experience

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring an impact analytics data analyst to join our team! The impact analytics team at Recidiviz measures our interventions so we can more effectively improve outcomes for the justice-involved population. We’re looking for a data analyst to join our team to measure historical impact and estimate future impact to inform both our product strategy and partnerships with funders.

About us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we’ve been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About the role

The Impact Analytics Data Analyst will work alongside the research and impact tracking leads to analyze the impact of Recidiviz’s products and interventions. They will build statistical models, communicate findings with stakeholders, and build reusable processes to facilitate repeated analyses. They will also contribute to aggregated metrics infrastructure and consult with other data analysts to design and measure experiments.

Core responsibilities

  • Build statistical models using Python and SQL to quantify historical impact and estimate future impact of Recidiviz interventions on the justice-involved population
  • Collaborate with Recidiviz’s growth and fundraising team to communicate impact analysis findings with stakeholders at a range of technical altitudes
  • Build automated workflows to continuously track Recidiviz’s progress in improving outcomes for the justice-involved population
  • Work closely with the impact tracking and research leads on the impact analytics team to inform data-driven product strategy at Recidiviz
  • Define measures of product usage and impact in Python and SQL through Recidiviz’s aggregated metrics framework and Looker
  • Consult with the data analysis and data science team to develop experimental and quasi-experimental rollout analysis methodologies

Wild success

One year into the role, you will have developed a model that estimates Recidiviz’s impact on the justice-involved population over the next several years. That model, alongside other impact evaluations you conduct, will have enriched both Recidiviz’s partnerships with funders and product strategy efforts with a more detailed understanding of how Recidiviz interventions can improve outcomes for the justice-involved population.

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, to help nurture a knowledgeable, data-oriented culture
  • Enthusiasm for working with internal and external partners from diverse backgrounds and worldviews, such as government staff, researchers, journalists, technical staff, and practitioners in criminal justice reform
  • Ability to inspect source data, reason about data models, examine results closely, and prepare data and analyses that are usable for various applications
  • 2 or more years of practical experience exploring, analyzing, and processing complex datasets
  • Professional work experience using SQL to work with large datasets, including high proficiency writing efficient queries for more complex data extraction and transformation tasks
  • High familiarity with Python, specifically Pandas package, for tasks such as statistical analysis and data visualization

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with statistical analysis, specifically forecasting and/or causal inference
  • Experience translating nebulous research questions into strategic analysis plans, executing those plans, and recommending future courses of action informed by analysis results
  • Experience working in a cross-functional organization that designs, builds, and launches products for users
  • Experience working with large datasets from the public sector, especially related to criminal justice
  • Familiarity with our data stack, which includes Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker, Jupyter notebooks, and Python/Pandas

Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The annual compensation for this role is: $97,000.

What we offer

  • Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
  • 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays per year
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Complimentary One Medical membership (availability based on location)
  • Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
  • Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
  • Free mental health support via Talkspace
  • Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
  • An annual company offsite and other ad-hoc gatherings
  • All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

More about Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we’ve built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator’s 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 20 state partners - big and small, red and blue - and touches over 46% of the country’s incarcerated population. We have helped to get hundreds of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2025 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk. And if you’re really keen to see our work, you can dive into our Github :).

An important note

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

  • Clinical quality
