raw.description:
Overview

The Finance team at Confluent Health needs a true technology partner - someone who understands financial workflows, owns the technical side of financial applications, and works closely with Finance from within IT to solve operational problems.

This role exists to strengthen technology ownership for our financial systems, including revenue cycle management, accounting, billing/claims, and related workflows. You’ll help co-own roadmap decisions, system configuration, process improvements, and vendor relationships across the finance application landscape.

This is an individual contributor role, not a people-management role. The ideal candidate is a finance-technology bridge: someone who can understand how Finance works, translate needs into technical direction, and help move solutions forward with speed and accountability.

The immediate focus will include supporting AI-enabled and automation-supported solutions for revenue cycle and accounting workflows, while serving as the long-term technology owner for financial applications. This role complements, but is distinct from, the AI Solutions Engineer builder role.

Responsibilities

  • Co-own the roadmap for financial solutions (with direction from Financial Leadership and the CIO), including ERP, revenue cycle, billing/claims, accounting, and related systems
  • Serve as the primary technology point of contact for Finance leadership and staff
  • Own vendor relationships, including escalations, performance feedback, and renewal input, and roadmap alignment
  • Use agentic AI tools to help analyze workflows, identify opportunities, and prototype practical solutions
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements and implementation plans
  • Help drive process improvement across finance workflows
  • Partner with IT and AI development resources on automation and AI-enabled solutions
  • Support building, testing, validation, rollout, and continuous improvement for finance technology changes
  • Maintain visibility into system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and risks
  • Drive process improvement across finance workflows with a strong understanding of how technology can improve execution

What Success Looks Like

  • Financial applications have clear technical ownership
  • Finance leadership has a trusted technology partner
  • Revenue cycle automation moves faster and more reliably
  • Financial solutions have a clear and published technical roadmap
  • Agentic AI is used to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and solution design where it creates real value
  • Vendor and system decisions are proactive, not reactive
  • Finance and IT are aligned on the same workflow and the same problem
  • Technology decisions are grounded in how work actually gets done within finance

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of experience in financial systems, finance operations technology, revenue cycle management, or related workflows
  • Process improvement mindset, including experience in process mapping, documentation, and Process Improvement cross-functional exercises (i.e. Six Sigma).
  • Experience bridging a business function and a technology/IT team with real ownership of outcomes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience working with & managing technology vendors
  • Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences
  • Working knowledge of automation and AI concepts, with the ability to identify practical applications in financial workflows
  • Comfort using agentic AI tools to explore problems, prototype solutions, and support decision-making

Preferred

  • Healthcare revenue cycle management and/or financial ERP experience
  • Experience in a healthcare, multi-site, or services organization
  • Familiarity with automation tools, low-code/no-code systems, or AI-enabled workflows
  • Prior experience in a systems owner, technology lead, or application ownership role
  • Hands-on development experience is a plus, but not required

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a people-management role
  • Not a traditional business analyst role
  • Not a pure developer role
  • This role is about technology ownership, workflow understanding, and solution architecture & development within Finance.

Why This Role Matters

Finance is one of the most important places for technology and workflow to be aligned. This role will help close the gap between Finance and IT, improve how critical financial systems are managed, and accelerate meaningful process improvement across the business.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of finance and technology, this role should be a strong fit.

You will use your knowledge of digital transformation and change management to act as a trusted advisor and business consultant to the customer, running the sales process end to end with them.

We are looking for the successful candidate to join us in our London Office, but we’re equally happy for you to join our team as a remote employee based in the United Kingdom. Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

Its Legal Studio platform strengthens portfolio management through jurisdiction-specific coordination and real-time oversight, while experienced IP professionals remain accountable for quality and judgment. The Spanish Patent Language Lead is a critical position that requires a strong background in translation, localization, and copy-editing tasks with a focus on patent/legal documents. This professional is responsible for translating, copy editing or reviewing complex patent/legal materials from English into Spanish, ensuring the highest quality and accuracy of the deliverables to client. This role works closely with Quality, Program Squads, Talent, vendors and other stakeholders to provide precise language support for patent-related matters.
This professional ensures that the expected level of translation quality is maintained, and the product delivered to the client should always meet its intended purpose, while closely monitoring that translation expenses remain within budget. The position also supports broader team efforts through editing, error arbitration, and active participation in quality initiatives.
The Spanish Patent Language Lead understands legal requirements and engages the production team in the fulfillment of these requirements, crafting client solutions based on the Welo Global Four Pillars of Customer Service, Quality, Innovation and Global Teamwork.

This is a remote opportunity for qualified Pharmacy Technicians who hold an active pharmacy technician license or registration in the state of North Carolina.

To ensure a successful transition into the role, all new hires are required to complete six weeks of mandatory, on-site training at our PharMerica location in Raleigh, North Carolina. Candidates must be able to commute to the Raleigh location for the full duration of the initial training period. Upon successful completion of the six-week training period, employees will transition to a remote work arrangement, subject to meeting all training and performance expectations.

As a Pharmacy Order Entry Technician you will:   

  • Enter and verify medication orders in a computerized system with a high level of accuracy and efficiency.

Operating long-term care, home infusion, and specialty pharmacies across the nation, we combine the personal touch of a neighborhood pharmacy with the resources of a national network. Jesteśmy globalną firmą doradczo-technologiczną. 

Robimy różnicę - transformujemy i zmieniamy usługi, produkty, organizacje,  
a nawet reguły gry. Biznesowo i technologicznie, wykorzystując sztuczną inteligencję i prawdziwe talenty. Pomagamy organizacjom rozwiązywać złożone problemy, podejmować lepsze decyzje i wdrażać zmiany na lepsze.

Codziennie podejmujemy wyzwania, analizujemy możliwości, promptujemy, badamy, współpracujemy, zadajemy dobre pytania, planujemy, modelujemy, kodujemy, próbujemy nowych rzeczy, wyciągamy wnioski  –  tworzymy rozwiązania, które są kluczowe dla klientów. 

Tutaj tworzą się przyjaźnie, relacje i wspomnienia na całe życie.  

Tutaj robisz trudne i ważne rzeczy, z wspierającymi i najlepszymi ludźmi.

EY jest pracodawcą równych szans – doceniamy i promujemy różnorodność wiedzy, doświadczeń i perspektyw naszej społeczności. Tworzymy środowisko oparte na szacunku, otwartości i współpracy, w którym każdy może się rozwijać i mieć realny wpływ. Associate National Account Manager- Remote

Come build your career.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.

The Job:

As an Associate National Account Manager, you’ll be part of our E-Commerce team working as a remote employee. Reporting to a National Account Manager, this role will work closely with Amazon. The position will assist with current and long-term sales growth plans, forecasting, marketing, promotions, and supply chain.

You’ll get to:

  • Identify and execute cross-sell/merchandising enhancement opportunities on customer PDPs
  • Review online messaging and tactics to ensure they comply with overall channel and brand strategy. Making recommendations on improvements for a better online shopper experience.
  • Execute the creation of new PDPs and optimizing existing catalog with ecommerce-forward content including product descriptions, images, videos, bullet points, and technical documents.
  • Own and execute updates/changes/additions to customer brand store pages
  • Work in collaboration with the Sales Directors and National Account Managers to achieve team targets and execute product launches and training.
  • Plan, prepare, and present product line review presentations & quotes with the customer’s merchants for new product listings.
  • Work with internal teams to resolve various customer needs and asks.
  • Assist with all stages of the sales cycle which includes listings, presentations, execution, forecasting, POS projections/reviews, promotional planning, and billing estimates
  • Analyze key metrics and performance scorecards to develop recommendations to support sales and share growth
  • Work with cross-functional partners including SBD Operations, Channel, Product, Brand Marketing, Merchandising, Licensing, and other Commercial Teams to maximize growth and revenue within the channel
  • Continuously evolve and understand the online competitive landscape in order to secure target channel position

The Person:

You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:

  • BS in Marketing, Business, Sales, eCommerce, Digital, or related experience
  • 2-3 years of experience in sales or account management
  • 1-2 years of content/merchandising experience a PLUS
  • Strong entrepreneurial spirit with an eagerness to meet and exceed goals and targets
  • Demonstrate strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into clear, compelling messages
  • Well-developed analytical skills and great attention to detail
  • Demonstrated success in problem solving with creative outcomes
  • Ability to expand skills and take on additional responsibility in the near future
  • Assertive, organized and strong follow-through

The Details:

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:

  • Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
  • Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More:

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

  • Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
  • Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
  • Belong:Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.
  • Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!


The Total Target Cash Compensation range for this position is $84,000.00 - $135,200.00

  • This is the lowest to highest total target cash compensation range we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. Total target cash compensation offered may vary depending on multiple factors including job level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and in compliance with local wage requirements. This role is eligible for a sales incentive plan or commission. Therefore, the total target cash compensation range is inclusive of base salary and target variable cash compensation. Please note that salary is only one component of total rewards at Stanley Black & Decker.​

  • The target cash compensation range listed in this job posting reflects the range for the primary location specified. The cash compensation range may vary for other locations.​

  • The successful candidate may be eligible for annual merit increases. ​

  • Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k),Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. ​

  • Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.


Who We Are

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.


What You’ll Also Get

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.


Benefits & Perks

You’ll get a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits plan that includes medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, retirement benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, including paid vacation, holidays & personal days, and tuition reimbursement. And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners.


Learning & Development:
Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).


Diverse & Inclusive Culture:
We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.


Purpose-Driven Company:
You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.


EEO Statement:
All qualified applicants to Stanley Black & Decker are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran’s status or any other protected characteristic.


If you require reasonable accommodation to complete an application or access our website, please contact us at (860) 827-3923 or at . Due to volume, we cannot respond to unrelated inquiries about the status of a completed application or resetting an account password.


Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal (eeoc.gov)

raw.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will be tasked with owning a book of existing customer accounts and driving both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is not a transactional renewals seat; it is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal, and you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time and grow it by uncovering and closing whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. You will sit within the Client Development / Renewals organization and partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineering, in a role built for a rep who is driven to outgrow a base they know well, own their numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts, carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings (upsell/cross-sell); identify whitespace across the SentinelOne product portfolio and run consultative expansion conversations, leading with customer use cases and outcomes, not just quotes; spot expansion triggers early, including new use cases, org growth, underutilized licenses ready to convert, and competitive displacement openings; build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth, not just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close; keep renewal timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book, so the primary focus remains on whitespace and expansion with your accounts; handle commercial negotiation on your accounts, including multi-year commitments, with support on the most complex deals.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by watching deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment across your accounts; run save motions on at-risk accounts, pulling in CSM, Support, and leadership when needed; flag overdeployment/downgrade exposure and get ahead of it before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across both renewal and expansion pipeline for your book; keep Salesforce and CPQ/quoting tools current, with accurate stages and a renewal/expansion pipeline you can defend; structure and close deals cleanly, using approved pricing and quote automation.
  • Partner with CSMs on account coverage so there is no gap or overlap, and with AEs and SEs on expansion opportunities; partner with our Channel/MSSP partners on renewal continuity and baseline growth for partner-managed accounts; bring the customer's voice back to Product and the broader team, including what is working, what is stuck, and where the next opportunity is.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3 to 5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role, with upsell/cross-sell closing experience on your record, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100 percent on your own book (expansion outpacing churn), not just renewal completion.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell/cross-sell motions and identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base.
  • Comfort managing multi-stakeholder conversations and negotiations, with direct experience negotiating with senior/economic buyers.
  • A risk-aware instinct: you notice the early signals of churn or downgrade and act before renewal time.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and CRM hygiene; hands-on with Salesforce and CPQ/quote tools.
  • Strong communication and organization, curiosity about customer use-cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations without being prompted.
  • Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus, not a requirement.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range plus commissions that will vary based on the location of the candidate. The range posted here is the on-target earnings (OTE) for this position, inclusive of base salary and commissions. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

On Target Earnings
$123,250—$135,000 USD

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

Hourly Rate: $21.00 - $23.00

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the full lifecycle of prior authorization (PA) requests in support of manufacturer-sponsored patient support programs, utilizing payer portals, electronic submission platforms, fax, and telephonic outreach to facilitate timely access to therapy.
  • Serve as a central coordination point between prescribers, specialty pharmacies, payers, and internal HUB teams to ensure seamless progression from benefits investigation through authorization approval and therapy initiation.
  • Conduct comprehensive benefits verification and coverage analysis to identify prior authorization requirements, payer restrictions, and potential access barriers; initiate and track PA submissions accordingly.
  • Submit accurate and complete prior authorization requests, including all required clinical documentation, and perform proactive follow-up with payers to expedite determinations and minimize delays in therapy access.
  • Partner closely with provider offices to obtain clinical information, clarify prescribing intent, and support the development and submission of first-level appeals, reconsiderations, and medical exception requests.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with HUB teams including reimbursement, copay assistance, patient assistance programs (PAP), and specialty pharmacy partners to remove financial and administrative barriers to treatment.
  • Maintain detailed, compliant documentation of all case activities, payer interactions, and authorization statuses within the HUB CRM system to ensure transparency, reporting accuracy, and audit readiness.
  • Evaluate authorization outcomes to determine next steps, including appeals, bridge program eligibility, or alternative access solutions in alignment with manufacturer program.
  • Monitor therapy status and coordinate prior authorization renewals or reauthorizations to support continuity of care and prevent treatment interruptions.
  • Ensure adherence to all regulatory and privacy requirements, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), as well as manufacturer program policies and standard operating procedures.
  • Deliver a high-touch customer experience by maintaining professional, empathetic communication with patients and healthcare providers throughout the access
  • Support onboarding and ongoing training of team members; contribute to knowledge sharing and best practices within the HUB environment.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of payer landscapes, specialty pharmacy workflows, and manufacturer HUB services, ensuring alignment with program-specific requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as needed to support patient access objectives and overall HUB program success.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS
Previous Experience:

  • Previous experience in managing prior authorizations or working knowledge of the prior authorization process is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, insurance plans and authorization.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of pharmacy or healthcare experience.
  • Ability to manage cases from multiple clientele programs and follow program business.
  • Proficiency with data entry functions, Microsoft applications, and hands-on computer skill.
  • Ability to work independently and on a team.
  • Excellent communication, problem solving and customer service.
  • Strong organizational /interpersonal skills; attention to detail and the ability to multitask.
  • Ability to use multiple PC monitors and navigate through several software systems effectively.

Education:

  • High School Graduate required, College degree preferred.
  • State Pharmacy Technician registration or PTCB National Certification preferred.

Physical Demands:

  • Requires sitting, standing, and occasional light lifting.

This is a full-time position with benefits. Please visit our Contact Us/Opportunities page on our website for more information about our benefits list.

Job Title: Principal EHS Consultant - Business Growth Leader
Location: Houston, TX; Dallas, TX; Atlanta, GA; Tampa, FL; or Miami, FL (Remote work is available in any of the listed locations, with the ability to travel up to 50%.)
Contract: Full-time, permanent

About the Role

Discover your potential and join BSI Consulting as a Principal EHS Consultant - Business Growth Leader, where you will play a critical role in growing our Southeast Region and can be located in any of the following locations:

  • Houston, TX

  • Dallas, TX

  • Atlanta, GA

  • Tampa, FL

  • Miami, FL.

This is a senior, client-facing role designed for an accomplished safety and EHS consulting leader who thrives on building trusted relationships, expanding market presence, and creating a sustainable book of business.

In this role, you will serve as a consulting leader, responsible for driving growth across safety, occupational health, and broader EHS services. You will combine deep technical credibility with commercial acumen to expand our footprint in key regional industries while leading and mentoring high-performing consulting teams. This position will require travel.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique?

  • Regional Leadership & Ownership: Take ownership of the regional market, shaping strategy, driving growth, and building long-term client relationships.

  • Business Growth Focus: Lead market development efforts, develop a personal and regional book of business, and expand BSI’s presence across priority sectors.

  • Diverse, High-Impact Work: Deliver and oversee complex safety and EHS consulting engagements that directly impact client performance and risk reduction.

  • World-Class Clients: Partner with leading organizations in energy, chemicals, manufacturing, and infrastructure.

  • Leadership Platform: Influence regional and national strategy while collaborating with BSI’s broader U.S. and global consulting teams.

As a Principal EHS Consultant - Business Growth Leader, you will:

  • Develop and execute a regional growth strategy focused on safety and EHS consulting services in the Southeast region

  • Build, manage, and grow a personal and regional book of business through client development, cross-selling, and long-term partnerships

  • Identify, pursue, and win new opportunities; lead proposal development, pricing strategy, and client presentations

  • Serve as a trusted senior advisor to clients on safety management systems, regulatory compliance, risk management, and EHS performance improvement

  • Lead and oversee complex consulting engagements, ensuring delivery excellence across scope, schedule, budget, and quality

  • Collaborate with national service line leaders to expand multidisciplinary solutions (safety, IH, EHS systems, sustainability, and risk)

  • Mentor and develop regional consulting talent, fostering a high-performance and growth-oriented culture

  • Represent BSI in the market through networking, industry events, and thought leadership

  • Support regional and national clients with estimated 30–50% travel

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has 15+ years of consulting experience in safety, EHS, or risk management within a professional services environment

  • Holds a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in EHS, safety, engineering, science, or a related field

  • Brings deep safety consulting expertise, with the ability to integrate occupational health and industrial hygiene as part of broader EHS solutions

  • Demonstrates strong business development success, including at least 5 years of revenue generation, sales, and client growth experience

  • Has a proven record of growing markets, developing client portfolios, and driving sustainable revenue

  • Possesses strong executive presence and credibility with senior client stakeholders

  • Has established relationships in oil & gas, chemical, manufacturing, energy, or industrial sectors (strongly preferred)

  • Shows experience leading, mentoring, and scaling consulting teams

  • Is open to 30–50% travel

Why BSI?

At BSI, you’ll be part of a global leader committed to excellence in Consulting. We offer a platform for you to innovate, influence, and contribute to a safer and more sustainable future. If you have the vision to lead in IH and OHS and the drive to make a difference, we invite you to bring your unique talents to our team.

Take the Next Step

Are you ready to be a key leader in our journey of growth and success? Apply now and join us in shaping a safer and healthier world.

What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, 401(K) with company contribution, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

The salary for this position can range from $126,000 to $170,000 annually; actual compensation is based on various factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s competencies, level of experience, education, location, divisional budget, and internal peer compensation comparisons.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:
  • Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.
  • Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.
  • Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.
  • Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.
Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

Primary Purpose
The Cloud Operations Engineer I ensures that services run smoothly, are highly available, and are cost-effective, while monitoring and resolving production problems with zero or minimal impact to the business. The role sits within a high-performing team in a growth-stage technology company that continuously reflects on and improves software development. The Cloud Operations Team values high technical competency and the ability to react quickly to develop solutions for a rapidly growing team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Follow standard procedures to handle and resolve requests for the Cloud Operations team.
  • Support, optimize, and improve production environments as part of a squad of cloud engineers.
  • Carry out proactive maintenance of supported customer environments.
  • Manage application infrastructures across several geographically dispersed data centers.
  • Work with application teams to automate application setup, deployment, and configuration.
  • Provide technical solutions to automate processes or functions to improve business operations.
  • Continually monitor and tune application infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, availability, and utilization of resources.
  • Engineer and deploy releases, enhancements, and upgrades or new applications throughout non-production and production environments.
  • Ensure internal tooling, processes, and procedures are regularly maintained, and provide input into improvement plans and roadmaps.
  • Provide input on scalability, capacity planning, and high availability concerns.
  • Work with Architecture, Development, and Quality Assurance teams to contribute to the technical planning of upcoming features in the next release.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for new features built or enhancements implemented, and propagate that knowledge throughout the team.
  • Lead technical discussions and design for new projects.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for process change within the team, and work with stakeholders to improve operations workflows.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 2 – 4 years of professional experience in a DevOps role.
  • Previous experience working on a client-facing product or service in production.
  • Architecture & Cloud Infrastructure:
  • Exposure to modern SaaS application architecture.
  • Knowledge of IaaS and cloud platforms such as IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.

Programming & Automation:

  • - Experience in automation and software development with proficiency in languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, C/C++, or PL/SQL.
  • Scripting capability in PowerShell, BASH, or Python.
  • Knowledge of configuration management and automation tools such as Chef, Puppet, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation.

raw.description:
Business Introduction
At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. Find out more: Our approach to R&D


We’re looking for a Clinical Development Director to shape the future of our respiratory portfolio. In this role, you’ll lead the scientific design and delivery of clinical studies across multiple stages of drug development and play a pivotal part in driving our clinical research and development strategy.

Position Summary
You will lead the clinical development of respiratory disease programs, working closely with global teams to design and deliver impactful clinical studies. Your role will help shape operational strategies that advance important treatments, supporting patients and healthcare providers. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. This position offers a unique chance to grow your expertise, make meaningful contributions, and be part of our mission: uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Responsibilities
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Generating the data and evidence required to determine a medicine’s potential efficacy, safety profile, key areas of product differentiation and value to patient in the shortest possible timeframe
  • Providing effective support / oversight of evidence generation activities to assure patient safety and study delivery
  • Contributing to regulatory interactions including clinical trial applications, briefing documents, presentations, addressing questions and responses
  • Contributing to the writing of the clinical study synopsis (CSP), study protocols, clinical study reports (CSR) and any subsequent study abstract and manuscript publications
  • Supporting the strategic management of the Integrated Evidence Plan (IEP), including the Clinical Development Plan (CDP) for an asset in development
  • Ensuring alignment with and support to project strategic plans, regulatory requirements and commercial goals, optimizing clinical study design aligned with IEP and CDP
  • Delivering clinical development timelines, enabling key decision points and Go/No Go criteria for the CDP
  • Developing and maintaining relationships with matrix counterparts in Commercial, Research, Regulatory, Clinical Operations and Statistics.
  • Serving as a clinical point of contact for senior management and senior level matrix teams, both internally and externally for an asset in development
  • Interfacing and influencing a diverse range of scientific external experts (e.g. regulators, payors, CROs, consultants, investigators) in order to deliver clinical programs and align to business strategy and address patient needs
  • Contributing to the implementation and embedding of strategic initiatives and various organizational initiatives in Clinical Sciences
  • Identifying and highlighting transformational opportunities where projects can offer highly significant benefit to patients in ways not possible with existing approaches


Why You?

Basic Qualifications
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science related field
  • 3 years of Significant clinical training and/or applicable clinical research experience; understanding of clinical development planning and running clinical trial from concept study idea to publication.
  • Robust knowledge of ICH guidelines, GCP, FDA requirements, regulatory and reimbursement data requirements in responsible area
  • Solid understanding of needs and priorities of regulators, payers and prescribers in relevant market(s)
  • Demonstrated experience using new learning and digital tools to create innovation in other areas
  • Thorough understanding of clinical research methodology and biostatistics principles, to facilitate innovative and efficient clinical trial design, and clinical development plans with clear data-driven decision rules
  • Proven ability to utilize statistics, and visualisation techniques to interpret or analyse complex information and make correct inferences and conclusions.

Preferred Qualifications
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • PhD or PharmD degree valuable but not required
  • Experience leading matrix teams with a strong reputation of inspiring and motivating high performance
  • Previous experience as a Clinical science Lead (CSL) at GSK, or a similar position in another company
  • Significant experience in respiratory clinical drug development with an understanding of the disease area, the underlying biology and potential therapeutic targets.


Work Arrangement

This role is home based in Canada, preferably in Ontario.

Are you ready to bring your clinical development experience to a team that’s making a real impact? Join us, and together we will push boundaries and create better outcomes for people affected by respiratory diseases. Apply today and let’s get ahead of disease together.


Skills

Analytical Thinking, Business Acumen, Change Management, Clinical Research, Clinical Trial Designs, Communication, Decision Making, Fostering Collaboration, Influencing Without Authority, Leadership, Matrix Leadership, Mentorship, People Management, Risk Management, Strategic Thinking

Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law. GSK is committed to accommodating persons with disabilities. If you need accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information on our accommodation policies, please contact us at . raw.description:
Overview

At Ferrellgas our corporate roles are fully remote, enabling talented professionals to support our field operations from wherever they are. These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results. The EHS Compliance Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative and operational support for Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) administrative functions and ensuring accurate entry and maintenance of safety-related documentation within Ferrellgas systems. The role requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to complete assigned tasks accurately and in a timely manner.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we’re committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D
  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Time Off & Family Support: Paid Time Off (PTO), parental leave, and tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness & Assistance Programs: Wellness program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Medicare support
  • Employee Perks: Referral program, employee discount programs, and propane savings

Responsibilities

  • Provides administrative support and coordination for Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs across field operations to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Administers and maintains administration of the EHS management system by entering, maintaining, and ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with company and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepares, formats, maintains, and distributes EHS materials and resources for field personnel.
  • Assists with reporting and data analysis by generating routine and ad hoc reports, identifying trends, and providing information to support leadership decision-making.
  • Coordinates with teams to support timely completion of safety initiatives, compliance activities, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Reviews Motor Vehicle Records (MVRs) for all new hire candidates and evaluates Safety Performance History reports for prior DOT-regulated employment; communicates findings and recommendations to Field Management.
  • Manages ongoing compliance for DOT-regulated employees, including MVR reviews, medical certification tracking, and timely follow-up on expirations or issues.
  • Maintains confidential employee and safety records while ensuring the integrity and security of sensitive information.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in propane operations, safety, compliance, transportation, or a related operational environment is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, Word, Adobe Acrobat, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize work load.
  • Ability to adjust and adapt to changes in work flow.
  • Ability to identify problems and present solutions.
  • Strong oral, written and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong trend analysis skills.
  • Strong safety ethic.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, or otherwise authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

Hear from our current employees and discover the people behind Ferrellgas: Employee Testimonials

raw.title: Senior Communications Manager, Safe Childhoods Initiative
raw.excerpt: Safe Childhoods is an international initiative dedicated to mobilising more—and more effective—philanthropic funding to prevent and respond to childhood sexual violence.
raw.description:
Safe Childhoods is an international initiative dedicated to mobilising more—and more effective—philanthropic funding to prevent and respond to childhood sexual violence. We work with leading philanthropists, foundations and partners around the world to raise awareness, connect donors with trusted experts and organisations, and unlock larger, longer-term and more strategic investments. Our mission is to transform how philanthropy addresses childhood sexual violence, making prevention and effective responses a global priority.

Safe Childhoods is hosted by Purposeful Ventures, a UK charity that partners with social entrepreneurs and philanthropists to build and grow organisations that improve the lives of children and young people. Purposeful Ventures is committed to creating a fairer society in which every young person can thrive. The Senior Communications Manager, will be employed by Purposeful Ventures.

The Senior Communications Manager is an exciting new role that will play a central part in developing Safe Childhoods’ communications and strengthening its external profile. Working closely with the Executive Director and wider team, you will help ensure that Safe Childhoods communicates clearly, consistently and credibly with funders, partners and the wider philanthropic and civil society community.

You will help develop and implement Safe Childhoods’ communications strategy, producing high-quality content across publications, newsletters, the website, social media, event materials and donor-facing communications. You will support the Executive Director and senior colleagues with presentations, talking points and written materials, while helping to establish a consistent voice and visual identity across our communications.

We are looking for an excellent writer and editor with strong judgement, creativity and attention to detail. You will be able to translate complex and sensitive issues into clear, compelling and carefully considered communications for philanthropic audiences. You will be highly organised, comfortable managing multiple priorities and capable of delivering high-quality work independently, while knowing when to seek input and guidance.

This is an opportunity to take significant ownership of communications within an ambitious, growing international initiative. You will work closely with colleagues across donor engagement, field-facing work and operations, helping to develop the content, materials and communications approaches that strengthen Safe Childhoods’ reach, credibility and impact.

Please download thefull job descriptionon the Purposeful Ventures website.

Job Description

Purpose

To support the development and delivery of Safe Childhoods’ communications, ensuring that the initiative communicates clearly, consistently and credibly with funders, partners and the wider philanthropic and civil society community. The Senior Communications Manager will take responsibility for producing high-quality communications and maintaining a consistent organisational voice, with particular attention to accuracy, sensitivity and sound judgement.

Responsibilities and duties

Communications strategy and content

  • Contribute to the development and implementation of Safe Childhoods’ communications strategy, ensuring activities support organisational priorities and reach key audiences.

  • Manage the production of key communications materials, including publications, newsletters, website content, social media, event materials and donor-facing communications.

  • Translate complex and sensitive issues into clear, engaging and accessible content for philanthropic and partner audiences.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the quality, consistency and reach of Safe Childhoods’ communications.

Executive and senior communications support

  • Work closely with the Executive Director and senior colleagues to develop presentations, talking points, speeches and other written materials.

  • Provide high-quality writing, editing and proofreading support, adapting content to different audiences and purposes.

  • Support the preparation of donor briefings, external correspondence and other materials as required.

Voice, identity and quality

  • Maintain a consistent organisational voice, tone and visual identity across communications outputs.

  • Exercise sound judgement on safeguarding, reputational considerations and power dynamics when developing and reviewing communications.

  • Ensure that all external materials are accurate, accessible and produced to a high standard, with appropriate review and approval processes followed.

  • Develop and maintain practical communications processes, templates and resources to support consistency and efficiency across the team.

Events and external profile

  • Coordinate communications for webinars, convenings and other events, working closely with colleagues and external suppliers.

  • Develop event-related content, including invitations, programmes, speaker briefings, presentations and follow-up communications.

  • Support appropriate media engagement and other public-facing activities, balancing opportunities to strengthen Safe Childhoods’ profile with the need for discretion.

  • Provide communications and practical event support alongside the events agency and operations team as required.

The job description is subject to change and the postholder may be required to undertake tasks not specifically referred to above. Such duties, however, will fall within the scope of the job description.

Who we are looking for

Essential

Key requirements

  • Passionate about creating a fairer society where all young people thrive.

  • Demonstrable track record of taking ownership of responsibilities and delivering on commitments.

  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce clear, nuanced material for different audiences.

  • Able to produce simple, high-quality visual materials independently using tools such as Canva, while knowing when to bring in specialist design support.

  • Strong strategic judgement and the ability to communicate appropriately about complex and sensitive issues.

  • Thoughtful, calm and attentive to safeguarding, reputation and power dynamics across various communications channels.

  • Comfortable working in a small team, managing multiple deadlines and producing high-quality work autonomously.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Knowledge

  • Strong working knowledge of strategic communications, audience-focused messaging and multi-channel content development.

  • Understanding of the reputational, safeguarding and ethical considerations involved in communicating about sensitive issues.

Experience

  • Demonstrable experience of developing and delivering communications strategies and high-quality external communications.

  • Demonstrable experience of writing and editing complex material for senior, external or philanthropic audiences.

  • Experience of producing communications across a mix of channels such as publications, newsletters, websites, social media, presentations and events.

Skills and competencies

  • Effective, engaging and nuanced communicator, written and verbal, with the ability to structure and articulate complex information for internal and external audiences.

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver multiple pieces of work to deadline.

  • Ability to be pragmatic and agile, using good judgement to identify the most effective actions.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with senior colleagues, partners and external suppliers.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion

Desirable

  • Experience in a foundation, charity, international development, advocacy or field-building context.

  • Experience supporting events, media or other public-facing communications.

  • Advanced design skills or experience working with professional design tools.

Overview

Goldbelt Professional Services specializes in providing expert resources for Public Health missions including scientific, technical, and administrative support from junior staff to high-level subject matter experts. Research and data driven, Goldbelt Professional Services’ experts create solutions customized to the client’s needs.

Summary:

Goldbelt Professional Services is seeking a Data Analyst I to provide NHSN Dialysis Event Prevention and surveillance training support within the Surveillance Branch (SB).

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Provide direct user support guidance for the NHSN Dialysis Event module from a user perspective.
  • Conduct user outreach and education and provide consultation/technical assistance to dialysis provider groups, quality improvement organizations, and health departments.
  • Analyze the NHSN system's daily function and develop system modifications to improve data quality; track modifications.
  • Update surveillance forms, instructions, and protocols with improvement recommendations.
  • Develop data validation projects to evaluate and improve quality.
  • Work with Division SMEs to enhance usability of NHSN surveillance data for prevention efforts.
  • Manage reports, data file exchanges, and agreements between CDC and partner organizations.
  • Review user inquiries related to NHSN and CMS quality incentive programs and prepare response documents.
  • Handle inquiries, perform enrollment, and support correct application of CDC HAI definitions and data entry. Expected volume is 212 per month (range 122–415).
  • Identify user/system issues requiring modification; contribute to development and prioritization of modifications.
  • Develop NHSN modules and electronic reporting mechanisms; communicate with users to improve interface and group functions.
  • Prepare and present educational trainings (20–30 annually) about NHSN.
  • Write and review training/educational documents and outreach messages.
  • Contribute subject matter support for meeting planning related to NHSN, the Coalition, and dialysis safety.
  • Create draft CDC communication materials promoting HAI prevention strategies.
  • Write/review content for the CDC Dialysis Safety webpage.
  • Perform data management, cleaning, and quality assessment analyses.
  • Perform NHSN data analyses for CMS quality incentive programs and create user reports.
  • Advocate with partners to increase participation in ESRD Network, NCC, and other CMS HAI prevention activities.
  • Develop and promote CDC infection prevention and surveillance resources.
  • Review and develop website materials and communications related to infection prevention, surveillance, and response.
  • Participate during CDC response activities and training exercises under direction of the DHQP Team Lead; duties include staffing the EOC desk to help support CDC's mission.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of the principles, concepts, methods, and techniques of public health research and evaluation to analyze, evaluate, and provide expert advice and consultation.
  • Knowledge of the principles, methods, applications, and state-of-the-art technology in the position's scientific area of responsibility to provide direction and guidance on critical and complex issues.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing to make clear, convincing presentations.
  • Knowledge of the rules, procedures, and principles that govern intramural and extramural program development, monitoring, and evaluation.
  • Highly proficient in using Microsoft Office Tools (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint).
  • Excellent judgment and decision-making; capable of working independently with ability to multitask successfully.
  • Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication in interpersonal exchanges.
  • Highly organized with great attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1 – 2 years of experience providing public health data analysis and manipulating, cleaning, and reporting data using a variety of statistical functions.
  • Highly proficient in using various statistical software (SAS, R, Python, etc.)
  • Knowledge of data management systems and application of data management software.
  • Previous experience working with the government procedures and guidelines.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain CDC Public Trust Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Public Health, or related field.
  • 3 – 5 years of experience providing public health data analysis and manipulating, cleaning, and reporting data using a variety of statistical functions.
  • Prior experience working with the CDC is highly desired to understand the culture and environment.

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $80,000.00 to $90,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Join Lumen as a Senior Network Implementation Program Manager supporting Business as Usual and metro work across Wisconsin. You will oversee complex telecommunications construction, relocation, fiber remediation, and network projects while coordinating vendors, stakeholders, funding, permitting, engineering, testing, cutovers, and project closeout.

Location

This position is responsible for BAU (Business as Usual) and Metro network work throughout the state of Wisconsin, supporting all Metro markets as well as the long-haul network as needed.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Manage Business as Usual and metro network projects throughout Wisconsin, with support for the long-haul network as needed.
  • Develop productive vendor relationships and hold construction partners accountable to engineering and construction standards through audits and site visits.
  • Manage project timelines, deadlines, funding, railroad flaggers, permits, engineering drawings, conduit and fiber construction, scheduling, cutovers, records, and financial closeout.
  • Confirm funding is authorized before work begins and generate work orders for vendor activities.
  • Receive completed vendor work and close associated projects in applicable internal systems.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Strategy: Proactively engage with Marketing Automation CX Strategy partners, SMEs in marketing, product and within the business to architect marketing automation that aligns with business objectives and achieves target business outcomes.

raw.description:
Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Location: Caribbean/Remote

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Proficiency in agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Experience with process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, and backlog management.
  • Clear understanding of technical concepts, including familiarity with APIs, mobile/web technologies, and SDLC.
  • Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).
  • Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Ability to apply structured, logical, and data-driven approaches to understand complex business problems and deliver actionable insights.
  • Consistently demonstrates the ability to work autonomously, proactively seeking out information and resources to understand tasks and deliver results
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities, makes informed decisions, and manages assignments with minimal supervision or reliance on others for context or direction.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic project settings.
  • Commitment to industry best practices (IIBA BABOK, Agile Manifesto).

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified Product Owner (CSPO), IIBA Agile Analysis Certification (IIBA-AAC), or equivalent.
  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.

raw.description:
Upjohn Export B.V. sucursal Costa Rica

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

Every day, we rise to the challenge of making a difference and here’s how the Financial Master Data Analyst role will make an impact:

The Financial Master Data (FMD) Analyst will create and maintain financial master data in necessary systems and in accordance with company policies, procedures, master data processes, and master data governance model. The Analyst will also support maintaining policy-aligned approval tables within systems needing to consume such data. Decision-making and solving problems of in-depth scope and complexity required to achieve quality execution and adherence to master data process and governance. This position will also support the reviewing, improving, and identifying of opportunities for innovation and within the established master data maintenance processes. The responsibilities of this role incorporate a variety of functions concurrently for maintenance of the master data that is essential to the company financial statements.


Additionally, this position will be also supporting the different project implementations where the FMD support is needed. coordinating efforts with stakeholders related with the creation and maintenance of the Finance Master Data and the mapping maintenance.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Create and maintain financial master data to support business processes (including but not limited to: approval flow mapping, Chart of Accounts for GL Accounts and Cost Elements, Cost Centers and Cost Center standard hierarchy, Profit Centers and Profit Center standard hierarchy, bank keys, foreign exchange rates, and financial statement versions) in accordance with company policy, including approver maintenance for Viatris’ Global E-Procurement tool, Legal Contracts Management tool, and invoice approval routing / reconciliation tool.
  • Support collection of master data, related financial reporting mapping and all related approval mapping to support a variety of systems requirements.
  • Ensure Financial master data is evaluated and created in such a way that processes will function efficiently, effectively and in accordance with company policy.
  • Manage requests from users for new master data and changes to existing master data.
  • Track assigned financial master data requests from users and prioritize requests according to set guidelines and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Maintain and update associated training material, process documentation and forms related to collection and maintenance of financial master data.
  • Implement and maintain effective communications with key internal and external partners.
  • Maintain effective communications with core FMD virtual team.
  • Provide master data guidance and training when appropriate.
  • Solve issues / scenarios and perform data and risk analysis of varying complexity (low, medium and high) following established policies and procedures in order to reach a logical conclusion/solution to a request.
  • Support and participate in master data maintenance activities related to system implementations, upgrades, enhancements, integrations, legal entity consolidations and other various business driven projects.
  • Support and ensure adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Collaborate with core FMD virtual team in efforts outside of normal business as usual tasks; namely: integration, enhancements and business directives.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities.
  • Support ERP project implementations, coordinate effort with stakeholders and business in order support these projects from the FMD perspective.
  • Support Approval & Authorizations (CFA) activities and process related.
  • Perform other duties as assigned according to the FMD operational process requirements.

The minimum qualifications for this role are:

Knowledge

  • Awareness of systems and requirements relating to master data processing – forms, approvals, and policy.
  • Knowledge of chart of accounts and maintenance – account types, normal balances, where and how used.
  • Knowledge of Hyperion or other financial reporting tools and their master data maintenance activities.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite -- particularly Excel and Outlook -- and related tools.
  • Awareness of internal controls and mitigations (SOX Compliance).
  • Awareness of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (USGAAP).
  • Experience in the following business areas preferred: Finance, Accounting or Financial Planning & Analysis. However, a combination of experience and/or education will be taken into consideration.
  • SAP experience preferred.

Skills And Abilities

  • Ability to understand multi-dimensional approval matrices and translate to system approval rules.
  • Ability to interpret and analyze customer requests and make master data recommendations to achieve accurate and policy-aligned execution.
  • Ability to see the macro and micro view of requests and determine best course for implementation.
  • Ability to work independently and as a team member.
  • Ability to communication and interact clearly, effectively, and professionally in English with core FMD virtual team and a diverse group of global users verbally and in written form.
  • Ability to collect data and perform data and risk analysis to reach a logical conclusion/solution to a request.
  • Ability to quickly identify and resolve issues related to finance master data.
  • Ability to rank and prioritize work for timely delivery.
  • Ability to meet individual and department deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to plan, organize and execute master data maintenance in accordance with established procedures.
  • Ability to create and manage related process documentation.
  • Possess strong organizational skills for managing requests from across the globe.

Education/Experience

  • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree or the equivalent in experience (2 – 4 years of experience).
  • Experience in finance related industry for 2 - 4 years.
  • Experience in data analytics and auditing preferred.

Language Skills

  • English B2 minimum, Portuguese is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex business and/or technical documents.
  • Ability to write business correspondence in English.
  • Ability to work with groups of people such as other departments and communicate known concepts.
  • Ability to present to a group.

Reasoning Ability

  • Ability to apply logic and quantitative reasoning.
  • Ability to draw inferences and follow prescribed and detailed procedures to all scenarios.
