Job Description Summary

The Research Program Integrator (RPI) manages clinical and technical research activities for assigned GE HealthCare businesses across multiple global regions. The role leads cross-functional planning, execution, and communication for internal and external studies, including GE-sponsored and investigator-sponsored research. The RPI oversees the entire lifecycle of research projects, from development, active management, and closure, ensuring all quality, content, schedule, and budget targets are met.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead assigned research projects from planning through completion, including study timelines, budgets, risks, deliverables, and reporting.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Research, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations.
  • Ensure compliance with Quality Management System requirements, SOPs, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain study documentation, including protocols, plans, informed consent forms, reports, and project records.
  • Manage through study execution, including oversight of study initiation, monitoring, training, enrollment progress, and closure activities with internal teams and external research partners.
  • Identify and resolve project risks, operational issues, and cross-functional challenges.
  • Support contract, budget, payment, and vendor management activities.
  • Maintain accurate records within approved systems, including CTMS and regulatory databases.
  • Provide project updates to stakeholders and support portfolio prioritization with Research Managers.
  • Contribute to process improvements and research project management best practices.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, engineering, clinical sciences, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in clinical or technical research programs in a clinical setting, industry, government agency, or a similar role in a medical device or pharmaceutical company.
  • Experience with medical device, healthcare technology, pharmaceutical, or clinical research organizations.
  • Familiarity with investigator-sponsored and industry-sponsored research.
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), clinical research regulations, and research documentation requirements.
  • Demonstrated project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS) and regulatory reporting systems.
  • Experience managing research budgets, contracts, and external partners.
  • Understanding of product development and cross-functional project environments.
  • Experience with global teams
  • Knowledge of GE HealthCare tools and processes (e.g., Support Central, SSP, AST, MyWorkshop).
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, and drive project execution.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $120,000.00-$180,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

raw.description:
Kriya is a biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to develop life-changing gene therapies for diseases affecting millions of patients around the world.

We leverage our proprietary computational engine, in-house manufacturing infrastructure, and integrated design platform to engineer technologies and therapeutics with the potential to transform the treatment of a broad universe of diseases of high unmet need, with a focus on metabolic disorders, neurology, and ophthalmology.

We are proud to have been named Triangle Business Journal’s Life Sciences 2024 “Best Private Company to Work For,” recognized by Forbes as one of “America’s Best Startup Employers of 2024,” and honored as one of BioSpace’s “2025 Best Places to Work.”

Role Overview

The Vice President, Biometrics leads all biometrics functions at Kriya Therapeutics, including biostatistics, statistical programming, and clinical data management. This leader develops and executes the statistical and data strategy for the clinical pipeline, ensures the integrity and quality of data supporting regulatory submissions, and builds the team and systems needed to move programs from early clinical studies through registration. The role is a member of the clinical development leadership team and a trusted partner to Clinical, Regulatory, Translational, CMC, and Quality.

The VP will apply deep expertise in rare and common disease trial design, novel endpoints, and natural history and external control approaches to a modality where the data package must be both rigorous and efficient.

Key Responsibilities
  • Strategy and leadership. Develop and execute the biometrics strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap in line with the clinical development plan. Serve on the clinical development leadership team and represent Biometrics to executive management and, alongside the CMO, to the Board as needed.
  • Biostatistics. Provide statistical leadership for trial design, sample size, endpoint selection, adaptive and Bayesian methods, interim analyses, and statistical analysis plans across all programs. Lead use of natural history data, external controls, and real-world evidence in support of development and regulatory strategy
  • Regulatory interaction. Lead biometrics content and execution, in partnership with Regulatory, for FDA, EMA, and other health authority interactions, including pre-IND, End-of-Phase meetings, Scientific Advice, INDs, and BLAs/MAAs. Ensure submission-ready datasets, ADaM/SDTM packages, and define files meet CDISC and agency standards.
  • Statistical programming and data standards. Oversee SDTM and ADaM development, TLFs, integrated summaries, and programming validation. Establish standards, metadata repositories, and reusable macros that support quality and speed.
  • Long-term follow-up and safety data. Partner with Clinical Safety and Clinical Operations on data strategy for long-term follow-up required for gene therapy programs, including DSMB and independent data monitoring committee support.

  • Proven track record leading or substantially contributing to biometrics for successful regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/MAA) and approvals; experience with cell and gene therapy, rare disease, or ophthalmology/cardiology/neurology programs is strongly preferred.

About Mimecast


The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.


Overview


As Director, Global MSP Marketing, you'll define and lead the worldwide marketing strategy for Mimecast's Managed Service Provider (MSP) business. Part of the Global Integrated Marketing team and reporting into Marketing leadership, you'll lead a global team and partner as a peer with the Global Head of MSP and regional MSP leaders.

You'll build programs that recruit new MSPs, grow pipeline and revenue through existing and new business, enable partners to sell and market Mimecast, and strengthen MSP engagement and retention. You'll turn global strategy into consistent regional execution across demand generation, campaigns, content, events, enablement and lifecycle marketing.


What You'll Do


  • Own the global MSP marketing strategy, annual plan and budget, aligning with MSP leaders and corporate marketing on regional goals and KPIs. Represent MSP marketing in executive forums.
  • Lead MSP recruitment programs, from the partner value proposition and targeted outreach to onboarding communications that accelerate time to first revenue.
  • Drive pipeline and revenue through cross-sell, upsell and net new business campaigns, with scalable campaign kits and joint marketing plans for regional teams.
  • Own MSP marketing and sales enablement, including playbooks, messaging, co-brandable assets, training and certification support, and the partner portal experience.
  • Lead lifecycle marketing across partner communications, community, advocacy, recognition and customer success stories. Use feedback and engagement data to improve satisfaction and retention.
  • Oversee MSP events, including partner conferences, advisory councils, tradeshows and regional activations, alongside digital, social, content and third-party media programs for lead generation.
  • Own marketing performance and ROI using Salesforce, Marketo and Tableau. Report on pipeline, acquisition, growth, engagement and retention, and work with sales and BDR teams to adjust investment.

What You'll Bring


  • Experience leading global partner or channel marketing teams, managing multi-region budgets and agencies, and owning strategy through regional execution.
  • Experience marketing to MSPs or other channel partners, including recruitment and retention programs, ideally in cybersecurity or SaaS.
  • Broad marketing expertise in IT, software or SaaS, with the ability to independently set channel marketing strategy, allocate investment and lead complex programs across regions.
  • A track record of demand generation and campaigns that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Experience building partner enablement and co-marketing programs at scale.
  • The ability to work in a matrix organization and influence senior global and regional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills, with experience engaging senior leaders and partners.
  • An analytical approach to marketing performance and ROI, and the initiative to manage multiple priorities across regions and time zones.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in marketing, communication or a related field.

The base salary range for this position is $156,000−$234,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.


Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations due to a disability, or any other reason that may help you in your interview process, please let us know by emailing .

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.

Who is Prescryptive?
Prescryptive is the healthcare technology company enabling the direct access marketplace for prescription drugs. Our platform aligns incentives so affordability, choice, and patient access become the natural outcome of a functioning system. Learn more about us by following us on LinkedIn or visiting Prescryptive.com.


About this role
This is a hands-on technical role for a PBM data integration expert who also owns program delivery. You’ll profile, map, and validate claims, eligibility, and accumulator data, design integration architecture with engineering, and be accountable for the timelines, risks, and vendor dependencies that come with it. You’ll stay close to the data yourself: writing SQL, resolving discrepancies, and troubleshooting production issues, while directing the teams who do much of the day-to-day work.


What you will do

  • Profile, map, and validate complex claims, eligibility, accumulator, and encounter data across multiple sources, and resolve daily eligibility and accumulator discrepancies arising from file imports and monthly reconciliations.
  • Write and execute advanced SQL for investigation, validation, regression testing, and special data loads.
  • Lead cross-functional root-cause investigation and remediation of production issues, and anticipate system and data failures before they happen.
  • Partner with engineering and architects on scalable, compliant integration architecture for claims, eligibility, and accumulators.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of benefit data integrations, including timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting.
  • Coordinate with external vendors and internal engineering, translating vendor data formats and constraints for engineering and vice versa.
  • Plan and coordinate integration testing, UAT, and implementation readiness, including data migration, rollback planning, and post-deployment support.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and maintain system documentation and operational procedures.

What you will bring (minimum requirements)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
  • At least 10 years of hands-on technical experience with data systems, SQL, and integrations.
  • At least 6 years of direct PBM or pharmacy claims processing experience, including deep knowledge of benefit configuration, adjudication logic, eligibility, and accumulator integrations.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex querying and data investigation.
  • Experience supporting eligibility and accumulator reconciliation processes.
  • Experience designing scalable data architecture for healthcare data systems.
  • Experience managing delivery timelines, risks, and dependencies, and coordinating integration testing and UAT.
  • Working knowledge of the ANSI/NCPDP Telecommunication Standard and PBM or TPA claims processing.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL, secure file transfer (SFTP/PGP), and job scheduling and alerting tools.

Ideally you will also have

  • Experience with a pharmacy benefits adjudication platform.
  • Cloud experience, ideally Microsoft Azure, in healthcare data environments.
  • Familiarity with C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, or R.

What we have to offer
• The opportunity to grow alongside an early-stage company shaking up a big, old-fashioned industry.
• Flexible time off, including 12 paid holidays.
• 401k match plus 100% employer-provided medical, dental, and vision premiums.
• Company contribution to Health Savings Account.

• Stock options.

Prescryptive is committed to fair pay practices. The projected annual salary range for this position is $148k - $205k. When preparing an offer, we also consider relevant experience, internal equity, and location.

Job Summary

IOTA Senior Transition Planner

Location: Remote with travel to Martinsburg, WV as needed Employment: Contingent Upon Contract Award Project: VA Martinsburg Warehouse IOTA Experience: Minimum 3 years of multi-phased transition planning and relocation experience

Aptive Resources is seeking an experienced IOTA Senior Transition Planner to support the planning and execution of facility transition and relocation activities for the VA Martinsburg Warehouse IOTA project.

The Senior Transition Planner will develop and coordinate detailed transition plans to ensure that personnel, equipment, furnishings, supplies, and operational functions are relocated and established in accordance with approved occupancy schedules.

This position requires direct experience managing complex, multi-phased facility transitions, developing departmental relocation plans, coordinating move sequences, and supporting operational readiness.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working across multiple departments and coordinating with facility operations, logistics, engineering, acquisition, and project leadership.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive facility transition and relocation plans.
  • Establish occupancy milestones, move schedules, and transition sequencing.
  • Coordinate transition activities across multiple departments and operational functions.
  • Develop detailed departmental move plans identifying responsibilities, timelines, resources, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate relocation requirements for personnel, equipment, furnishings, and supplies.
  • Identify transition risks, operational constraints, and potential disruptions.
  • Support advance planning and preparation activities required before occupancy.
  • Coordinate with facility leadership, logistics personnel, vendors, and installation teams.
  • Track transition milestones and resolve scheduling or resource conflicts.
  • Support move execution, facility readiness assessments, and post-move issue resolution.
  • Maintain transition documentation, action-item logs, and readiness reports.
  • Coordinate with the Activation Project Manager to ensure relocation activities align with overall project schedules.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in transition planning and relocation services on multi-phased projects.
  • Demonstrated experience in:
  • Conceptual advance planning.
  • Identifying occupancy milestones.
  • Detailed implementation planning and move sequencing.
  • Preparation and setup.
  • Developing detailed move plans for each impacted department.
  • Relocation execution.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting VA or other federal facility relocations.
  • Experience with healthcare, warehouse, logistics, or administrative facility transitions.
  • Experience coordinating multi-department relocations.
  • Experience with equipment and furniture relocation, installation, and readiness.
  • Familiarity with project scheduling and transition management tools.
  • Experience developing occupancy readiness checklists and transition risk assessments.
  • Strong stakeholder coordination and problem-solving skills.

Physical Requirements

The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Job Summary

The Senior Director of Partner Management is responsible for developing and executing strategies to enhance partner relationships, driving mutual business growth and aligning with organizational objectives. This role involves leading and mentoring the partner management team, overseeing partner agreements, and integrating partner solutions to enhance market competitiveness. The ideal candidate will establish strong relationships with key partners, pursue new partnership opportunities, and provide strategic insights to senior leadership for informed decision-making.

Role Description

  • Develop and execute strategies to enhance partner relationships and drive mutual business growth, aligning with organizational objectives and market trends.

  • Lead and mentor the partner management team, fostering a high-performance culture and ensuring alignment with the company’s values and goals.

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with key partners, facilitating effective communication and collaboration to achieve shared objectives.

  • Oversee the negotiation and management of partner agreements, ensuring mutually beneficial terms and compliance with organizational policies.

  • Monitor partner performance and conduct regular reviews to ensure alignment with strategic goals and optimize partner contributions.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate partner solutions into the company’s offerings, enhancing value propositions and market competitiveness.

  • Identify and pursue new partnership opportunities, leveraging market insights to expand the partner ecosystem and drive business growth.

  • Develop and implement partner training and enablement programs to ensure partners are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills.

  • Provide strategic input on partner-related marketing and promotional activities, aligning efforts with overall business objectives.

  • Prepare and present reports on partnership performance and initiatives to senior leadership, providing insights and recommendations for strategic decision-making.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Leadership: Can lead strategic team initiatives, inspire others to take leadership roles, and foster a culture of shared responsibility and continuous improvement.

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, drive organizational transformation, and adapt strategies to changing market conditions.

  • Business Acumen: Can provide strategic guidance and insights to drive overall business success.

  • Communication: Can lead and model exceptional communication at all levels of the organization, develop and implement communication strategies, and coach others to improve their communication skills.

  • Collaboration: Can lead complex team projects, inspire others to collaborate effectively, and foster a culture of mutual respect and shared purpose.

  • Relationship Building: Can lead strategic collaborations, inspire others to build relationships, and foster a culture of teamwork and mutual respect.

  • Negotiation: Can lead strategic negotiations, inspire others to develop negotiation skills, and foster a culture of constructive dialogue and compromise.

  • Results Orientation: Can inspire a culture of results-orientation across the organization, setting high standards and holding everyone accountable for achieving results.

  • Adaptability: Can drive strategic transformations, inspire others to embrace change, and foster a culture of continuous adaptation.

  • Problem-Solving: Can lead strategic problem-solving initiatives, inspire others to improve their problem-solving skills, and foster a culture of proactive problem-solving.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Understanding of IT industry trends and dynamics, ensuring continuous learning and staying ahead of market shifts – Expert

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain effective relationships with business partners, ensuring collaborative success and strategic alignment – Expert

  • Expertise in managing partner accounts, ensuring satisfaction and alignment with business objectives – Expert

  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, and board members, which is essential for fostering collaboration and ensuring organizational alignment – Expert

  • Skilled in strategic planning and implementation, aligning with the responsibility of developing and implementing strategic plans to achieve organizational goals – Expert

Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor's Degree in Business or a related field, or relevant work experience required

  • 10+ years of experience in Sales, Information Technology, or a relevant functional area

  • 5+ years of experience in a management position

  • Ability to travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer Events

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client. This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
  • Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
  • Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
  • Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
  • Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
  • Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
  • Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
  • Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
  • Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
  • An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
  • Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
  • Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
  • Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
  • Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
  • Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving how we sell by bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers multiple distinct opportunities to help shape this journey while building your own expertise as a technology-focused seller. This is an opportunity to be part of meaningful change - help define how we engage, advise, and support customers as their technology needs become more complex. If you are energized by building trusted relationships, shaping a more consultative customer experience, and making a visible impact as our sales approach evolves, this role offers the chance to help lead that change.

As an Account Director Senior Large Enterprise, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the Account Director Senior, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a self-directed strategy for a portfolio of large, important, or global accounts, grounded in each customer’s business model, financial priorities, operating risks, technology estate, market context, and competitive position.
  • Anticipate needs before they become formal requirements; develop points of view and use cases that connect modernization to growth, efficiency, resilience, risk reduction, and innovation.
  • Build qualified pipeline through executive relationships, account intelligence, focused prospecting, partners, marketing, and business development.
  • Prioritize investments and resources based on customer potential, solution fit, buying signals, competitive dynamics, and revenue opportunity.
  • Lead discovery across executive, business, technical, operational, and financial stakeholders to define the problem, value at stake, decision path, and urgency to act.
  • Integrate relevant capabilities across Lumen and its partners into a coherent outcome; direct architects and specialists through clear commercial and customer objectives while they own technical design and validation.
  • Build quantified business cases covering expected value, investment, implementation requirements, risk, and cost of inaction.
  • Develop customers’ and colleagues’ understanding of business, market, and solution tradeoffs; influence executive sponsors, economic buyers, technical decision makers, and internal champions.
  • Own new-logo acquisition and expansion against assigned sales, revenue, and consumption goals.
  • Lead complex, high-value sales cycles through qualification, validation, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal review, and close.
  • Exercise substantial commercial discretion—and, within company governance, full authority to shape and negotiate product, service, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Establish mutual action plans, decision criteria, stakeholder commitments, milestones, and activation dates; surface risks and dependencies early.
  • Plan and manage the account resource model, mobilizing sales, technical, delivery, customer success, channel, and partner teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Retain commercial ownership through implementation and activation; hold downstream partners accountable for customer readiness, delivery commitments, adoption, and value realization.
  • Use consumption data and customer signals to remove adoption barriers, address underutilization, anticipate revenue risk, and identify expansion across workloads, locations, and business units.
  • Convert demonstrated value into modernization, additional use cases, broader executive relationships, recurring revenue, and sustained growth.
  • Serve as a recognized expert across business, financial, market, customer, and portfolio domains; coach peers and contribute account insight that improves sales approaches and solution fit.
  • Activate channel and technology partners through joint targeting, account planning, and selling, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Use AI, agents, and automated workflows to improve research, prioritization, outreach, follow-through, and opportunity management; validate outputs and apply sound judgment.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, stakeholder maps, next steps, forecasts, and CRM records.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience and sustained quota achievement, with evidence of performance at the scope and complexity described above.
  • Success acquiring and expanding large, important, or global enterprise accounts and closing complex deals with multimillion-dollar total contract value.
  • Broad expertise across customer business and financial drivers, enterprise technology markets, complex buying environments, and relevant solutions such as networking, cloud, security, managed services, or enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated authority and judgment in structuring and negotiating complex product, service, pricing, and contract terms with senior customer leaders.
  • Technical fluency to lead credible discovery, recognize solution opportunities, and direct architects and specialists effectively.
  • Experience planning account strategy independently and orchestrating colleagues and partners across the full customer lifecycle without formal authority.
  • Understanding of recurring-revenue and consumption-based models, including how activation, adoption, and usage create customer value and revenue growth.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation to improve sales execution, with disciplined validation of outputs.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and an ownership mindset; you make decisions, surface risk early, give direct feedback, and take responsibility for outcomes.

Position Purpose: Oversees the care plans and care management activities of member needs primarily focused on behavioral health needs (including behavioral health, and social needs) to provide quality, cost-effective healthcare. Reviews and provides expert knowledge to inform personalized care plans for the most complex care members and provides guidance and/or support to the care management team.

  • Oversees and reviews ongoing care plans/service plans, which may include which may include behavioral health and social determinant needs and works with care management team to identify providers, specialists, and community resources needed for care
  • May perform telephonic, digital, home and/or other site visits outreach to assess member needs and collaborate with resources
  • Provides insight and guidance on developing care plans and triaging issues to appropriate behavioral healthcare providers for complex care plans/service plans for members with high level acuity
  • Provides guidance and expert knowledge as appropriate to healthcare management team members (including behavioral) to ensure quality control over work, ensure identified services are accessible to members, and adherence to contract policies and procedures
  • Monitors the most complex care plans and/or member status and outcomes for changes in treatment side effects, complications and clinical symptoms and revises care plan/service based on member needs and issues identified including mental health and substance use disorders

  • Monitors management policies and procedures within the care management team to ensure compliance with corporate, state, and National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) standards

  • Works as a subject matter expert (SME) and provides training and education to care management team and providers to ensure members are receiving high quality care and information regarding service / care plan options, procedures, referrals, and healthcare benefits, which may include behavioral health and social determinant needs

Overview

The Senior Technical Trainer is responsible for leading complex training initiatives across WMS implementations and system transformations. This role assists the manager of training with the design of scalable training programs, mentors other trainers, and ensures training strategies align with operational and program objectives. The Senior Technical Trainer also assists with training governance, evaluates training effectiveness, and partners with leadership to improve system adoption across the network.

Responsibilities

Training Strategy & Program Leadership

  • Lead training for large or complex WMS implementations

  • Supports in defining training frameworks, standards, and methodologies

  • Assists with establishment of scalable training models such as train-the-trainer or superuser programs

  • Determines utilization and validates documentation through testing systems.

  • Align training plans with project timelines and operational readiness goals

Complex Implementation Training

  • Own training for multi-site implementations or complex implementations

  • Serve as the primary training lead for major system rollouts or process transformations

  • Partner with program leadership to ensure training readiness before go-live

  • Identify training risks and mitigation strategies

  • Technical Writing: Develop SOPs, work instructions, and other documentation.

  • Report training metrics related to systems training, such as satisfaction, completion rates, learner retention.

Advanced Content Development

  • Assists with

    • Designing structured WMS training programs and learning paths for various operational roles

    • Standardize training documentation, templates, and delivery approaches

  • Drive improvements in training tools, simulations, and digital learning assets

Training Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish metrics to measure training success (e.g., adoption, process adherence, operational impact)

  • Evaluate training outcomes using frameworks such as the Kirkpatrick Model

  • Implement continuous improvement initiatives to improve training quality and effectiveness

  • Support with training and qualifying super-users in the field.

  • Maintain and continuously improve the training program and resources.

  • Maintains technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing publications.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor and guide Technical Trainers in training development and delivery

  • Review training materials for quality and consistency

  • Provide coaching on facilitation techniques and operational training approaches

Process Governance & Operational Excellence

  • Lead process audits during go-live and stabilization phases

  • Identify systemic process gaps impacting WMS adoption

  • Partner with operations and Superuser teams to drive process improvements

  • Provide reporting on training readiness and adoption

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, adult learning experience or similar degree required.
  • 7--10 years of experience in warehouse operations, WMS, or supply chain systems training
  • Strong understanding of warehouse processes (receiving, putaway, picking, packing, shipping, inventory)
  • Demonstrates strong facilitation skills, both in the classroom and virtual environments.
  • Demonstrates intermediate skills in all phases of instructional design/delivery (ADDIE). Demonstrates working knowledge of e-learning development software and learning management systems.
  • Ability to manage time, projects, and priorities.
  • Has a high level of attention to detail, quality, and customer focus.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, experience in communicating effectively with a diverse group of individuals.
  • Ability to travel up to 75% to warehouse sites during implementations

raw.description:
Location: US Remote
Reports to: VP, Marketing Operations

Role Overview

Nasuni is looking for a Senior Manager, Marketing Operations (PMO) to build and scale the operating system that turns marketing strategy into predictable execution.

You will own the Marketing PMO function, creating the planning rhythms, governance, work-management infrastructure, and cross-functional processes that help our marketing organization prioritize effectively, execute consistently, and adapt quickly as the business grows.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has built or significantly evolved a PMO, centralized planning function, or comparable operating model—not simply managed projects within an established system.

You will also lead complex strategic programs spanning Marketing, IT, Sales Operations, Finance, and other business functions, including acquisition integrations and transformation initiatives.

This role reports to the VP of Marketing Operations and works closely with functional marketing leaders and executive stakeholders.

Level & Scope

You will independently own the Marketing PMO operating model while partnering with the VP of Marketing Operations on strategic direction and priorities.

You will have autonomy to diagnose execution challenges, design governance and planning mechanisms, establish operating cadences, improve workflows, and drive adoption across teams where you may have influence but no direct authority.

The role combines operating-model design with hands-on execution. You will build the system and also lead it until the system can operate predictably at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and continuously improve Marketing’s integrated planning and operating cadence, including sprint planning, business reviews, quarterly planning, and cross-functional execution management.
  • Build scalable PMO governance that improves prioritization, accountability, handoffs, visibility, and delivery predictability across marketing functions.
  • Own and optimize Smartsheet as Marketing’s primary work-management environment, including workspace architecture, dashboards, templates, automations, and executive visibility.
  • Lead complex strategic programs spanning multiple functions, including acquisition integrations, business transformation initiatives, systems projects, and other leadership priorities.
  • Design and improve Marketing’s request and intake processes, establishing clear standards for prioritization, briefs, routing, ownership, and service expectations.
  • Identify execution risks, dependencies, and blockers early and work across functions to resolve them without relying on executive escalation.
  • Establish meaningful operating metrics, including delivery performance, governance adoption, backlog health, milestone completion, and planning predictability.
  • Partner with the VP of Marketing Operations to evolve PMO capabilities and build repeatable approaches for future integrations and transformation programs.
  • Apply AI-enabled tools to improve appropriate operational workflows such as planning, project synthesis, reporting, analysis, and workflow automation while maintaining validation, data awareness, and human accountability.

What Success Looks Like

In your first several months, you will take independent ownership of core planning and sprint cadences, establish a reliable source of truth for project execution, strengthen intake governance, and create structured workplans for priority strategic initiatives.

Over time, the Marketing Rhythm of Business should operate predictably without VP-level facilitation. Teams should experience the PMO as a function that creates clarity and makes execution easier—not as an additional layer of bureaucracy.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Demonstrated experience building, establishing, or substantially evolving a PMO, centralized planning function, or comparable operating model.
  • Experience leading complex programs across multiple business functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Strong enterprise work-management platform expertise, including advanced use of Smartsheet or comparable platforms involving dashboards, automation, templates, governance, and scalable workspace design.
  • Demonstrated ability to design operating processes that improve accountability, adoption, and execution—not simply administer existing processes.
  • Strong influence and stakeholder-management skills with experience working across functional and leadership boundaries.
  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve professional workflows, with clear methods for validating outputs and maintaining human accountability.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, cloud infrastructure, or another complex, high-growth environment.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or comparable project/program management certification.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, SharePoint, and Slack.
  • Experience with marketing budget governance or financial forecasting.

Ideal

  • Experience building a Marketing PMO or integrated marketing planning function from the ground up.
  • Experience supporting M&A integration or other significant cross-organizational transformation programs.
  • Advanced Smartsheet architecture and automation expertise.
  • Evidence of creating repeatable AI-enabled operational workflows that improve speed, quality, visibility, or decision-making.

Experience Guidelines

Candidates will typically bring 8+ years of relevant professional experience, including meaningful experience in program management, PMO, marketing operations, business operations, or a related discipline.

Scope and ownership matter more than tenure. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate what they personally built, the organizational problem it solved, how they drove adoption, and the measurable impact it produced.

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits.

As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform that provides a secure and governed foundation for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.

Why Work at Nasuni

This role offers the opportunity to build an operating capability at a meaningful point in Nasuni’s growth. You’ll work across Marketing and the broader business on initiatives that directly affect how strategy becomes execution—including transformation programs, acquisition integration, and AI-enabled ways of working.

Nasuni supports a US Remote work model, with our Boston-area presence available for optional in-person collaboration. You’ll work with teams operating at the intersection of cloud, AI, enterprise data infrastructure, and business transformation while helping create the operating discipline needed to scale.

Why work at Nasuni?

As part of our commitment to your well-being, we are pleased to offer comprehensive benefits packages to employees across the US. Benefits packages generally include:

•Best in class employee onboarding and training
•"Take What You Need” paid time off policy
•Comprehensive health, dental and vision plans
•Company-paid life and disability insurance
•401(k) and Roth IRA retirement plan
•Generous employee referral bonuses
•Flexible remote work policy
•10 Paid Holidays
•Wide array of wellbeing offerings
•Pre-tax savings accounts with company contributions
•Great team culture and social activities
•Collaborative workspaces
•Free on-site fitness centers and stocked kitchens in select office locations
•Professional development resources
Compensation Transparency:In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Nasuni is committed to providing visibility into compensation for all U.S.-based roles. Click HERE to view our compensation ranges by job grade. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including a candidate’s experience, skills, education, and work location.

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Nasuni is an equal opportunity employer. The equal employment opportunity policy at Nasuni protects employees and job applicants from discrimination on the bases of race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors. These protections extend to all management practices and decisions, including recruitment and hiring practices, appraisal systems, promotions, and training and career development programs.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager partners with our larger midsize and regional customers to secure their entire digital experience.

You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment and navigate complex, matrixed organisations to connect customers with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.


Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • You will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and sell Palo Alto Networks Products and Solutions through Channel Partners and by interacting directly with customers in your region to consistently achieve and exceed regional revenue targets
  • You will own and develop a diverse set of customers in a selected set of complex accounts, focusing on long-term value creation.
  • Leverage consultative selling experience will help you identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and existing customers, architecting comprehensive cybersecurity transformation across network, cloud and SOC environments
  • Lead multi-threaded sales engagements involving senior executive stakeholders, technical buyers, and procurement teams, to navigate enterprise purchasing complexities and secure large-scale, multi year deployments.
  • Master the competitive landscape, trends, and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions.

  • Build and leverage C-level relationships (CIO, CISO, CSO, and equivalent) to establish Palo Alto Networks as a trusted strategic partner.

  • You will collaborate with the specialist sales teams driving cross-platform adoption and ensure the best solution for our customers and prospects.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry.
  • Experience selling into mid-size and large enterprises, typically with multi-billion-dollar revenue and global or multi-regional operations.
  • Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques.
  • Proven ability to manage high-value accounts with extended sales cycles while operating in a high-variance environment.
  • Comfort managing accounts of different sizes, deal complexity, and sales readiness; deals may range from mid-market cycles to six & seven-figure, enterprise-scale opportunities.
  • Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems.
  • Cultivated relationships with our channel partners to bring a channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers.
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes, including legal, security, and commercial negotiations.
  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process.
  • Experience collaborating closely with a specialist sales organization to position the complete portfolio with prospects and customers.
  • Excellent time management skills and a history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets in a regional sales environment.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Architect – Security, responsible for working with stakeholders, both leadership and subject matter experts, to build a holistic view of the organization’s security architecture, controls, and risk posture. This individual will utilize knowledge and experience to link the business mission, strategy, and processes of the organization to a secure-by-design IT strategy, and document this utilizing multiple architectural models or views that show how the current and future needs of the organization will be met in an efficient, sustainable, agile, adaptable, and secure manner. A central focus of this role is embedding security into architecture decisions across SCA’s hybrid, partner-driven environment and serving as the authoritative security voice at the Architecture Review Board. Because SCA maintains its own identity boundary with no federation to its Optum/UHG parent, this role treats identity as the primary control plane and delivers secure access through a Zero Trust, Zscaler-anchored model.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop, maintain, promote, and evangelize an enterprise view of the security architecture blueprint and roadmap for the organization
  • Align the security strategy, controls, and solutions with the Company’s business objectives and defined risk appetite
  • Serve as the authoritative security reviewer at the ARB/DRB, evaluating architectures for security fitness and recording the Security domain sign-off
  • Partner with the CISO organization to ensure architecture aligns with the NIST CSF-aligned security remediation framework, coordinating it with the EA-owned Technical Debt Management Framework
  • Establish and lead the threat modeling practice required by Optum for qualifying solution architectures — defining which architectures trigger a threat model, the method applied (e.g., STRIDE), and how threat-model findings are remediated and carried into the ARB security sign-off
  • Perform architecture risk assessments across initiatives, mapping mitigations to the design and reducing project risk
  • Provide strategic security consultation to assigned business customers in designing technology-based solutions, and identify enabling security technologies based on requirements
  • Design and publish security patterns and reference architectures spanning identity and access management, zero-trust, data protection, network segmentation, secrets management, and logging/detection
  • Own the enterprise identity and access management architecture as the primary control plane for Zero Trust — directory and identity services (Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory), authentication and federation standards (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM), Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless, and RBAC/ABAC authorization models
  • Architect identity governance and privileged access — joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle and automated provisioning/deprovisioning, access certification and entitlement reviews, and privileged access management (e.g., Entra Privileged Identity Management) with just-in-time, least-privilege elevation
  • Design cross-boundary, workforce, and partner identity for SCA’s separated identity model — Optum-issued contractor identities, B2B/guest access, and Citrix — where SCA and the Optum parent maintain distinct identity stores without federation; define workload and non-human identity patterns (service principals, managed identities, workload federation) and secrets management to eliminate long-lived credentials
  • Architect data protection for PHI and PII in the ASC context, including encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and masking/tokenization
  • Establish the Zero Trust network and secure-access architecture on the Zscaler SSE/SASE platform — Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) for identity- and posture-aware access to private applications, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) for secure web/egress and inline inspection, and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for monitoring — replacing implicit-trust VPN patterns and enforcing segmentation and ingress/egress controls
  • Extend the Zscaler platform into the broader control set where it fits — CASB and DLP for SaaS, posture control, and device-posture signals feeding Conditional Access — with clean integration to Entra ID, endpoint tooling, and logging/detection
  • Provide cloud and SaaS security architecture, in particular for Microsoft Azure, including landing-zone guardrails, policy-as-code, and shared-responsibility clarity
  • Map security controls to applicable frameworks (NIST CSF, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI) with ownership and an evidence approach
  • Guide vulnerability management and supply-chain security, including SBOM, patching, and security gates in the SDLC/CI-CD pipeline
  • Lead the security architecture review of third-party and vendor solutions, with particular rigor for Tier 1 PHI vendors
  • Monitor and manage security-related technical debt within the environment, coordinating remediation priority with the CISO framework
  • Contribute to the growth and maturity of the IT department through mentorship, knowledge transfer, and thought leadership by example
  • Articulate security architecture concepts, risk, and analytical findings to Executive Management, business leadership, software developers, and end users
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 8-10+ years of experience in security architecture and engineering, with the most recent role in an architect or technical leadership capacity
  • 2-5+ years of experience working in an architect or technical leadership capacity
  • Solid understanding of healthcare provider (ASC) security and compliance obligations (HIPAA, HITRUST), with the ability to provide a trusted voice at the decision-making table
  • Strong command of security frameworks and control catalogs: NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, HITRUST, SOC 2, and PCI DSS
  • Deep identity and access management expertise: directory and identity platforms (Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory), federation and authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM), Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless, and RBAC/ABAC authorization
  • Identity governance and privileged access experience: IGA lifecycle and provisioning, access certification and entitlement management, and PAM with just-in-time elevation (e.g., Entra Privileged Identity Management); experience with workforce/partner identity across separated, non-federated identity stores — including externally issued contractor identities, B2B/guest, and Citrix — is a strong plus
  • Thorough understanding of cloud security and governance, in particular Microsoft Azure (landing zones, guardrails, policy-as-code)
  • Data protection expertise: encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and masking/tokenization for PHI and PII
  • Strong network and boundary security background, including segmentation and zero-trust network access
  • Hands-on Zscaler experience across the SSE platform — Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) — designing zero-trust access to replace legacy VPN, with an understanding of how Zscaler integrates with identity (Entra ID) and device posture
  • Proficiency with threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and risk assessment methodologies as they relate to integration and software engineering
  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing a threat-modeling program — establishing trigger criteria, applying a recognized methodology (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA, or attack-tree analysis), and integrating findings into architecture governance — not just performing individual threat models
  • Experience with security logging, monitoring, and detection, including SIEM and SOC integration
  • Experience with vulnerability management, SBOM, and DevSecOps / secure SDLC practices, including CI/CD security gates
  • Knowledge of TOGAF and a security architecture framework such as SABSA required; certification preferred (CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, CCSP, SABSA, Microsoft SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator, Azure security certifications, or Zscaler certifications such as ZCCA/ZCCP)
  • Excellent conceptual and security design pattern skills irrespective of technology, and willingness to assume total ownership of security architecture from inception to delivery
  • Experience creating an effective framework and process model for establishing enterprise-wide security architecture
  • Ability and willingness to document security architecture, integrations, and dependencies for existing platforms and systems currently in use at SCA
  • Understanding and experience implementing the strategic alignment of business and security
  • Experience with third-party and vendor security risk management, particularly for Tier 1 PHI SaaS vendors
  • Demonstrated competency in communicating the value of security architecture to stakeholders and senior management
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to develop and conduct executive-level presentations
  • Ability to collaborate with various levels of individuals – both IT and business
  • Self-directed with the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines
  • Experience with Mergers & Acquisitions, in areas of security diligence and integration, is desirable.

About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details:

  • 3-month (rolling) contract outside of IR35
  • £500 to £600 per day
  • Fully remote

About the role:

We are looking for skilled engineers to join a new team that will deploy and maintain our established cross-domain system for a customer. The system uses an AMQP event-driven microservices architecture and extensively utilizes docker container services. As a team member, you will maintain a continuous deployment pipeline, work with feature delivery teams to promote component releases into production, and apply configuration management tools to ensure all deployments are consistent and correctly configured.

The system is designed to be highly observable and available. The team will use monitoring tools to verify that all components are meeting SLA/SLO requirements. If any problems are identified, the team will take preventive actions to minimize customer impact and restore service as quickly as possible.

This role is perfect for an experienced engineer who is comfortable working in a managed service environment and wants to gain more experience with best-of-breed DevOps tools and techniques.

Key Responsibilities of the DevOps Engineer:

  • Collaborate with Feature Development teams to promote new component versions into production as efficiently as possible.
  • Maintain the system to agreed service level and availability objectives using real-time monitoring tools and system generated metrics.
  • Instrumentation of new system metrics and alerts to pre-empt issues and improve performance.
  • Respond to monitoring alerts and customer incidents, taking preventative/remedial action to minimise customer impact.
  • Liaising with key customer stakeholders to schedule capability changes and capture new service requirements as they arise.
  • Apply automation techniques to reduce manual operations burden.

Skills & Experience Required:

  • Experience in infrastructure automation tools (CloudFormation, Terraform or Ansible)
  • Experience working with docker containers & container orchestration tools (such as Kubernetes, OpenShift or Docker Swarm)
  • Experience using and maintaining CI / CD tools (such as Jenkins or GitHub actions)
  • Good understanding of relational databases and SQL
  • Linux command line, administration and shell scripting
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, auto-scaling, performance tuning, troubleshooting and disaster recovery best practices
  • Working knowledge of network security protocols
  • Working knowledge of AWS
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as InfluxDB, Prometheus or Grafana

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience of working in a managed service environment
  • Experience using, developing with and maintaining cloud hosting services (ideally AWS EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda)
  • Experience of event-driven integration with MQ messaging (RabbitMQ or similar AMQP solution)
  • Knowledge of cross domain principles & technologies
  • Industry experience writing well-tested code in one of our platform languages (Java, Go, Python or similar)

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you

Further Information:

Due to the nature of the work and the sectors we support, any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of the relevant security screening and clearance process.

This role requires eligibility for [BPSS / SC / DV] clearance. As part of the vetting process, candidates must meet the UK Government's residency and right-to-work requirements associated with the required level of clearance.
