raw.description:
About Us

Zact is a Fintech innovator dedicated to a singular idea : Organizations need simpler expense and payment management systems that align the spending employee with finance and accounting while providing inherent guardrails and continuous reconciliation with financial systems.
Zact enables all parts of the company to Pay by the Rules.

About the Role

We are building out a dedicated Application Support function for our GCP-hosted, microservices-based commercial card and payments platform. This mid-level analyst is the second US seat on the team, working alongside a Lead Application Support Engineer who anchors the function.

You will handle tier-1 and tier-2 support tickets independently, investigate issues across GCP logs and MySQL data, and be a reliable presence during US banking hours for our bank clients. This is a hands-on investigation role — you will spend real time in log consoles and query interfaces, not just routing tickets.

Location

  • Zact is a global company with multiple locations across US, Europe and India.
  • We provide 100% Remote Working Option.
  • Candidates applying for this role should be located in India;

What You’ll Do

Day-to-Day Ticket Handling

  • Own the Zendesk ticket queue during US hours — triage incoming issues by severity, respond within SLA, and resolve or escalate with full documentation
  • Handle known incident types independently using the team’s runbook library — no need to escalate for established patterns
  • Be the first US contact for bank client technical queries — acknowledge promptly, investigate thoroughly, communicate clearly
  • Cover the queue when the Lead is occupied with complex incidents, client escalations, or tooling work

Investigation & Triage

  • Search and filter GCP Cloud Logging to find error entries, trace requests across microservice boundaries using correlation IDs, and identify where failures occur in the service chain
  • Write MySQL SELECT queries against production read replicas to investigate transaction status, card data, account records, and settlement details
  • Escalate to the Lead with a structured handoff — logs reviewed, queries run, hypothesis formed, nothing left vague
  • For P1/P0 incidents, join the Lead immediately — contribute to the investigation rather than waiting for direction

Monitoring & Alerting

  • Check GCP monitoring dashboards and Zendesk alert channels at shift start — surface anything anomalous before clients report it
  • Track open incidents across shifts and ensure clean handoff to the team at end of US day
  • Flag alert noise or misconfigured thresholds to the Lead — you are on the front line and will notice signal problems first

Client Communication

  • Write clear, professional, jargon-free updates to banking client operations teams during and after incidents
  • Follow up on resolved tickets — confirm the fix, provide a plain-language explanation, close cleanly
  • Maintain a professional tone under pressure; bank clients operate in regulated, audit-sensitive environments

Documentation & Knowledge base

  • Document every new issue investigated — symptom, logs found, queries run, resolution or escalation path
  • Contribute to and improve runbook entries after resolving incidents
  • Build and share a personal MySQL query library for common investigation patterns

Technology Environment

  • Cloud platform: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Logs & monitoring: GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring — primary investigation tools
  • Database: MySQL — read-only investigation queries (SELECT only; strict change-control for anything else)
  • Architecture: Microservices — REST APIs; tracing requests across services using correlation IDs
  • Ticketing: Zendesk — managing your queue, documenting investigations, client communication
  • Scripting: Python / Bash — desirable; the Lead will help you grow here if needed
  • Product domain: Commercial card programs — card issuance, payments authorization, settlement, spend controls
  • Client environment: US community and regional banks — SLA-bound, audit-sensitive, regulated

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years in application support, technical support, IT operations, or a closely related role
  • Solid SQL — you write SELECT queries with JOINs, subqueries, and WHERE clauses without needing a template; you read query results and know what to look for
  • GCP Cloud Logging or equivalent — you have used at least one cloud log platform (CloudWatch, Splunk, Kibana, Datadog, or GCP) to investigate a real production issue
  • Familiarity with microservice concepts — you understand that a user action may touch multiple backend services and know how to trace a request across them
  • REST API literacy — HTTP status codes, reading API responses, identifying where in a request chain an error originated
  • Methodical troubleshooting — you rule out possibilities systematically and document as you go
  • Clear written communication — you can write a calm, professional client-facing update mid-incident
  • Change-control discipline — you never modify production data without explicit authorization

Nice to Have

  • GCP-specific experience — Cloud Logging query syntax (Log Explorer), Cloud Monitoring dashboard navigation
  • Familiarity with Zendesk as a support platform — using ticket views, macros, and SLA tracking
  • Basic Python or Bash scripting — log parsing, simple automation, or one-off scripts count
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment — fintech, banking, healthcare, or telecoms
  • Exposure to commercial card or payments concepts — authorization flows, settlement, spend controls — helpful but fully trainable

Working Hours

  • Standard shift of 8–10 hours per day, US business hours (Eastern or Central preferred for bank client coverage)
  • ~2-hour overlap with India team at start of US day — used for handoff, standups, and any incidents in flight

Position Summary

In this role, you will serve as the primary administrator and owner of the identity governance platform, overseeing both operational execution of IAM processes and the ongoing maintenance, performance, and lifecycle management of identities using the SailPoint IdentityIQ (SailPoint) application.

Reporting to the Director of Cybersecurity, the successful candidate will lead IAM initiatives, manage access governance workflows, and act as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for SailPoint. Additionally, this position provides support to broader cybersecurity programs and incident response activities as necessary.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Identity Lifecycle Management

  • Manage end-to-end IAM activities, including user provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews/changes, and policy enforcement using SailPoint.
  • Maintain accurate identity records and ensure timely onboarding/offboarding of hospital staff and third-party users.

B. SailPoint Administration

  • Serve as the technical owner and administrator of the SailPoint platform.
  • Deliver user training and provide support to ensure efficient use of SailPoint.
  • Coordinate with vendors for issue resolution and product enhancements.

C. Access Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with internal security policies and external regulations (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS).
  • Conduct periodic access certifications.
  • Enforce principle of least privilege (PoLP) and need-to-know principle across identities.
  • Support audits by providing documentation and evidence of IAM controls.

D. Application Onboarding & RBAC

  • Lead onboarding new applications into SailPoint.
  • Develop and maintain role-based access control (RBAC) models and segregation of duties (SoD) rules.

E. Documentation & Process Management

  • Create and maintain technical documentation for SailPoint processes, integrations, and configurations.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements.

F. Collaboration & Incident Response

  • Work closely with IT and business units to resolve access issues.
  • Contribute to incident response efforts and assist with cyber threat analysis when required.

G. Operational Support

  • Occasionally, work extended hours, including weekends and holidays, to support IAM incidents or critical upgrades.

Establishing Relationships

Inspiring and Motivating Others

Fosters commitment and cohesiveness by facilitating cooperation and working as a team within the organization toward goal accomplishments. Work well with others, build consensus, and ensure cooperation to complete tasks and positive workflow.

Exercises self-leadership, self-awareness, and self-regulation; manages emotions so that they are expressed appropriately; leads others by showcasing adaptability, empathy, and social skills.

Acts in a way that is consistent with personal and organizational values by keeping confidence, promises, and commitments. raw.description:
About Us:

Ladder Health, an innovative virtual care platform built alongside clinicians at Boston Children's Hospital, serves as an end-to-end developmental partner for children (0-6 years old) with developmental delays. Ladder offers an alternative to waitlisted state-based programs or private pay practices, guiding families through our developmental screener, clinical evaluations, and comprehensive virtual care with specialized therapists (PT, OT, SLP). Our platform supports a coordinated care plan with resources, HIPAA-compliant messaging, and integration with pediatric care teams. Ladder partners with pediatricians and community organizations to improve access and quality of care for families.

About You:

  • Self-motivated pediatric Physical Therapist, ideally with telehealth experience, having worked in Early Intervention, school-based programs, or private practice
  • Experience working with children (0-6) and their caregivers
  • Up-to-date on evidence based practices and enthusiastic about use of technology to facilitate and augment care
  • Passionate about caregiver guided intervention, strengths-based framing and play as therapy, and the impact early intervention support can have on children
  • Flexible schedule to allow for convenient appointment times for busy families (e.g., some availability in early mornings and/or evening, and/or weekends)
  • License to practice in Massachusetts required
  • Bilingual professional capabilities (English & Spanish) is preferred

Responsibilities:

  • Perform virtual consult/evaluation appointments with children and their families and use clinical decision making to determine need for ongoing support. Thorough review of medical history, developmental concerns, and goals for seeking support.
  • Document clinically sound, personalized care plans and recommend therapy frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly)
  • Facilitate therapy appointments with child and their caregiver(s). Communicate clearly with caregivers and educate them on activities and exercises so they can work with their child at home.
  • Maintain up-to-date patient records including appointment summaries, progress monitoring, and other documentation
  • Utilize the platform to recommend exercises/activities that caregivers can apply in between appointments to work toward therapy goals
  • Work to improve the platform including review of developmental screener and associated escalation logic, expansion of exercises library, and other enhancements
  • Responsive to the messaging portal to answer questions from users on a predetermined cadence
  • Collaborate with other clinicians to ensure children and their families are receiving holistic care.

Benefits:

  • Chance to work at an innovative, early-stage digital health company, with room for growth and opportunities for advancement
  • Flexible hours with the ability to work part-time
  • Opportunity to mold a new care delivery model and help the access gap for children who need developmental services but are unable to receive them today
  • Hourly salary commensurate with experience

Important Security Notice:

Please be aware of recruitment scams. Representatives from Ladder Health will never conduct interviews purely via text/chat apps, nor will we ever ask for banking details, direct deposit info, or credit card numbers during the interview process. Official communications will only come from an @ladderhealth.co email address. If you suspect fraud, please report it to us directly.

Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client. This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
  • Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
  • Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
  • Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
  • Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
  • Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
  • Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
  • Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
  • Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
  • An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
  • Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
  • Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
  • Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
  • Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
  • Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

We are looking for an experienced Technical Artistto join the development of a mobile multiplayer shooter featuring a Battle Royale mode foriOS and Android.

In this role, you will focus on performance optimization, rendering, shaders, and asset efficiency to ensure stable performance and high visual quality across a wide range of mobile devices. You will work closely with artists and engineers, helping bridge art and technology, improve content pipelines, troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, and support the development team with technical and programming tasks.

We are looking for someone with strong Unity expertise, hands-on profiling and optimization experience, and a solid understanding of real-time rendering and mobile hardware constraints.

  • Experience with shaders programming languages such as HLSL, GLSL

  • Experience with Shader Graph in Unity engine.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex performance issues.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Experience optimizing games for a wide range of Android and iOS devices.

Nice to have:

  • Previous experience working on mobile shooters, multiplayer games, or Battle Royale projects.

  • Understanding of performance considerations specific to real-time multiplayer games.

  • Experience with GPU/CPU optimization, draw calls, batching, overdraw, memory usage, and mobile rendering constraints.

  • Experience optimizing VFX, shaders, animations, and 3D assets for mobile platforms.

Key Duties:

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in assets, shaders, and rendering.

Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well:

raw.description:
The Director, AI Platforms & Engineering defines and leads the organization’s enterprise AI platform strategy, architecture, and engineering capabilities. This role is accountable for the platforms, standards, and governance that enable the secure, reliable, and scalable development, deployment, and operation of AI solutions across the organization. Responsible for machine learning, agentic AI, and AI-enabled business intelligence platforms, the role provides a common AI foundation that supports innovation while maintaining security, compliance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

Own the multi-year strategy and reference architecture for the organization’s AI platforms, spanning the data platform, ML platform, agentic platform, and AI-enabled BI

Define how the ML and agentic platforms sit on top of the enterprise data platform, and how ML products support BI and agent use cases, to present a coherent platform and capabilities journey

Establish a scalable architecture for generative AI, AI agents, traditional machine learning, computer vision, and emerging AI technologies that preserves optionality across cloud providers, foundation models, and SaaS platforms

Set enterprise AI architecture standards, environment standards, tool/model selection guidelines, and reusable patterns in partnership with Enterprise Architecture

Establish clear decision frameworks for when the organization should build, buy, configure, or partner for AI capabilities

Own and evolve enterprise AI platforms, services, frameworks, and APIs that enable scalable AI development and operations, including model access, orchestration, knowledge retrieval, observability, identity, and security


Establish engineering standards for AI agents, intelligent workflows, APIs, and embedded AI experiences

Drive disciplined software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD, versioning, release management, and production support

Establish enterprise lifecycle management for predictive models, generative AI applications, and autonomous or semi-autonomous agents

Translate organization’s AI governance policies into practical technical controls embedded within the platform

In partnership with various stakeholders, ensure platform-hosted solutions are governed, permissions-aware, and auditable, and meet requirements for healthcare data, consumer information, and intellectual property

Implement platform-level safety controls proportionate to risk

Establish production standards and service-level expectations for enterprise AI capabilities, and own operational reliability, availability, and performance

Forecast and manage platform consumption and vendor commitments (e.g., Snowflake/Cortex, cloud, and model usage)

Establish clear roles, decision rights, performance expectations, development plans, and succession readiness; align replacement and future hiring to evolving organizational needs

Develop annual and quarterly operating plans covering priorities, capacity, staffing, funding, vendor needs, technology consumption, and anticipated outcomes

Job Specifications

Typically has the following skills or abilities:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; advanced degree preferred; Minimum of 2 additional years of experience related to functional area

Minimum of 6 years of management experience with responsibilities for hiring, training, assigning work, and managing performance of direct reports

Experience across software, data, or machine-learning engineering, cloud platforms, or related disciplines, including building and operating production platforms

Demonstrated experience taking machine learning or generative AI capabilities into production at enterprise scale, with strong understanding of modern GenAI architectures, foundation models, RAG, AI agents, and vector technologies

Experience delivering and operating cloud data and AI platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure) and modern tooling including LLM stacks, orchestration frameworks, MLOps/LLMOps, CI/CD, APIs, and observability

Proven ability to define enterprise architecture standards, reusable platform services, and a federated enablement model adopted across multiple teams

Strong grounding in responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance for regulated environments (e.g., healthcare or financial services), including auditability and access control

Experience managing platform budgets, strategic vendor commitments, and consumption/FinOps for scaled technology or AI environments

Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical tradeoffs into clear priorities and delivered outcomes

For roles that are remote (i.e., Work From Home (WFH)) or hybrid (i.e., partial onsite at a VSP location and WFH), must demonstrate a high level of engagement in virtual environments, including maintaining camera presence during meetings to support effective communication and team alignment

raw.excerpt: Position OverviewPower your future with Qualus as a Principal Protection and Control Engineer, to join our well-established Protection & Control team of engineers and designers in Canada, in our Transmission & Distribution Canada business.
raw.description:
Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus as a Principal Protection and Control Engineer, to join our well-established Protection & Control team of engineers and designers in Canada, in our Transmission & Distribution Canada business. This role offers long-term workload stability, exposure to a diverse portfolio of projects, and the opportunity to provide technical leadership across utility and renewable energy clients.

You will work on projects ranging from 12 kV to 500 kV, supporting designs from early concept through construction and commissioning. This opportunity is ideal for a principal engineer who enjoys technical ownership, mentoring others, and solving complex system-level challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the Qualus’ Protection & Control Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing technical governance across multiple projects and programs
  • Set and uphold protection, control, and metering philosophy, standards, and best practices for high voltage substations
  • Serve as Principal Engineer or Technical Authority on complex, high risk, or non standard projects, providing final technical approval and direction
  • Provide review and approval of: -Protection planning, philosophy, and application documents-One-lines, schematics, logic diagrams, panel layouts, and wiring diagrams
  • Oversee protection coordination studies and relay settings for utility transmission systems, including review and validation of work performed by others
  • Chair or participate in senior-level design reviews, hazard and risk assessments, and near miss investigations
  • Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), Site Acceptance Tests (SATs), and critical field inspections for complex installations
  • Advise project teams on construction sequencing, outage planning, and commissioning strategy
  • Participate in client technical, Safety by Design, and constructability review meetings
  • Provide technical oversight for project scopes, feasibility studies, cost estimates, and definition-phase deliverables, including review of assumptions and risks
  • Support Business Development by contributing technical strategy, execution approaches, and risk assessments for proposals and pursuits
  • Act as a primary technical escalation point for clients, internal teams, and external partners
  • Mentor senior and junior engineers, and play a key role in the continuous improvement of P&C standards, tools, and engineering practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • 20+ years of utility-focused protection, control, and metering engineering experience, with demonstrated system-level responsibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Canada, or eligibility to obtain (U.S. PE considered an asset)
  • Recognized expertise in substation protection philosophy, including transmission line, transformer, bus, and feeder protection
  • Extensive experience reviewing and approving detailed P&C design drawings and technical deliverables
  • Experience performing protection coordination studies and relay settings for high-voltage transmission systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of protection software and platforms such as ASPEN, CAPE, EasyPower, SKM, and SEL / GE relay families
  • Practical experience with substation construction, commissioning, outage planning, and operational interfaces
  • Proven ability to provide technical judgment on non standard, complex, or first of kind applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience on EPC projects, and familiarity with utility maintenance and operational practices, are considered strong assets
  • Demonstrated capability to mentor

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

raw.title: Grants Associate
raw.excerpt: BackgroundThe African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent.
raw.description:
Background

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives.

Purpose

The Grants Associate is a member of the Grants team, supporting and coordinating grants and contracts administration processes with a focus on compliance and data management. Reporting to the Senior Grants Manager, the Grants Associate ensures effective grant management processes and a high level of compliance and organisation for the ACF’s re-granting processes.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Grant application process

  • Participate and contribute to the continuous improvement of the ACF grant application process and grants cycles.
  • Produce high-quality minutes and trackers of the proposal review meetings decisions.
  • Send invitations for application via the grants management system to applicants approved for full application at the proposal review meeting.
  • Assist applicants to effectively access the online application process to complete and submit the application. Import received applications into the grants management system.
  • Conduct initial review of the applications to ensure all the required documents have been submitted and due diligence requirements met.
  • Follow up with applicants to address any due diligence or budget review comments.
  • Notify the relevant internal stakeholders for the next steps of the application review process.

Progress Reports

  • Coordinates and monitors completion of grant processes, in accordance with defined requirements.
  • Ensure internal approvals of all progress reports, deliverables and any related payments.
  • Follow up with partners to address any progress report review comments.
  • Communicate agreement amendment requirements and follow up for required documentation and approvals to facilitate amendment.
  • Ensure all grant requirements have been met and get final confirmation to send out close-out letters for grants and requests that are closed in the system.

Grants compliance

  • Ensure ongoing compliance by maintaining the grants management system and associated filing is kept up to date according to protocols.
  • Monitoring and tracking of all progress reports for active grants, consultancies and approved no-cost extensions.
  • Maintain and update progress report schedules and due dates within the grants management system.
  • Notify grantees of reporting due dates, disseminate reports to the relevant internal stakeholders for review and keep the record of reports received up to date.
  • Ensure application and due diligence documentation received are in accordance and in compliance with required standards.

Financial Management

  • Support the timely and accurate processing of all approved grants, consultancies, Service providers and sponsorships payments.
  • Monitor and track grantee, consultant, Service provider and sponsorship payments.
  • Communicate payment schedules internally.
  • Capture proof of payments in grants management system and send out the proof of payments to partners as soon as they are available.
  • Ensure accurate record-keeping of proof of payment for all grants, consultancies and sponsorships to support financial assurance and audit readiness.
  • Support Finance with annual audit preparation and provide information to auditors as required.

Knowledge management/ Grants Management System

  • With other Grants Associates, ensure grant- related folders are up to date and in line with ACF’s knowledge management protocols.
  • With other Grants Associates, ensure and maintain the accurate capture of reporting schedules, payment date for grant tranches within the grants management system.
  • Maintain complete, up-to-date, and consistent grant records across ACF’s systems (including GivingData, SharePoint and Teams), ensuring data integrity and audit readiness.
  • Serve as Super-User for the ACF Grants Management System (GivingData), troubleshooting support, and continuous improvement recommendations.
  • With the Grants Manager, coordinate system user onboarding and training, manage user access and profiles, and ensure appropriate system usage across teams.

Requirements include but are not limited to:

  • Minimum 3 years proven experience working in Grants Administration.
  • Experience working with non-profit organizations or in donor-funded environments.
  • Fully computer literate (Microsoft Office) with advanced Excel proficiency.
  • Experience with donor and grant making software advantageous (e.g GivingData).
  • Experience working collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to organize multiple tasks and manage deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are essential. Proficiency in French would be a strong advantage.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to foster positive working relationships.
  • Detail oriented and works with high levels of accuracy.
  • Team focused.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
  • High levels of integrity, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Coordinate with program staff on grantees correspondence, including clarifications, follow-ups and issue resolution, to ensure timely and consistent communication.
  • Providing other grant-related assistance as needed, coordination, and problem-solving.
  • Actively participate in weekly grant progress meetings providing portfolio status updates.

Start date: Position available immediately.

Contract duration: 12 months (renewable based on mutual agreement).

Location: ACF’s operational hub is in Cape Town, South Africa. Remote working will be considered for
candidates based in Nigeria, Senegal, Kenya and South Africa.

Closing date: 01 November 2026

Application Details:

  • Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where they are based.

For further information about the ACF, visit .

Should you not hear back from us by 31 December 2026, please consider your application to be unsuccessful.

The ACF strives to be an equitable organisation with a team which reflects the diversity of Africa.

In compliance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), The ACF assures all applicants that any personal information provided during the recruitment process will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and used solely for recruitment purposes. Your privacy and data security are of paramount importance to us. By applying for this position, you consent to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal information for recruitment-related activities only. The ACF is committed to safeguarding your privacy and maintaining the trust you place in us.

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to take ownership of designing, managing, andoptimizingscalable, reliable, and secure cloud infrastructure. This role is suited to a senior engineer who thrives in a fast-growing SaaS environment, enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, and can lead technical initiatives to support high-volume data processing at scale. You willbe responsible forensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of systems handling billions of tracking requests per day worldwide. You will work across cloud infrastructure, servers, networks, containers, databases, monitoring, and system architecture,identifyingbottlenecks,and implementing scalable solutions. The ideal candidate is an independent, analytical, and pragmatic engineer who can lead a team, drive infrastructure improvements, maximize uptime, and make sound technical decisions while collaborating closely with developers and other stakeholders.

    Design, manage, maintain, and optimize cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
    Lead and support a team of engineers, providing technical direction and driving infrastructure improvements.
    Identify and map the capacity limits of infrastructure components, including virtual machines, containers, databases, and networks.
    Develop and implement scalable solutions capable of handling billions of requests per day.
    Build, configure, and optimize monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to improve observability and incident detection.
    Maximize system uptime and ensure high availability, resilience, and redundancy across all layers of the architecture.
    Configure, maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot servers, networks, cloud environments, and applications.
    Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve infrastructure bottlenecks and performance issues.
    Secure infrastructure, data, and networks, ensuring business continuity and operational resilience.
    Advise and implement new technologies, infrastructure solutions, and architectural improvements.
    Collaborate with software developers to support application deployments and deliver infrastructure and software innovations.
    Establish and maintain infrastructure best practices, automation, and operational processes.
    Investigate system limitations and work with cloud providers or external systems to overcome capacity and scalability constraints.
    Take ownership of infrastructure initiatives, work independently, and drive continuous improvement in a fast-growing environment.
    Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related technical field.
    Extensive hands-on experience in a similar DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or cloud engineering role, preferably within a SaaS or data-driven organization.
    In-depth knowledge of modern DevOps tooling, infrastructure management, and automation.
    Practical experience with Kubernetes; this is considered a must
    Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Sentry, Grafana, or Loki.
    Strong understanding of server infrastructure, networking, containers, databases, and distributed systems.
    Experience designing and maintaining highly available, scalable, and resilient production environments.
    Knowledge of infrastructure security, redundancy, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
    Experience identifying infrastructure bottlenecks, troubleshooting complex production issues, and optimizing system performance.
    Proven ability to take ownership of technical projects, work independently, and make sound engineering decisions.
    Experience leading a team or providing technical leadership in an infrastructure or DevOps environment.
    Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
    A forward-thinking and innovative mindset, with a focus on continuous improvement.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply.
    Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving organization.

Informações adicionais

    Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) certification, or a willingness to obtain one.
    Experience scaling high-throughput systems and distributed infrastructure for substantial request volumes.
    Experience with cloud-native architectures, container orchestration, and infrastructure automation.
    Experience designing monitoring systems, defining service reliability objectives, and improving incident response.
    Experience working with external cloud providers and resolving infrastructure capacity constraints.
    Previous experience in a senior or team lead position within a growing SaaS or technology company.
    A proactive approach to mentoring colleagues, sharing knowledge, and improving engineering practices.

raw.description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit

What we are building

The Quality and Compliance team at Domino helps teams deliver AI software and solutions with the quality, validation, and supporting evidence that enterprise customers need. We are building repeatable ways to bring these requirements into delivery early and make readiness clear across teams.

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to own quality and validation readiness across complex programs. You will bring Engineering, Product, forward-deployed engineers, and Customer Success together around clear plans and decisions, and use AI and automation to reduce manual work as our programs grow.

What your impact will be

  • Drive quality and validation programs from scoping through readiness review, translating requirements into clear deliverables, owners, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate dependencies across Engineering, Product, FDEs, and Customer Success. Resolve blockers and give teams and leadership a clear view of progress, risks, and decisions needed.
  • Partner with engineering and quality stakeholders to align test coverage, validation evidence, and exception handling. Work with the release owner to incorporate readiness into release planning and decision-making.
  • Build repeatable workflows that surface quality and validation needs earlier, prevent recurring issues, and reduce coordination overhead. Define and improve measures of readiness, delivery predictability, and manual effort.
  • Use AI and automation in everyday program work. Partner with engineers to build and adopt workflows for evidence preparation, readiness checks, and reporting, with clear checks on accuracy and reliability.
  • Provide backup coverage for release managers as needed, coordinating release activities, tracking dependencies, and communicating status to keep releases moving during their absence.
  • Operate as a highly flexible and adaptable program manager across Engineering & Security when needed on specific cross-functional initiatives driven and agreed upon by the VP, Quality & Compliance, CISO, and/or Head of Engineering.

What we look for in this role

raw.description:
Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Position Title: MV Commissioning & Electrical Safety Manager
Department: LTSA Project Implementation and Services
Compensation: $120,000 - $160,000 + annual bonus
Reports To: Global Director, Service
Location: Canada

About the Role:

e-STORAGE is looking for an MV Commissioning & Electrical Safety Manager to lead a regional team of Senior Power Systems Technicians and oversee product-level commissioning across utility-scale battery energy storage projects in the Americas.

The role will support the safe commissioning, operation, and maintenance of SolBank systems, string inverters, MV Skids, and associated medium-voltage equipment. You will provide leadership around technician competency, MV switching and energization, isolation, grounding, LOTO, electrical safety procedures, and operational performance across Canada, the United States, and Latin America.

Responsibilities:

  • Directly manage a regional team of Senior Power Systems Technicians, including workload allocation, coaching, development, performance management, and technical support

  • Plan workforce and authorization coverage to ensure qualified personnel are available to support commissioning, preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and operational requirements

  • Assess technician competency for MV/HV and product commissioning work and provide recommendations regarding training, qualification, and authorization

  • Establish and monitor team performance indicators related to safety compliance, commissioning throughput, and maintenance turnaround

  • Act as the escalation point for technical, operational, and electrical safety matters raised by field technicians

  • Oversee product-level commissioning of SolBank systems, string inverters, MV Skids, and associated electrical equipment

  • Develop, implement, and improve product commissioning procedures, testing practices, documentation, and sign-off requirements

  • Support equipment testing, startup, troubleshooting, energization, and turnover activities

  • Coordinate with site commissioning teams, which retain responsibility for the broader commissioning programme, grid compliance and testing, and client handover

  • Oversee MV switching activities, typically up to 34.5kV, where e-STORAGE holds or has been delegated control-of-work responsibility

  • Support safe isolation, grounding, LOTO, energization, de-energization, and switching practices

  • Ensure compliance with applicable codes and standards, including CSA, NEC, IEEE, NFPA, OSHA, and local utility requirements

  • Ability to travel to project sites across the Americas as required, particularly during commissioning, energization, switching activities, and major operational milestones

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Extensive experience with medium-voltage electrical systems, typically up to 34.5kV, within utility-scale infrastructure, renewable energy, BESS, substations, power generation, or comparable environments

  • Demonstrated experience performing, supervising, or authorizing MV switching activities, including isolation, grounding, LOTO, energization, and safe work planning

  • Experience in commissioning and operational, maintenance, or field-service environments

  • Experience leading electrical technicians, commissioning personnel, field-service teams, or other technically qualified personnel

  • Strong understanding of North American electrical safety codes and standards, including CSA, NEC, IEEE, NFPA, OSHA, and local utility requirements

  • Experience supporting commissioning, energization, operations, maintenance, or field service activities for complex electrical systems

  • Experience developing or implementing electrical safety procedures, switching procedures, permits, risk assessments, method statements, or operating standards

  • Degree, diploma, trade qualification, or equivalent practical experience in electrical engineering, power systems, electrical technology, or a related field

e-STORAGE is Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

e-STORAGE uses AI-assisted tools during parts of the hiring process, including screening and workflow automation. All final hiring decisions are made by humans.

This is a current vacancy, and we are actively hiring for this position.

What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

  • Integrity: We do what’s right, always.

  • Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.

  • Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.

  • Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.

  • Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.

  • Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.

  • Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

  • The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.

  • Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.

  • A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

We Do Consulting Differently


The Integrated Health Solutions (IHS) practice at Berkeley Research Group (BRG) provides end-to-end advisory support to healthcare providers, payers, investors, and other stakeholders navigating complex strategic, operational, financial, and clinical challenges. Led by seasoned healthcare executives, operators, and clinicians, IHS partners with organizations to drive sustainable performance improvement and long-term growth through strategic growth design, operating model transformation, technology, AI, and digital enablement, clinical quality and patient care optimization, and revenue strategy—helping clients build resilient, future-ready healthcare enterprises in an increasingly complex environment.

 

Our five core service offerings include: 

  • Strategic Advisory
  • Revenue Management
  • Operational Excellence
  • Clinical & Quality Transformation
  • Technology, AI, & Digital Solutions

BRG Technology, AI, & Digital Solutions delivers analytics and technology solutions that improve decisions, automate manual processes, and scale performance across the enterprise. BRG supports financial, operational, and clinical use cases through advanced analytics, automation, dashboards, and responsible AI. We also assess AI readiness and help build the data, governance, and operating foundations needed to develop and scale high‑impact AI use cases.


Position Summary:

The Associate Director will lead client engagements from assessment and strategy through solution design, implementation, adoption, and benefit realization, applying deep expertise in a primary technology or transformation discipline and sound healthcare business judgment. Working with healthcare executives, operational leaders, clinicians, IT teams, and subject matter experts, the Associate Director will identify high-value opportunities, develop actionable business cases and roadmaps, and coordinate multidisciplinary teams across IHS and BRG to guide scalable solutions. Engagements may span AI and automation, digital solution performance, and IT efficiency and transformation. This position offers advancement opportunities within a growing expert services and consulting firm.


Travel Requirements:

Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50%, depending on project requirements and client expectations, is required.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead engagements or major workstreams, serving as a key client contact and managing scope, workplans, budgets, staffing, risks, dependencies, and deliverable quality.
  • Translate complex financial, operational, clinical, and technology challenges into clear recommendations, executable plans, and executive-level communications.
  • Coordinate IHS operational and clinical specialists, Analytics professionals, BRG AI specialists, client teams, and vendors to deliver integrated solutions with clearly defined responsibilities.
  • Manage multiple engagements while maintaining delivery standards, client relationships, and engagement financial performance.
  • Lead healthcare-focused AI and automation readiness assessments, evaluating workflows, data quality and accessibility, technology architecture, talent, governance, and organizational capacity for change.
  • Develop prioritized use-case portfolios, business cases, and implementation roadmaps based on value, feasibility, risk, strategic alignment, and readiness.
  • Design and help establish AI and Automation Centers of Excellence, including intake, prioritization, decision rights, delivery standards, resource planning, and performance monitoring.
  • Serve as a technical and strategic lead for solutions combining native enterprise-platform capabilities, robotic process automation, low-code/no-code tools, generative AI, and agentic workflows, selecting the approach best suited to the business problem.
  • Guide architecture, integration, development, testing, deployment, and support planning to create secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Establish appropriate quality controls, documentation, human oversight, exception handling, and monitoring in collaboration with AI, privacy, security, compliance, and clinical specialists.
  • Move successful pilots into reusable enterprise capabilities through standardized components, operating procedures, training, ownership, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Partner with IHS service lines to identify and implement technology-enabled improvements across revenue cycle and managed care, supply chain, workforce and shared services, patient access and ambulatory operations, and clinical and quality transformation.
  • Work with domain experts to map current workflows, address process and data deficiencies, and design future-state operations before introducing or expanding automation.
  • Align technology initiatives with enterprise strategy, operating-model changes, margin improvement, clinical priorities, and patient and workforce experience.
  • Collaborate with the Analytics team on data requirements, performance measurement, dashboards, and decision-support needs, drawing on specialist capabilities as appropriate.
  • Ensure clinical applications are developed and implemented with appropriate clinical leadership, validation, and oversight.
  • Evaluate digital solutions for business and workflow fit, functionality, usability, interoperability, utilization, supportability, risk, and total lifecycle cost.
  • Develop recommendations to optimize, extend, consolidate, replace, or retire solutions, distinguishing adoption and configuration gaps from structural technology limitations.
  • Build scenario-based investment cases and capability-led platform roadmaps that account for integration, migration, training, operating costs, dependencies, and transition risks.
  • Support IT efficiency initiatives involving workforce capacity, application rationalization, infrastructure, vendor and license spend, and service-delivery models, coordinating relevant specialists while protecting service quality and continuity.
  • Lead adoption and change-management activities that improve effective technology use, user proficiency, and workflow performance—not just deployment or training completion.
  • Establish performance baselines, accountable benefit owners, and measurement plans; validate results with operational leaders and Finance, distinguishing realized savings, revenue improvement, cost avoidance, and redeployable capacity.
  • Lead and mentor consultants, business analysts, and technical professionals through balanced delegation, coaching, technical review, and career development.
  • Contribute to recruiting, training, resource coordination, and reusable methodologies, tools, and delivery standards.
  • Support business development through opportunity identification, engagement expansion, proposals, scope development, effort estimates, client presentations, and thought leadership.
  • Evaluate technology vendors, emerging companies, and potential partners; help structure and manage pilots aligned with client needs, architecture, and investment priorities.

Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of relevant consulting or advisory experience focused on healthcare technology, enterprise implementations, intelligent automation, operational transformation, or related disciplines is required.
  • A degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, business analytics, finance, economics, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, is required.
  • Demonstrated experience leading consulting or advisory engagements, managing client relationships and multidisciplinary teams, and delivering projects within agreed budgets and timelines is required.
  • Deep expertise in at least one relevant discipline—such as intelligent automation architecture, AI-enabled workflow transformation, enterprise technology implementation, or technology strategy—with sufficient breadth to lead integrated engagements is required.
  • Practical experience assessing, designing, implementing, or scaling AI and automation solutions, including an understanding of generative AI and agentic workflows, their limitations, and appropriate controls, is required.
  • Operational or consulting experience in at least one healthcare domain, such as revenue cycle, managed care, supply chain, workforce, patient access, ambulatory operations, or clinical transformation, and the ability to work effectively with experts in other domains are required.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, application programming interfaces (APIs) and integration, data readiness, security and privacy considerations, testing, deployment, and ongoing support is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop business cases, estimate implementation requirements, prioritize investments, and connect operational performance to financial outcomes is required.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and build trusted relationships with business and technology leaders, are required.
  • A high-level understanding of other BRG Healthcare practices and their interrelationships with Technology, AI, & Digital Solutions is required.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, relationship expansion, and staff development is required.
  • Experience establishing or operating an AI or Automation Center of Excellence is preferred.
  • Experience architecting or leading delivery using one or more platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Notable, Microsoft Power Platform—including Power Automate and Power Apps—or comparable technologies is preferred.
  • Experience with healthcare enterprise platforms such as Epic, Workday, Salesforce, or comparable systems is preferred.
  • Experience with responsible AI governance, vendor evaluation, model or solution assessment, and ongoing performance monitoring is preferred.
  • Experience with digital adoption, application rationalization, IT operating-model design, technology spend optimization, or technology partner and startup collaborations is preferred.

Salary Range: $150,000 - $250,000


Job title and compensation to be determined based on qualifications and experience.


Candidate must be able to submit verification of legal right to work in the U.S., without company sponsorship.



About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

raw.description:
Position Summary

Experienced clinical operations professional responsible for managing biomarker clinical trials and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) kit studies from study start-up through close-out. Ensures studies are delivered on time, within budget and in compliance with ICH-GCP and FDA requirements, generating high-quality clinical evidence to support regulatory submissions and market access. US-based, remote position.

Responsibilities and Activities:

Study Planning and Start-up

  • Plan and lead the operational execution of biomarker clinical trials and IVD kit clinical performance studies, from protocol development through database lock and clinical study report.
  • Provide operational input into protocol design, sample handling workflows, and statistical planning to ensure feasibility and regulatory alignment.
  • Contribute to and review study documents, including protocols, informed consent forms, CRFs/eCRFs, monitoring plans and study budgets and timelines.
  • Lead site feasibility, selection and qualification; manage clinical trial agreements, site budgets and IRB/ethics submissions.
  • Planning and oversight of the study from GCP point of view (e.g. clinical trial management, establishing project management in response to study risk, site management plans and associated documentation)

Study Execution and Oversight

  • Manage CROs and other vendors; oversee scope, deliverables, performance and invoices.
  • Oversee site monitoring activities and review monitoring reports; drive timely resolution of issues and protocol deviations.
  • Track enrollment, milestones, budget and risks; implement mitigation plans to keep studies on schedule.
  • Own study budgets, including forecasting, internal accrual tracking, and change-order management.
  • Lead financial oversight of CRO and vendor contracts, including negotiation of amendments.
  • Ensure data quality through data review, query resolution and database lock in partnership with data management and biostatistics.
  • Maintain a complete, audit-ready Trial Master File (TMF) and manage deviations and CAPAs.
  • Establish and lead CRO governance meetings (e.g., operational reviews, KPIs, quality reviews).
  • Ensure CRO adherence to KPIs, quality metrics, and contractual obligations.
  • Drive escalation pathways and corrective actions when CRO performance deviates.

Regulatory and Quality

  • Ensure studies comply with ICH-GCP E6, applicable FDA regulations (21 CFR Parts 50, 56, 809 and 812), ISO 20916 and company SOPs.
  • Support FDA interactions and submissions (e.g., Pre-Submissions/Q-Subs, IDE, 510(k), De Novo, PMA) by providing clinical study documentation and responses to questions.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of clinical operations SOPs and processes.

Role Title: Business Operations Expert

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote, global

Required Skills:

  • Turning Real Operations Work Into a Defined Task

  • Objective Grading Criteria

  • Business Operations

  • Process Design and Ownership

  • Operational Reporting and Data Discrepancies

Opportunity Snapshot:

  • Pay: Up to $90/hour equivalent

  • Time per task: ~10 hours per task

  • Location: Fully remote — no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)

  • Next step: Complete the role-specific AI interview — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client

  • Your tasks: Design realistic, multi-step business operations tasks with objective criteria for grading the output

Your domain knowledge is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

The work is to turn real operational workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve written an SOP, built a QA checklist, or trained a team against a standard, that’s the instinct this needs.

Scope of Work:

  • Design multi-step tasks drawn from real operations work — reporting, process design, workflow management — with realistic reference files and clear instructions.

  • Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output.

  • Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly.

  • Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: spreadsheets, system exports, process documentation, operational reports.

  • Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway.

  • Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in business operations, operations reporting, process design, or workflow management — direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure.

  • Experience creating or applying structured standards: SOPs, QA checklists, process documentation, service level definitions, or training assessments.

  • Strong Excel capability and comfort reasoning across multiple documents at once.

  • Strong English, written and spoken — B2 minimum, C1 preferred.

  • AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

This is a remote position.

Big Ideas PH is seeking a high-velocity, execution-driven Influencer Outreach Specialistwith dedicated experience in the beauty and skincare space to power creator activation programs for two premier US beauty brands:Patchology (micro-creator high-frequency seeding) and Kate Somerville(tiered authority outreach). Reporting directly to brand marketing leads and managers, this is a daily execution and high-cadence volume role centered on sourcing creators, driving outreach, managing end-to-end sample fulfillment, and converting contacts into organic brand advocacy. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love solving operational puzzles, and take pride in hitting daily conversion targets, this role is for you.

This is a full-time, contractual, freelancer position for a trial period of 3 months while working at home. If you are a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual with experience and qualified based on the criteria below, we encourage you to apply.

Upon successful completion of the evaluation period, the contractor's performance will be reviewed, potentially leading to a contract renewal that may include a benefits package.

JOB DESCRIPTION
​

  • High-Volume Daily Outreach: Execute 50–75 outbound creator or influencer touches per day across TikTok and Instagram using tailored, brand-aligned messaging (no generic mass-DM copy), using an influencer management platform

  • Dual-Engine Program Execution: Sourcing and activating creators against strategic briefs for two distinct brand engines:

    • Patchology (Velocity Engine): High-frequency micro-creator seeding and volume gifting.

    • Kate Somerville(Authority Engine): Tiered outreach targeting beauty creators, wellness influencers and lifestyle trendsetters.

  • Sample Fulfillment Workflow & Tracking: Manage end-to-end sample requests including logging creator addresses, submitting accurate warehouse requests, tracking timestamped shipments, and proactively following up to confirm receipt.

  • Creator Relationship Nurturing & Follow-Ups: Conduct timely post-outreach follow-ups to maintain creator engagement and maximize response-to-posted content conversion rates.

  • Content Auditing & Compliance Tracking:Monitor, log, and verify live creator posts to ensure accurate product tagging, adherence to brand messaging, and compliance with FTC disclosure guidelines.

  • Data Logging & Reporting Discipline:Daily and weekly tracking of outreach volume, response rates, sample shipments, and content output using spreadsheets or ShopMy/CRM tracking tools to roll up actionable performance data to brand leads.

  • CRM & Creator Database Management: Maintain a clean, organized creator directory categorized by creator tiers, skin concerns/niches, platform performance, and engagement metrics.

  • Daily Alignment & Problem Solving: Participate in daily standups or asynchronous check-ins with brand leaders, proactively troubleshooting stalled responses or shipping delays to maintain continuous workflow velocity

​

Requirements

  • EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.

    • As least 2-3 years prior experience in influencer marketing, social media management, creator recruiting, talent outreach, or affiliate marketing management.

    • What this job is NOT:Not a community manager, not a content creator, not a paid media buyer.

  • TECHNICAL AND OTHER SKILLS (MUST-HAVES)

    • Direct Creator Outreach Experience:Proven experience in hands-on creator outreach on TikTok (including TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace / Affiliate Plan) and Instagram (DM, email, or native outreach tools). Generic social media management is not a substitute.

    • Seeding Platform Fluency:Direct operational familiarity with ShopMyor comparable creator gifting platforms (Superfiliate, GRIN, Aspire).

    • Fulfillment Operations Comfort:Hands-on experience working inside sample fulfillment workflows (address logging, warehouse coordination, and timestamped shipment tracking).

    • Exceptional English Communication:Fluency in written English required to draft personalized, brand-voice outreach messages that build authentic creator connection.

    • Rigorous Reporting Discipline:Consistent track record of daily/weekly data logging, tracker hygiene, and clear performance reporting.

    • High comfort working with spreadsheets(Google Sheets, MS Excel) and CRM-style tracking tools to maintain data accuracy.

    • Self-starter mindset with full comfort working toward daily/weekly outreach targets and performance KPIs.

  • PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Beauty/CPG Industry Background:Hands-on experience in the beauty, skincare, or consumer packaged goods space.

    • Campaign Structure Knowledge:Ability to differentiate gifting/seeding workflows (low-cost, product-only) from contracted posting waves (negotiated deliverables and paid agreements).

    • FTC Disclosure Familiarity:Understanding of basic FTC compliance requirements for influencer gifting and sponsored content.

    • Experience utilizing AI tools(e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) with strong prompting skills to optimize outreach copy generation and communication efficiency.

    • Prior experience supporting US-based clients or working in a remote agency ecosystem.

  • REQUIREMENTS FOR REMOTE WORK

    • Eligible to legally work as a remote freelancer or contractor based in the Philippines.

    • Natural-born Filipino citizen or Foreigner with a working VISA or permit to legally work in the Philippines.

    • Has own computer or laptop capable of handling the rigorous demands of work.

    • Has a fast and reliable internet connection at home (at least 200-300 MBPS)

    • Has a quiet and distraction free work environment at home.

    • Willing to work in graveyard shifts or changing shift US schedules.

HOURS OF WORK

  • Work from home. Full-time freelancer, contractual position

  • Full-time, 40 hours per week (8 guaranteed paid hours per workday, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour unpaid break).

  • US Time Zone / Graveyard Shift 9:00AM to 6:00 Eastern EST, USA time zone

  • US Holidays are observed off (unpaid during trial); PH Holidays are regular workdays. Overtime requires prior client approval.


Benefits

  • TAXATION:As per Philippine Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) regulations, professional fees for self-employed individuals are subject to a5% or 10% Expanded Withholding Tax (EWT). The final tax will be calculated based on the freelancer's submission of a valid Certificate of Registration (COR) as self-employed.
  • CONTRACT:This is a 3-month long freelancing trial contract (full-time) that can be done remotely at home with a computer and a fast and reliable internet connection. There are no benefits for Freelancers during the evaluation period.
  • EXCLUSIVITY OF ENGAGEMENT:By accepting a full-time freelancer contract with Big Ideas, you agree that this position serves as your sole full-time role. Upon executing this contract, you are required to formally resign from and relinquish any existing full-time employment or contracts. Secondary part-time roles or freelance commitments are permitted, provided they are transparently declared prior to signing, do not present a conflict of interest, and do not compromise your availability or performance.​
  • POSSIBLE RENEWAL:However, if the Client decides to renew the contract there may be certain benefits such as paid sick leaves, paid vacation leaves, HMO health insurance and 13th month pay. These are not guaranteed and everything will depend on performance and client discretion.
  • REPORTING TO:Although you will be reporting directly to the designated manager from our client, you will also be reporting to and will be supervised by Big Ideas Social Media Inc, who is the consultant and service provider (Agency) of the US business. Big Ideas will be the ones to provide your compensation and other HR and administrative needs locally.
  • LEGAL STATUS:You will be classified as “Self-Employed” when it concerns legality and taxation. You will not be considered an employee of our Client or Big Ideas Philippines but instead, you will be a self-employed freelance professional.

These tools are strictly supportive; human judgment is at the core of our process, and all final hiring decisions are made by people. For information regarding your data privacy, please contact us.
