IT Manager Support - Infrastructure & Systems (Remote)

Work From Home | Full-Time | AU Hours |

About the Role

We are seeking a capable and hands-on IT Manager Support professional to support day-to-day IT operations across systems, users, and infrastructure for an Australian business.

Working closely with the IT Manager, you will help keep Microsoft environments, servers, networks, and end-user systems running smoothly, securely, and efficiently.

This role suits someone who can troubleshoot quickly, communicate clearly, and take ownership of issues from resolution through to prevention.

Key Responsibilities

Microsoft Environment (Core Focus)

  • Administer and support Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and security policies through Azure AD / Entra ID
  • Support email setup, migrations, troubleshooting, and spam/security controls

Systems & Server Support

  • Monitor and maintain Windows Servers (on-premise and/or cloud)
  • Assist with backups, patching, updates, and system performance
  • Support virtual environments such as Hyper-V or VMware

Network Management

  • Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN, routers, firewalls, and switches
  • Troubleshoot connectivity issues and outages
  • Support VPN access and remote user connectivity

Helpdesk & User Support

  • Provide Level 1–2 support across hardware, software, and access issues
  • Resolve support tickets efficiently and escalate when required
  • Support onboarding/offboarding including device setup, email, and system access

Security & Compliance

  • Support endpoint security, antivirus, and monitoring tools
  • Maintain access controls, MFA, and security policies
  • Assist with backups, recovery processes, and data protection practices

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain IT documentation, user guides, and support processes
  • Track recurring issues and resolutions
  • Assist in reporting system performance and risks

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years experience in IT support / systems administration
  • Strong experience with Microsoft 365 and Exchange environments
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server, Active Directory / Azure AD
  • Experience with network troubleshooting (routers, firewalls, VPNs)
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical users

Systems & Tools

  • Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
  • Azure AD / Entra ID
  • Windows Server
  • Hyper-V / VMware (preferred)
  • Networking tools (VPN, routers, firewalls, switches)
  • Backup and monitoring tools

What Success Looks Like

  • Systems and infrastructure run reliably and securely
  • User support requests are resolved efficiently
  • Network and server issues are proactively managed
  • Security controls and backups are maintained effectively
  • Documentation and support processes are kept up to date

Preferred

  • Experience with Azure or AWS
  • Exposure to cybersecurity tools and best practices
  • Experience with backup systems and disaster recovery
  • IT certifications (Microsoft, CompTIA, or similar)

Position:

HPE SLED Channel Manager - West


Job Description:

Why You'll Love This Role

Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next.

Working across functions and technologies, you'll build lasting partnerships, deliver value beyond products, and help customers transform ideas into real-world solutions while growing your own career in a global technology organization.


Role Overview

The HPE SLED West Channel Manager is responsible for driving HPE growth across the West. This role serves as the primary Arrow resource aligned to HPE and is accountable for developing and executing strategic go-to-market initiatives that accelerate revenue, profitability, partner engagement, and market share within SLED.


This individual will work closely with HPE, Arrow supplier teams, and key public sector channel partners to create demand, identify growth opportunities, expand HPE portfolio adoption, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience with HPE's portfolio, deep knowledge of public sector procurement and sales motions, and established relationships throughout the SLED ecosystem.


This role requires a strong sales background and demonstrates ability to identify, develop, and influence revenue opportunities through the channel ecosystem. The successful candidate will possess both strategic business acumen and a consultative selling mindset, with a proven track record of driving growth, creating demand, and accelerating complex opportunities across public sector organizations and partners.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Own and execute the HPE West SLED growth strategy, driving revenue, profitability, and market share across public sector accounts and partners.
  • Serve as Arrow's primary HPE SLED business leader for the Western region.
  • Develop strategic account and partner plans aligned with HPE priorities, incentives, and growth initiatives.
  • Drive adoption across HPE's portfolio, including Compute, Storage, Networking (Aruba), Hybrid Cloud, GreenLake, AI, Security, and Services.
  • Build trusted relationships with HPE field leadership, partner account managers, solution architects, and public sector sellers.
  • Identify, recruit, enable, and develop strategic reseller partners focused on SLED and Healthcare opportunities.
  • Lead pipeline generation activities including partner business planning, campaigns, executive briefings, workshops, and market development initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Arrow's public sector, solution engineering, marketing, and contracts teams to develop comprehensive solutions addressing public sector customer needs.
  • Provide competitive market intelligence, customer insights, procurement trends, and partner feedback to internal stakeholders and HPE leadership.
  • Influence and support large strategic opportunities through the sales cycle, including deal strategy, positioning, and executive engagement.
  • Drive partner participation in HPE programs, certifications, incentives, solution specializations, and enablement initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and executive reporting.
  • Represent Arrow and HPE at industry events, partner conferences, customer engagements, and public sector associations throughout the region.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8-10+ years of channel sales, business development, or supplier management experience.
  • 5+ years supporting or selling HPE solutions, with demonstrated knowledge across multiple HPE portfolio areas.
  • Proven success working within the public sector ecosystem, including State Government, Local Government, Education, Healthcare, or Cooperative Purchasing organizations.
  • Strong understanding of public sector procurement, contract vehicles, funding sources, and buying cycles.
  • Experience building and executing partner growth strategies through distribution and indirect sales channels.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating with executive leadership, sales teams, and strategic partners.
  • Strong knowledge of HPE programs, partner ecosystem, channel incentives, and go-to-market motions.
  • Experience with HPE GreenLake, Aruba Networking, Compute, Storage, AI, and Hybrid Cloud solutions preferred.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, business planning, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to analyze business performance, identify growth opportunities, and execute strategic initiatives.
  • Strong Salesforce.com and forecasting discipline.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented leader with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a strong focus on execution and measurable outcomes.

Due to contractual requirements with the federal government, viable candidates must be US citizens


Work Arrangement

Fully Remote: Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.


What’s In It For You:

At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans and a solid benefits package:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • 401k, With Matching Contributions
  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options
  • Paid Time Off (including sick, holiday, vacation, etc.)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Growth Opportunities
  • And more!

About Arrow

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better. At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges. Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.

Life at Arrow

At Arrow, we believe innovation starts with people. We create an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning help our employees grow and make a meaningful impact every day. From your first day, you'll have opportunities to build new skills, work alongside talented teams around the world, and contribute to technology that helps shape a better future. Because when our people grow, innovation moves forward.

$115,800.00 - $184,803.70

Actual compensation offer to candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive (if applicable) will be finalized at offer.

US-CO-Colorado (Remote Employees)Remote work employees may be required to be present at the closest designated Arrow office for work-related purposes, at the Company’s request and sole discretion.

Full time

Sales

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike’s Strategic Advisory Services team assists our customers with a wide array of proactive engagements to help enhance security programs, educate employees, and develop tailored cyber initiatives. The Consultant role is one of the primary contributors to engagement delivery, with a strong focus on task-oriented activities, reporting, and supporting engagement leadership to ensure projects are performed on time and to our highest standards. Consultants will also have the opportunity to contribute to thought leadership, methodology development, and other “back of office” tasks, as a secondary function of the role.


Am I a Strategic Consultant Candidate?

  • Do you find yourself keeping up with the latest cyber breaches?
  • Do you want to help companies protect themselves against malicious adversaries?
  • Are you interested in learning your customer’s maturity and pain points to develop a plan to improve?
  • Are you looking for opportunities to learn from the best in the business while developing your own skill set?
  • Are you comfortable working independently as well as with a team?
  • Are you ready to “do the work” while also being given opportunities to contribute to the broader business where possible?
  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?
  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?
  • Do you have strong communication and writing skills?
  • Are you the smartest person on your current team? Would you prefer to engage peers who challenge you daily?

What You'll Do:

  • Contribute to the delivery of large and complex strategic advisory service engagements, engaging with management-level individuals across a wide range of industry segments.
  • Assess and develop cybersecurity and incident response programs in a proactive fashion to help mature the security posture of organizations prior to an incident.
  • Develop cutting-edge scenarios to help customers exercise the full range of their response capabilities.
  • Produce and ensure delivery of high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings to customer management.
  • Identify and address emerging trends in cybersecurity, drawing on both government and private sector perspectives.
  • Contribute thought leadership and experiences to internal programs and teams.

What You'll Need:
Successful candidates will have at least 2-6 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • IT / Security Management Consulting: you’ve held leadership positions and owned relationships with organizational executives as a management or technical consultant. You’ve worked on a range of infosec and IT issues, including both technical cyber security (applying controls, improving architectures, etc.) and operational cyber security (organizational alignment, cyber policy review, etc.)
  • Security Program Development: you’ve personally contributed to the development, management, and implementation of a security program, helping organization build, enhance, or recalibrate their plans for a successful future-leaning security program. This may include aspects of developing a SOC, CSIRT, Fusion Center, or several security initiatives that support a centralized security function.
  • Security Analysis / Operations: you’ve held leadership or key delivery positions in organizations or on teams that focus on organizational security (such as SOCs, IR teams, etc.). You understand cybersecurity from a practitioner standpoint, and importantly, you also understand how to consolidate and communicate results to senior leaders.
  • Business Strategy / Risk Analysis: you’ve helped businesses address a range of risks, including cyber risks, across their organization. You’re familiar with how organizational risk frameworks are developed, and you have experience helping organizations improve and apply their risk frameworks to address cyber risks.
  • Cybersecurity Policy: you’ve been responsible for developing new policies or enhancing existing policies that inform how private or government organization performs and manages its various cyber security activities. You have played a key role in developing policies, plans, and/or playbooks focusing on cyber security activities, and have ideally been part of the process of transitioning these plans into practice within an organization.
  • Public / Government Affairs: you have significant experience helping government organizations, or entities that work closely with governments, refine cyber security priorities and communicate clearly about these priorities. You are highly experienced in working across technical and non-technical stakeholders in an organization to develop defensible, actionable priorities and plans for improving cyber security.

Additionally, all candidates must possess the following qualifications:


  • Exceptional written and verbal communications skills, specifically in fast-paced professional environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships with a wide range of customers and team members.
  • Capable of completing complex tasks involving strategic analysis and development, without supervision.
  • Desire to grow and expand cyber aptitude, technical awareness, and soft skills.
  • Strong time management skills, including the ability to complete tasks for multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Consistent positive work environment and attitude.
  • Ability to travel to engage with clients, up to 30% of the time, often on less than three weeks’ notice.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Education:

We are seeking candidates with the right combination of training and skills to join our team. Experience, drive, and results are key and advanced degrees are not required. Successful candidates coming from an academic background will likely have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, Public Policy, Intelligence Studies, or a related discipline.


Additional consideration for Master's degrees. Applicants without a degree but with relevant military or work experience and/or training will be considered, and should apply their previous experience to the qualification areas above.


This role may require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass alcohol and/or drug test(s) during the course of employment.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Manager – RCT to join our team! Trillium’s Care Manager – RCT plays a vital role in ensuring members receive whole person-centered care to meet their individual and complex physical, mental health, and social needs. The Care Manager serves as the single point of contact for members and works with a multidisciplinary care team, including primary care providers, specialists, care manager extenders, transition staff, and caretakers/legal guardians to promote continuity of care and quality care for each member. The Care Manager – RCT would be expected to work and be available at their remote location between the hours of 8:30 am – 5:00pm and be flexible to travel within the community to meet with members as well as attend other meetings as needed.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned members, providing ongoing care management and advocacy.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of member needs using person-centered planning methods and organizational tools.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized care plans in collaboration with members, families, and multidisciplinary support teams.
  • Coordinate services across providers, agencies, and community resources to address member physical, behavioral, and social health needs.
  • Ensure assessments and care plans are updated to reflect changes in member needs and circumstances.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must meet Qualified Professional (QP) status.
  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR
  2. A graduate of a college or university with a master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  4. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a field other than human services and has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling.
  • Additionally, If serving members with Long Term Services and Support (LTSS) needs, the care manager, must meet the minimum QP requirements defined above (A-D) and shall additionally have at a minimum two (2) years of prior LTSS and/or Home and Community Based Service (HCBS) coordination, care delivery monitoring and care management experience. This experience may be concurrent with the years of experience required to become a Qualified Professional.
  • License and/or certification may be accepted as noted above.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within 75 miles of Trillium’s South Central Region, which includes the following counties: Carteret, Craven, Duplin, Jones, Lenoir, Onslow, Pender, Sampson, and Wayne.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship for employment now or in the future (ex: OPT F-1, J-1).

Preferred:

  • A degree in a field related to health, psychology, sociology, social work, nursing, or any other relevant human services field.

Deadline for Application:Wednesday November 4, 2026, at 11:59PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

About Beeline Medicines:

Beeline Medicines is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company focused on developing and delivering category-leading precision therapies to transform the lives of people living with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. With a portfolio of potential best-in-class and first-in-disease therapeutic candidates that directly target key pathways governing dysregulated immunological and inflammatory responses, the Company is developing medicines that have the opportunity to provide durable, life-changing impact. Led by an established executive team and backed by world-class life science investors, each day Beeline Medicines is determined to bring the scientific rigor and operational excellence to get to what matters for patients – realizing a world where people with immune-mediated diseases can live life fully.

Job Summary:

The Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) will lead the operational planning, execution, and oversight of complex, global clinical studies in the field of immunology and autoimmune diseases. This role is responsible for ensuring studies are delivered on time, within scope, and in compliance with regulatory standards, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The Sr. CTM will partner closely with internal cross-functional teams (Clinical Development, Regulatory, Biometrics, Safety, and Quality) and external partners (CROs, vendors, and sites) to ensure operational excellence. This individual will also play a critical role in driving strategic decision-making and supporting inspection readiness and regulatory submissions.


Work Arrangement & Location:

Remote - This position is designated as remote; the incumbent will be expected to travel to Beeline Medicines’ offices on a periodic basis to support in-person collaboration, team engagement, and business operations. The frequency and scheduling of such visits will be determined at the company's discretion based on business need.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the operational strategy, planning, and execution of global Phase 1–4 clinical trials in immunology indications (e.g., autoimmune and inflammatory diseases).
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Oversee the selection and management of CROs and other vendors, including scope of work, budget development, contracting, and performance oversight.
  • Drive site feasibility, site selection, activation, patient recruitment strategies, and ongoing site management to ensure achievement of enrollment goals.
  • Develop and maintain study timelines, risk mitigation strategies, and operational tracking tools.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on protocol development, CRF design, ICF review, and development of operational study plans.
  • Ensure studies are conducted in compliance with GCP/ICH guidelines, local regulatory requirements, and internal SOPs.
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational issues, escalating risks and implementing mitigation strategies as needed.
  • Oversee data collection activities, database lock readiness, and support data review processes.
  • Contribute to regulatory filings, inspection readiness, and audit preparation.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to Clinical Operations team members.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives within Clinical Operations to enhance efficiency and quality.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in clinical operations in the biopharmaceutical industry, with at least 3 years in a Senior CTM or equivalent leadership role.
  • Proven track record of managing global, multi-center clinical trials in immunology or autoimmune disease indications.
  • Experience with biologics, monoclonal antibodies, or advanced therapies.
  • Strong knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines, clinical trial regulations, and operational best practices.
  • Experience in rare autoimmune indications or immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
  • Familiarity with adaptive trial designs or complex biomarker-driven studies.
  • Experience in early- to late-stage development programs, including pivotal trials.
  • Proficiency with electronic systems such as CTMS, EDC, eTMF, and risk-based monitoring tools.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and work independently with minimal supervision
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • This position requires availability during Eastern Time (ET) business hours
  • This role may require domestic and international travel, including overnight stays, up to 20% or more based on business needs

raw.description:
Every utility-scale renewable energy project begins long before construction starts. Its efficiency, reliability and long-term performance depend on the engineering decisions made at the design stage.

At SUNOTEC, you can shape these decisions while working fully remotely from anywhere in Bulgaria, in a hybrid model or from our Sofia office.

As an international system integrator of large-scale renewable energy infrastructure, we have delivered more than 680 projects, with over 15 GW of installed capacity and 6 GWh of battery energy storage capacity across 24+ countries.

As our Electrical Design team continues to grow, we’re looking for a Senior Electrical Design Engineer to lead technical design activities across utility-scale solar and BESS projects.

Why this role matters:

As a Senior Electrical Design Engineer, you'll play a key role in developing and reviewing the electrical design of photovoltaic power plants and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Beyond delivering high-quality engineering solutions, you'll help establish technical standards, optimise project designs and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.

Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, project managers and international stakeholders, your expertise will directly influence the technical quality, efficiency and successful delivery of our projects.

Work from anywhere in Bulgaria:

We believe great engineering is built through collaboration, not location. That's why we give our electrical design engineers the flexibility to choose how they work, while staying connected to international projects and teams.

  • Flexible working model – fully remote, hybrid or office-based (Sofia);
  • Work closely with engineers and project teams across Europe;
  • A culture of trust and accountability - we support flexible work arrangements while expecting ownership, reliability and commitment to team collaboration.

Where you'll make an impact:

  • Lead the electrical design of utility-scale photovoltaic power plants, battery energy storage systems (BESS) and related electrical infrastructure;
  • Develop and optimize engineering solutions that balance technical performance, project requirements, regulatory compliance and long-term operational reliability;
  • Ensure the quality and consistency of project documentation by reviewing and coordinating design work delivered by internal engineering teams and external design partners;
  • Support successful project execution by providing technical expertise and author's supervision throughout construction and commissioning;
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, project managers and international stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time and to the highest engineering standards;
  • Represent the electrical engineering discipline during technical discussions with clients and other project stakeholders, providing expert guidance throughout the design process;
  • Contribute to technical proposals, budget estimations and engineering input that supports the development of new renewable energy projects.

What will help you succeed:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in the electrical design of utility-scale photovoltaic power plants;
  • A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline;
  • Strong proficiency in AutoCAD; experience with additional electrical design software will be considered an advantage;
  • A solid understanding of engineering standards, regulations and best practices related to renewable energy projects;
  • Confidence in reviewing technical documentation and making sound engineering decisions on complex technical challenges;
  • The ability to communicate effectively with engineers, project teams, clients and external partners across international projects;
  • Professional working proficiency in English. German language skills will be considered an advantage;
  • The ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Why you'll enjoy working here

At SUNOTEC, you'll work on some of Europe's largest renewable energy projects while collaborating with experienced engineers across multiple countries and technical disciplines.

Because our Electrical Design team supports projects across our international portfolio, you'll be exposed to a wide variety of technical challenges, technologies and engineering standards without relocating or travelling extensively.

As our business continues to grow, you'll have opportunities to take on increasingly complex projects and further expand your technical expertise while maintaining the flexibility of working remotely from anywhere in Bulgaria.

In addition, you'll benefit from:

  • A flexible working model based on your preferences and role requirements – fully remote, hybrid or office-based (Sofia);
  • A remuneration package reflecting the scope of the role and your experience;
  • Additional health insurance including dental care;
  • Multisport card;
  • 24 days of paid annual leave;
  • Modern office facilities whenever you'd like to work from our Sofia office, team events and additional employee benefits.

If you'd like to contribute to projects that shape Europe's energy infrastructure, this might be the right place for you.

Send us your CV in English and become part of a team building large-scale solar, battery storage and grid infrastructure projects across Europe.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. Your documents and personal data will be treated as confidential and will be protected according to Bulgarian Data Protection Legislation and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

raw.description:
Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

Great Minds® is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our Marketing Creative team—someone who brings strong design fundamentals, fresh thinking, and a passion for bringing ideas to life.

Reporting to the Design Manager, you’ll help shape how Great Minds shows up across marketing and communications—from high-impact PowerPoint presentations and digital campaigns to marketing collateral and branded experiences. You’ll collaborate with designers, marketers, and content partners to create thoughtful, engaging, and impactful work.


Responsibilities

  • Design compelling, brand-aligned PowerPoint presentations that transform complex content into clear, engaging visual stories through thoughtful typography, hierarchy, color, and layout.

  • Create marketing collateral across print and digital, including flyers, brochures, one-pagers, infographics, social graphics, and campaign materials.

  • Support the development of event and experiential graphics, including trade show materials, signage, and other branded touchpoints.

  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and creative partners to translate project objectives into thoughtful, effective visual solutions.

  • Apply and uphold Great Minds brand standards, ensuring consistency and quality across marketing and communications.

  • Bring fresh ideas and creative thinking to established design systems, finding opportunities to elevate the work while maintaining brand consistency.

  • Source, select, and retouch photography and visual assets to support compelling creative executions.

  • Prepare and deliver accurate, production-ready files for print, digital, and presentation use.

  • Manage multiple projects and priorities, collaborating with project managers and team members to deliver quality work on schedule.

  • Incorporate feedback thoughtfully, communicate clearly, and contribute to a positive, collaborative creative environment.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in a marketing, agency, or in-house creative environment.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating design fundamentals, creative thinking, attention to detail, and experience across print, digital, and presentation design.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to create polished, visually compelling presentations that go well beyond standard templates.

  • Portfolio that includes at least one presentation or deck demonstrating strong design thinking and visual storytelling.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

  • Strong understanding of typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy, and brand consistency.

  • Ability to translate complex information and marketing messages into clear, engaging visuals.

  • Experience working within established brand guidelines while bringing creativity and fresh perspectives to the work.

  • Strong communication, organization, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and incorporate feedback.

  • A curious, adaptable mindset and willingness to learn new tools, explore new ideas, and grow as a designer.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Canva and other collaborative design tools.

  • Familiarity with HTML and CSS.

  • Experience working with education, publishing, or mission-driven organizations.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in graphic design, visual communication, or a related field.

Remote

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-Time, Mechanicsburg, PA

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

Job Title:

Cloud Solution Architect -GitHub Enterprise

Job Description

Technical Products and Services (TPS):

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Overview:

As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will lead the design, optimization, and modernization of enterprise-scale source control and developer collaboration platforms, with a strong focus on large-scale GitHub Enterprise Server environments. This role is ideal for a highly experienced architect who brings deep infrastructure expertise, DevOps transformation experience, and hands-on leadership in building secure, resilient, high-performing platforms that support thousands of developers across global organizations.

You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with engineering, infrastructure, security, and executive stakeholders to deliver scalable architecture, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence for complex enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enterprise-grade source control and developer collaboration platforms using GitHub Enterprise Server.
  • Create scalable architecture patterns that support global development teams, CI/CD pipelines, software engineering excellence, and developer productivity.
  • Develop technical roadmaps for platform modernization, migration, optimization, and long-term scalability.
  • Provide architectural governance, technical standards, and best-practice guidance across DevOps and platform engineering teams.
  • Lead deployment, configuration, administration, and optimization of GitHub Enterprise Server environments.
  • Architect high-availability, disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity solutions for mission-critical developer platforms.
  • Design integration strategies across identity, security, monitoring, ticketing, CI/CD, and enterprise infrastructure systems.
  • Support complex multi-region and large-scale enterprise implementations, including on-premises environments.
  • Perform detailed infrastructure sizing and capacity planning assessments.
  • Analyze repository growth, storage consumption, network utilization, system performance trends, and platform usage patterns.
  • Develop forecasting models to support future platform growth, infrastructure investment, and organizational expansion.
  • Recommend scaling strategies based on utilization data, business demand, and operational requirements.
  • Conduct system health assessments and performance reviews across application, database, storage, network, and infrastructure layers.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve platform responsiveness, scalability, reliability, and user experience.

raw.title: Principal Sales Solutions Consultant
raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Principal Sales Solutions Consultant is a strategic, client-facing healthcare technology advisor responsible for helping drive revenue growth through consultative discovery, enterprise solution architecture, value engineering, and technical pre-sales leadership.
raw.description:
Overview

The Principal Sales Solutions Consultant is a strategic, client-facing healthcare technology advisor responsible for helping drive revenue growth through consultative discovery, enterprise solution architecture, value engineering, and technical pre-sales leadership.

Partnering closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, and Client Engagement teams, this individual works with prospective and existing healthcare payer clients to understand their business strategies, operational challenges, technology environments, and desired outcomes. The Lead Sales Solutions Consultant translates these insights into integrated Cotiviti solutions that connect data, intelligence, interoperability, analytics, workflow, and healthcare domain expertise.

This role extends beyond traditional product demonstrations or product-specific solution support. The Lead Sales Solutions Consultant develops comprehensive solution strategies, architects future-state environments across multiple capabilities, and creates executive-level narratives that clearly articulate the financial, operational, clinical, member, and strategic value of Cotiviti’s solutions.

The position supports complex sales pursuits across Cotiviti’s Health Enablement, Interoperability, Payment Integrity, and related solution portfolios. Success requires deep healthcare payer knowledge, strong technical and architectural credibility, executive presence, commercial acumen, and the ability to connect individual client needs to broader enterprise opportunities.

The role is equally comfortable discussing payer strategy and business outcomes with executive leaders, operational workflows with business stakeholders, solution architecture with technology leaders, and value creation with financial decision-makers. This broader, horizontal solution-consulting model reflects the organization’s goal of telling a comprehensive, end-to-end client story across business units rather than positioning isolated products.

Responsibilities

Strategic Discovery and Client Advisory

  • Lead strategic discovery sessions with prospective and existing healthcare payer clients to understand their business priorities, operational challenges, technology environments, regulatory obligations, and desired outcomes.
  • Conduct current-state assessments that evaluate client workflows, administrative platforms, data ecosystems, integration requirements, technical constraints, and organizational readiness.
  • Identify the underlying business problems clients are seeking to solve and translate those challenges into clear solution requirements and success measures.
  • Facilitate executive workshops, architecture discussions, solution-design sessions, and strategic whiteboarding engagements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive, business, operational, and technical stakeholders throughout the sales cycle.
  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned clients and accounts to provide relevant, informed, and forward-looking solution guidance.
  • Help clients evaluate future-state opportunities related to operational performance, payment accuracy, interoperability, regulatory readiness, data exchange, member experience, and healthcare outcomes.

Enterprise Solution Strategy and Architecture

  • Develop integrated, end-to-end solution strategies that connect Cotiviti capabilities across interoperability, data, analytics, intelligence, workflow, and healthcare payer domains.
  • Design and articulate solution architectures that address data ingestion, transformation, integration, APIs, interoperability patterns, security considerations, operational workflows, and scalable deployment approaches.
  • Architect the broader client environment and explain how individual solution components work together to deliver measurable business value.
  • Translate complex business, operational, regulatory, and technical requirements into feasible and differentiated solution designs.
  • Develop current-state and future-state architecture views, data flows, integration models, and solution roadmaps.
  • Balance client requirements with Cotiviti’s product capabilities, implementation models, delivery resources, and strategic direction.
  • Identify solution assumptions, dependencies, technical risks, implementation considerations, and potential barriers to client adoption.
  • Lead or support proofs of concept, pilots, architecture reviews, and technical validations to confirm solution fit and reduce implementation risk.

Pre-Sales Leadership and Complex Pursuit Strategy

  • Lead the technical and solution-consulting strategy for assigned complex healthcare payer opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Partner with Sales to develop pursuit strategies, clarify client value drivers, position Cotiviti’s differentiators, and align proposed solutions with client priorities.
  • Coordinate Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, Security, Legal, and domain experts during complex pursuits.
  • Anticipate and proactively address technical, operational, functional, regulatory, commercial, and competitive objections.
  • Support opportunity qualification by assessing solution fit, technical feasibility, implementation considerations, competitive positioning, and the potential value to the client.
  • Strengthen the sales pipeline by identifying technical differentiators, cross-sell opportunities, expansion opportunities, and future client needs.
  • Maintain a forward-looking perspective on assigned accounts by identifying what the client may need next and connecting those needs to the broader Cotiviti portfolio.
  • Help reduce sales-cycle friction by establishing early alignment among client expectations, proposed solution capabilities, and delivery requirements.
  • Ensure solution commitments are documented, achievable, and aligned with Cotiviti’s product capabilities and delivery expectations.

Value Engineering and Executive-Level Storytelling

  • Develop compelling executive-level narratives that explain why the proposed solution matters, how it supports the client’s strategy, and what outcomes it can deliver.
  • Connect solution capabilities to measurable financial, operational, clinical, member, regulatory, and strategic value.
  • Develop value propositions and business cases that quantify, where feasible, the potential impact of Cotiviti solutions.
  • Apply value-engineering principles to help clients understand expected benefits, improvement opportunities, implementation considerations, and investment rationale.
  • Communicate effectively with C-suite executives, business leaders, operational stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, and other decision-makers.
  • Adjust the depth, terminology, and presentation style based on the audience while maintaining consistency in the overall solution narrative.
  • Build credibility with executive stakeholders by demonstrating strong healthcare payer knowledge, business acumen, and technical expertise.

Executive Engagement, Solution Storytelling, and Client Workshops

  • Lead executive workshops, solution-strategy sessions, technical workshops, and architecture discussions tailored to client priorities, stakeholder needs, and desired business outcomes.
  • Develop business-led solution narratives that connect client challenges, Cotiviti capabilities, architectural choices, and measurable outcomes.
  • Use presentations, demonstrations, and other visual techniques selectively to support the broader solution narrative and validate fit; avoid feature-led or isolated product presentations.
  • Lead whiteboarding sessions that clearly communicate current-state challenges, future-state designs, workflows, data exchanges, decision points, and expected business value.
  • Respond effectively to real-time questions, objections, competitive concerns, and evolving client priorities while maintaining a coherent strategic narrative.
  • Present sophisticated healthcare, operating-model, data, and technology concepts clearly and persuasively to executive, business, operational, and technical audiences.
  • Create reusable executive narratives, workshop frameworks, value stories, architectural patterns, presentation materials, and—where appropriate—demonstration assets that strengthen the broader Solutions Consulting practice.

Healthcare Payer and Technical Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in healthcare payer operations, technology environments, and data ecosystems.
  • Apply knowledge of payer administrative platforms and workflows, including claims, encounters, enrollment, eligibility, membership, prior authorization, provider management, payment integrity, risk adjustment, quality improvement, Stars, HEDIS, and member engagement.
  • Demonstrate a good understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and technologies.
  • Apply knowledge of integration patterns, ETL processes, cloud technologies, enterprise architecture, analytics platforms, workflow automation, and complex healthcare data flows.
  • Understand how artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, and automation may be applied to relevant healthcare payer use cases.
  • Maintain current knowledge of CMS requirements, interoperability and prior authorization mandates, market developments, emerging technologies, payer priorities, and competitive offerings.
  • Develop deep expertise in one or more Cotiviti solution or healthcare domains while maintaining the breadth required to position integrated, cross-portfolio solutions.
  • Articulate how technical components work together to address broader payer business challenges and produce measurable outcomes.

Solution Strategy, Business Case, and Technical Validation

  • Develop integrated solution recommendations and business cases that connect client priorities to Cotiviti capabilities, differentiators, implementation considerations, and expected outcomes.
  • Ensure client-facing recommendations communicate a cohesive enterprise solution and value strategy rather than disconnected product capabilities.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Security, and Delivery stakeholders to validate solution strategy, proposed architectures, value assumptions, commitments, implementation assumptions, and delivery requirements.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, gaps, decision points, and areas requiring additional validation before commercial or delivery commitments are made.
  • Lead or support proofs of concept, pilots, technical workshops, and other validation activities when they are the most effective way to reduce decision risk and advance client alignment.
  • Lead the solution strategy and substantive technical and value content for proposals and RFP responses; proposal administration and coordination are not the primary purpose of this role.

Pipeline Development and Account Expansion

  • Build and maintain account-specific knowledge to support stronger client engagement, solution continuity, and enterprise growth.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to identify cross-sell, upsell, and multi-solution opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Connect immediate client requirements to broader Cotiviti capabilities and longer-term strategic opportunities.
  • Help develop an actionable opportunity funnel by identifying emerging needs, future initiatives, and potential transformation priorities.
  • Recognize patterns across clients and markets that may indicate new solution opportunities or evolving buyer expectations.
  • Support larger and more strategic pursuits by positioning Cotiviti as an enterprise solution partner rather than solely as a product or point-solution provider.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Market Influence

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, Client Engagement, and other internal teams to develop coordinated solution strategies.
  • Engage appropriate product, healthcare-domain, architecture, and delivery experts based on the client’s needs and the complexity of the proposed solution.
  • Serve as connective tissue among clients, the market, Sales, Product, and Technology by translating external insights into actionable internal feedback.
  • Provide structured client, market, competitive, and technology insights to support product strategy, roadmap planning, investment decisions, and innovation.
  • Identify capability gaps and recurring client requirements that may inform future product development or partnership opportunities.
  • Contribute to the Solutions Consulting community by sharing best practices, competitive insights, value-engineering approaches, reusable assets, and architectural patterns.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to other Solutions Consultants during complex pursuits, demonstrations, workshops, and client engagements.
  • Represent Cotiviti at client forums, executive workshops, industry events, conferences, and other strategic engagements as needed.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business, computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 12+ years of experience in healthcare technology, solution consulting, pre-sales, sales engineering, enterprise architecture, healthcare consulting, or a comparable client-facing role.
  • Significant experience working within the healthcare payer ecosystem and a strong understanding of payer business models, operational processes, technology environments, and data ecosystems.
  • Experience selling, positioning, or supporting complex enterprise healthcare technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead strategic discovery, current-state assessments, solution workshops, architecture discussions, whiteboarding sessions, demonstrations, and technical validation.
  • Experience designing and articulating integrated, end-to-end solution architectures, including data flows, integrations, APIs, workflows, and interoperability patterns.
  • Knowledge of payer domains such as claims, encounters, enrollment, eligibility, prior authorization, payment integrity, provider management, risk adjustment, quality improvement, and member engagement.
  • Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and technologies.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect technology capabilities to financial, operational, clinical, member, regulatory, and strategic value.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives, business leaders, operational stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, and technical professionals.
  • Experience developing and delivering executive presentations, solution demonstrations, technical workshops, business cases, and architecture recommendations.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and operational information into clear, compelling, value-oriented narratives.
  • Knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies and the practices associated with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-management, and stakeholder-engagement capabilities.
  • Ability to influence decisions and build alignment without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent opportunities, and remain effective in a fast-paced sales environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, and client-facing teams.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for client meetings, workshops, conferences, and other business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Cotiviti solutions or comparable healthcare analytics, interoperability, payment integrity, payer technology, or enterprise healthcare software platforms.
  • Deep expertise in one or more areas such as Payment Integrity, Risk Adjustment, Quality, Stars, HEDIS, Interoperability, Prior Authorization, Provider-Payer Connectivity, or payer data exchange.
  • Experience positioning integrated enterprise solutions that span multiple products, business units, healthcare domains, or technology platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise architecture, APIs, integration patterns, ETL processes, cloud-based data platforms, analytics, workflow automation, and complex healthcare data ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with CMS requirements, interoperability mandates, prior authorization regulations, and other healthcare payer compliance considerations.
  • Experience developing quantified business cases or applying value-engineering principles during complex sales pursuits.
  • Experience supporting proofs of concept, pilots, enterprise transformation initiatives, and strategic account expansion.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics to healthcare payer use cases.
  • Experience with consultative selling, design thinking, customer journey mapping, or outcome-based solution development.
  • Master’s degree in healthcare, business, technology, engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant healthcare, enterprise architecture, cloud, interoperability, sales engineering, or technology certifications.

Cognitive and Mental Requirements

  • Ability to analyze complex business, operational, regulatory, and technical information and communicate conclusions clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate incomplete or evolving information and recommend an appropriate path forward.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to retain and apply evolving knowledge of Cotiviti solutions, healthcare regulations, industry practices, client environments, and competitive offerings.
  • Mental flexibility to adapt communication style, presentation strategy, and technical depth to different audiences and situations.
  • Ability to remain composed, think quickly, and respond professionally during high-pressure client and sales engagements.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills to support multiple concurrent opportunities, accounts, and client activities.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Ability to remain in a stationary position, including sitting or standing, for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions involving the wrists, hands, and fingers.
  • Ability to travel as required for client-facing engagements and other business needs.
  • Must be able to provide and maintain reliable high-speed internet connectivity and an appropriate remote-office setup.
  • Must be able to maintain a dedicated and secure work area.

General Statement

Complete all responsibilities outlined through the annual performance review and goal-setting process, as well as special projects and other duties as assigned. Duties must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. It does not constitute an employment agreement and may be modified as Cotiviti’s business needs and the requirements of the position evolve.

Base compensation ranges from $160,000 to $195,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

This role is eligible for commission.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

raw.description:
As the "quarterback" of each pursuit, the Proposal Specialist leads the end-to-end proposal process for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs and similar solicitations, running color team reviews from assignment through submission, supporting post-submission activities and coordinating all resources across sales, technical, pricing, contracts, legal, program management, partners and vendors into one cohesive response.

The role calls for both a strong persuasive writer and a disciplined project manager. The Proposal Specialist uses content library/knowledge management platforms and company-approved generative AI tools to produce compliant, compelling, win-focused responses efficiently. The ultimate goal of the role is to increase win rates and drive revenue.


What You Will Do:


Opportunity Assessment & Planning

  • Analyze solicitations for requirements, evaluation criteria, instructions and risks; build compliance matrices and outlines mapping each requirement to an owner.
  • Research the customer's priorities, constraints and hot buttons, the incumbent and the competitive landscape.
  • Provide relevant context and input for sales-led bid/no-bid decisions.

Proposal Leadership & Project Management

  • Build a schedule backward from the due date, define roles and track actions, risks and dependencies.
  • Manage concurrent proposals, hold contributors accountable without direct authority, escalate issues early.

Color Team Review Process

  • Plan, facilitate and adjudicate Kickoff, Pink (first draft), Red (final draft), Gold (page by page compliance); coordinate Green (pricing) reviews owned by sales or technical leads.

Strategy, Win Themes & Writing

  • Work with the opportunity team to develop the win strategy, win themes, discriminators and value propositions.
  • Write, edit and tailor persuasive, accurate, compliant content in one voice, aligned to evaluation criteria.

AI & Content Library

  • Use company-approved generative AI tools to analyze and deepen understanding of solicitations, draft and refine content, summarize requirements and speed up reviews.
  • Verify AI output, protect confidential data, and grow the content library, templates and boilerplate.

Compliance, Production & Submission

  • Ensure compliance with instructions, forms, certifications, formatting and page limits; manage final assembly, quality control and on-time submission, including via portals.

Post-Submission Support

  • Support clarifications, Q&A, orals, BAFOs and protests as needed, in a supporting rather than leading role.
  • Request and conduct debriefs, capture lessons learned, support award transition and close out opportunities.

Department Contribution

  • Join training, department and process-improvement initiatives, industry days and pre-proposal conferences; share best practices with peers.

What We Expect of You:

Minimum Basic requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Two or more years of proposal writing, proposal management, project management, technical/business writing or editorial experience.
  • Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadline-driven projects at the same time.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on compliance.
  • Working proficiency with generative AI tools and a willingness to adopt new technology.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint) and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Sound judgment, composure under pressure and constructive communication with all levels of the organization, including executives.

Preferred skills, experience, and qualities needed

  • Public sector or government procurement knowledge, including contracts, T&Cs and purchasing requirements.
  • General knowledge of IT products, services and solutions.
  • Experience with proposal content/RFP response platforms and structured color team reviews (e.g., Shipley).
  • APMP certification (Foundation or Practitioner) or PMI certification (CAPM or PMP).

Pay range: $71,000 - $100,000 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 5% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.
